Stiff–soft synergistic assembly of mechanically adaptive silica aerogel composites 软-硬协同组装策略构筑的力学自适应氧化硅气凝胶复合材料
abstract: Owing to their ultralow thermal conductivity, silica aerogels are considered among the most promising super-insulating materials. However, their intrinsic brittleness and poor processability severely restrict practical applications in complex industrial scenarios and extreme conditions. Herein, we report a macro-scale “stiff-soft” synergistic strategy that employs a macroscopically processable “soft and tough” framework as the load-bearing unit, while using “hard and brittle” polymethylsilsesquioxane (PMSQ) aerogels as the insulation unit to fabricate mechanically adaptive aerogel composites. This approach is based on a pressure-driven assembly process, where viscosity-tunable PMSQ gel inks are controllably filled into various hollow frameworks. Guided by the modified Hagen–Poiseuille model, the viscosity of the gel inks was precisely matched with the geometric parameters of the hollow structure (e.g., honeycomb panels, wheat straws, and hollow fibers). This integration enables the synergistic realization of high mechanical performance (e.g., compressive strength of 2.5 MPa, flexural strength of 6.25 MPa, and tensile strength of 40 MPa) and excellent thermal insulation. This strategy exhibits remarkable versatility and scalability, providing a new design paradigm for the development of silica aerogel composites with mechanically adaptive properties in thermal management applications.

title: High resistive switching on/off ratio in Lu doped Hf0.4Zr0.6O2 thin films through band structure and vacancy co-strategy 能带结构与空位协同调控实现Lu:Hf0.4Zr0.6O2薄膜的高阻变开关比
abstract: Fluorite-structured oxides (HfO 2 , ZrO 2 ) are ideal materials for resistive random-access memory (RRAM) due to their scalability and adjustable structural and electrical characteristics. The high-resistive switching windows are essential for improving reading accuracy in memory applications. Here, we adopted a collaborative strategy by optimizing the Hf/Zr ratio and Lu 3+ doping to regulate the band structure and oxygen vacancy concentration, which significantly influence intrinsic leakage currents and the formation of conductive filaments. The resulting Lu-doped Hf 0.4 Zr 0.6 O 2 (LHZO) thin films achieve a resistive switching ratio of 8.4 × 10 4 , which is two orders of magnitude higher than that of ZrO 2 thin films (1.2 × 10 3 ). Electrical characterization and synchrotron radiation photoemission spectroscopy confirm that enhanced insulating properties and increased oxygen vacancies are pivotal for suppressing off-state conduction and stabilizing conductive filaments in the on-state. These findings show that the co-optimization of band structure and oxygen vacancy effectively regulates the electrical characteristics of fluorite-structured oxides as high-performance RRAM.

title: COFAP: a universal framework for COFs adsorption prediction through designed multi-modal extraction and cross-modal synergy COFAP: 一种通过多模态提取和跨模态协同设计实现COFs吸附预测的通用框架
abstract: Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are promising adsorbents for gas adsorption and separation, while identifying the optimal structures among their vast design space requires efficient high-throughput screening. Conventional machine-learning predictors rely heavily on specific gas-related features. However, these features are time-consuming and limit scalability, leading to inefficiency and labor-intensive processes. Herein, a universal COFs adsorption prediction framework (COFAP) is proposed, which can extract multi-modal structural and chemical features through deep learning, and fuse these complementary features via cross-modal attention mechanism. Without relying on explicit gas-specific thermodynamic descriptors, COFAP achieves state-of-the-art prediction performance on the hypoCOFs dataset under the conditions investigated in this study, outperforming existing approaches. Based on COFAP, we also found that high-performing COFs for gas separation concentrate within a narrow range of pore size and surface area. A weight-adjustable prioritization scheme is also developed to enable flexible, application-specific ranking of candidate COFs for researchers. Superior efficiency and accuracy render COFAP directly deployable in crystalline porous materials.

title: Architecturing unique microstructures in high-entropy alloys via compositional complexity for superior mechanical performance: a critical review 高熵合金成分复杂性诱导的独特微观组织与优异力学性能综述
abstract: Departing from the initial paradigm of single-phase solid-solutions, high-entropy alloys (HEAs) have evolved to actively exploit their inherent compositional complexity as a strategic lever for microstructural design. This review synthesizes recent advances by categorizing and analyzing three distinct classes of microstructures uniquely enabled by this chemical complexity: unique solidification microstructures (eutectic, peritectic, eutectoid), multi-scale solid-state precipitates, and chemical short-range order (CSRO) configurations. Crucially, we elucidate not only the individual formation mechanisms of these microstructures but also their cross-coupling interactions across multiple length scales. Furthermore, we detail how these distinct structural features interplay with fundamental deformation mechanisms to achieve unprecedented mechanical properties. By establishing explicit composition-microstructure-property linkages, this work provides a targeted framework for leveraging chemical complexity, moving beyond empirical exploration toward the rational design of next-generation HEAs with tailored hierarchical architectures and superior performance.

title: Ultrafast scintillation enabled by exciton localization in high-entropy fluoride crystals 高熵氟化物晶体中激子局域化实现超快闪烁
abstract: Ultrafast scintillators with low-nanosecond emission are essential for next-generation high-rate X-ray and particle imaging. Although Ce 3+ -activated scintillators inherently exhibit fast response characteristics, conventional Ce 3+ -doped hosts rarely achieve low-nanosecond ultrafast decay. Here, we report a high-entropy fluoride scintillator (HEFS), Ce:LaGdCaSrBaF 12 (Ce:LGCSB), in the form of bulk single crystals. The severe lattice distortion arising from multication disorder induces exciton localization and effectively suppresses exciton diffusion. Through the rapid relaxation of localized excitons, the high-entropy Ce:LGCSB single crystals deliver a decay time of 1.23 ns with a 94.6% fast-component contribution and without any noticeable slow component. Through first-principles calculations, spectroscopic characterization, and transient dynamics analysis, we reveal that the ultrafast response originates from accelerated Frenkel exciton (FE) recombination enabled by the high-entropy environment. This work establishes entropy-engineered fluorides as promising ultrafast scintillator platforms and proposes a general strategy for extending sluggish diffusion effects to the excitonic scale, offering new opportunities for improving scintillation timing performance.

title: Advancing functional vascular reconstruction through 3D printing strategies 3D打印策略推进功能性血管重建
abstract: The human vascular system, characterized by multi-scale topological complexity, serves as the fundamental infrastructure for nutrient transport, hemodynamic regulation, and immune surveillance. Replicating this system is critical for injury repair, disease modeling, and organ-on-a-chip development, yet a key gap persists between structural mimicry and full functional reproduction. This review evaluates how emerging 3D printing strategies are advancing beyond geometric imitation toward integrated physiological functions, thereby helping to bridge this divide. Over the past decade, 3D printing has advanced significantly in functional vascular reconstruction via precise molding and cell-material integration. This review summarizes the latest progress, including material design, molding methods and structural optimization, focusing on 3D printing breakthroughs in three core scenarios: high-fidelity in vitro vascular models, in vivo tissue functional replacement, and vascularized organ-on-a-chip systems. Furthermore, this review delves into the existing challenges and future prospects of these application directions.

title: An AIE-active centrosymmetric small molecule for ultra-deep three-photon brain angiography in the NIR-III window 一种具有聚集诱导发光特性的中心对称小分子用于NIR-III区窗口的超深层三光子脑血管成像
abstract: Three-photon microscopy (3PM) utilizing the near-infrared-III (NIR-III) window (1600–1840 nm) provides a pivotal tool for high-resolution visualization of cerebral vasculature in vivo , owing to its superior deep-tissue penetration capability. However, imaging quality is critically dependent on the performance of fluorescent probes. This study proposes a probe optimization design strategy evolving from mirror symmetry to centrosymmetry, leading to the synthesis of a highly symmetrical aggregation-induced emission (AIE) molecule, T4PQ. The centrosymmetric structure enables precise matching of donor (D)-acceptor (A) units, facilitating uniform electron cloud delocalization and directional charge transfer. This enhances exciton formation efficiency and suppresses non-radiative decay, thereby improving the fluorescence quantum yield. Furthermore, the highly symmetrical configuration significantly boosts the three-photon absorption cross-section by promoting electron delocalization and increasing the transition dipole moment, enabling stronger nonlinear optical responses under long-wavelength excitation. As a result, the designed T4PQ nanoparticles achieve optimized probe performance, combining an enhanced three-photon absorption cross-section, high fluorescence quantum yield, and excellent photostability. The corresponding nanoparticles (T4PQ NPs) exhibited a significantly enhanced three-photon absorption cross section, high fluorescence quantum yield, and excellent photostability. In murine in vivo experiments, T4PQ NPs achieved three-dimensional cerebrovascular imaging at a depth of 1785 µm and enabled real-time dynamic observation of hemodynamics in microvessels at a depth of 1006 µm, while demonstrating good biocompatibility. This research validates the advantage of centrosymmetric molecular structures in the design of deep-brain imaging probes, providing a high-performance tool for neurovascular research.

title: The stable radical anions generated from perylenediimide functionalized bispillar[5]arene for boosting near-infrared photothermal conversion 基于苝二酰亚胺功能化双柱[5]芳烃的稳定自由基阴离子构建及其近红外光热转换增强效应
abstract: Perylene diimide (PDI) radical anions exhibit poor environmental stability, which restricts their generation efficiency and practical application. Herein, a PDI-functionalized bispillar[5]arene (PDI-P5) was designed to construct stable and high-efficiency photothermal radicals. Intramolecular charge transfer (ICT) between PDI and bispillar[5]arene narrows the energy gap. Under 455 nm ultraviolet light irradiation and diethylamine (DEA) vapor exposure, photoinduced electron transfer (PET) efficiently generates PDI-P5 ·− radicals, which possess broad near-infrared (NIR) absorption, enhanced non-radiative transitions, and excellent stability. Notably, PDI-P5 ·− can rapidly reach 90 °C under 0.20 W cm −2 simulated sunlight irradiation. Moreover, it exhibits superior multi-step photothermal anti-counterfeiting performance. This work provides a novel strategy for the development of stable radical-based photothermal materials, which holds great potential for anti-counterfeiting and bioimaging applications.

title: Bioelectric responsive nanozymes for catalytic control of lipid peroxyl radicals 生物电响应型纳米酶用于脂质过氧自由基的催化调控
abstract: Lipid peroxyl radicals (ROO·), the terminal propagating species of lipid peroxidation, are major drivers of oxidative damage in neurological disorders. Their prolonged lifetime and rapid diffusion within lipid membranes make them difficult to neutralize. Here, we develop a bioelectric-responsive TEMPO-doped polydopamine (PDA@TEMPO) nanozyme that sustains catalytic interception of ROO· radicals under persistent oxidative stress. By coupling a PDA redox reservoir with TEMPO catalytic centers, the nanozyme establishes a self-regenerating radical-neutralization cycle via proton-coupled electron transfer. The π-conjugated framework further facilitates charge migration and enables an electric-field-enhanced antioxidant response. In a seizure model, the nanozyme dynamically responds to bioelectric fluctuations, accelerating radical interception and alleviating oxidative stress in neural microenvironments. These findings establish bioelectric coupled nanozymes as a general strategy for catalytic and sustained regulation of oxidative stress in neural microenvironments, providing a potential therapeutic approach for neurological disorders.

title: Hierarchical structures invoked by hydrogen binding domains based on hydrogen-bonded organic frameworks for ultra-tough elastomers 基于氢键有机框架的氢键域引发的多级结构用于超韧性弹性体
abstract: Elastomers are one of the promising rubber materials, but high mechanical strength at the expense of flexibility, toughness and adhesiveness has offset their advantages. It is pivotal and challenging to balance the energy dissipation of the elastomers. Herein, the hierarchical structure of elastomers based on hydrogen-bonded organic frameworks (HOFs) hard phase and polyurethane soft phase has been reported. The hard HOFs invoke hydrogen binding domains to form multiple noncovalent interactions between HOFs and polyurethane, which facilitates the energy dissipation under external force, while soft and ductile polyurethane chains maintain the integrity of elastomers. The tensile strength and toughness of as-prepared elastomers are as high as 8.01 MPa ± 0.34 MPa and 80.52 MJ m −3 ± 11.46 MJ m −3 , respectively, which greatly surpass those in the polyurethane counterpart (2.76 MPa ± 0.20 MPa and 27.48 MJ m −3 ± 3.84 MJ m −3 ). The ultra-high toughness and elasticity endow the elastomers with splendid and repeatable adhesiveness toward various substrates. Benefiting from the strong mechanical performance, the resultant elastomer sensors could accurately recognize the gesture during operating electronic products with recognition accuracy over 94%. This work provides a promising approach to construct high-performance elastomers for the development of flexible electronics.

title: Novel cross-linkable blue light emitting material and its high stability OLEDs by solution process 新型交联蓝光材料分子设计合成及高稳定溶液工艺器件研究
abstract: The solution process holds great promise for organic light-emitting diode (OLED) fabrication owing to its minimal material loss, simple processing and low equipment investment. However, solution-processed blue OLEDs still face the challenges of low electroluminescence efficiency and poor working stability. In this study, two new cross-linkable blue light-emitting molecules, v-4CzBn and v-5CzBn, were synthesized. They featured a multicarbazole-substituted benzonitrile donor–acceptor structure as the emitting core, with two vinyl phenyl units on the carbazole rings serving as cross-linking groups. A singlet–triplet energy gap of Δ E ST ⩽ 0.10 eV and a high reverse intersystem crossing rate ( k RISC > 10 6 s −1 ) were achieved because the three-dimensionally confined covalent network structure formed through a thermal cross-linking reaction limited intramolecular motions and vibrational relaxations of luminescent units. Moreover, this structure suppressed irreversible morphological changes and structural deterioration of light-emitting units due to aggregation or crystallization, improving the light-emitting performance of the device. Nondoped solution-processed OLEDs with the structure of ITO/PEDOT:PSS/TFB/S-4CzBn/TPBi/LiF/Al exhibited blue emission with a peak at 488 nm, achieving a maximum external quantum efficiency of 12.01%, a maximum luminance of 11,141.15 cd m −2 , and a T 50 lifetime of 1375.66 h@100 cd m −2 . This result represents the longest operational lifetime reported to date for solution-process devices with cross-linked emitting layers.

title: Synergistic conformation locking and terminal conjugation engineering of carbazole-based self-assembled monolayers for high-performance organic solar cells 咔唑基自组装单分子层的协同构象锁定与末端共轭工程用于高性能有机太阳能电池
abstract: Self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) are pivotal for optimizing the electrode interfaces in organic solar cells (OSCs) because of their molecular conformation and ordering govern interfacial quality. Conventional carbazole-based SAMs (e.g., 2PACz) rely on flexible alkyl linkers whose conformational freedom often results in disordered packing, incomplete coverage, and limited environmental robustness, especially under air processing. Here, we design and systematically study a series of well-defined carbazole SAM homologues (Cz-PPA, Cz-HPA, PCz-HPA, and PCz-PPA) to elucidate the role of synergistic conformational locking achieved through linker rigidification and terminal conjugation extension. PCz-HPA, which integrates a rigid cyclohexane linker with a strongly conjugated 3,6-diphenylcarbazole end group, enables effective conformational locking. It forms a highly ordered, densely packed monolayer on ITO, delivering high surface coverage, a strengthened interfacial dipole, and improved energy-level alignment. The rigid framework and ordered interface enhance air-process stability and interfacial contact, thereby suppressing recombination and facilitating exciton dissociation and charge collection. Using PCz-HPA as SAM for the devices based on PM6:L8-BO reaches 19.75% efficiency and it demonstrates consistent gains across multiple systems. These results identify conformational locking via linker rigidification as a general design rule for durable, high-performance SAM interlayers in organic optoelectronics.

title: Sequential conformational dynamics in the excited state programmed multicolor emission in a carbon nanohoop 碳纳米环连续激发态构象动力学调控的多色发光
abstract: Multicolor luminescent materials hold great promise in data encryption, anticounterfeiting, bioimaging, and white light-emitting diodes, but achieving diverse emissive states in a single organic luminophore remains a formidable challenge. Leveraging the intrinsic ring strain of cycloparaphenylene (CPP), we report an effective strategy to develop robust organic multicolor luminophores by modulating excited-state conformational dynamics. Consequently, the proof-of-concept nanohoop, [10]CPP-pICz, exhibits wide-tuning and stimulus-responsive fluorescent properties with an emission color tunable from yellow to blue. The mechanism underlying the dynamic fluorescence is thoroughly investigated using time-resolved spectroscopy, establishing a sequential conformational transformation governed by R*→I 1 *→I 2 *→P* due to the progressive planarization of the carbon nanohoop. Given the stimulus responsiveness, the potential applications of [10]CPP-pICz in dynamic multicolor display and information encryption are further demonstrated. Our results show that CPP is a promising platform for enabling controllable multicolor luminescence, which may pave the way for the development of advanced organic luminescent materials.

title: Activating inert atomic sites in heterogeneous catalysis: multi-scale design strategies 异相催化中惰性原子位点的激活: 多尺度设计策略
abstract: Heterogeneous catalysis serves as a cornerstone technology underpinning modern energy conversion, chemical manufacturing, and environmental remediation. However, its advancement has long been constrained by the scarcity and prohibitive cost of noble metals. A more sustainable paradigm lies in activating the abundant intrinsically inert sites inherent in low-cost materials (e.g., transition metal oxides and carbon-based materials)—an approach widely regarded as a “precision-control” revolution in catalysis. This review systematically outlines recent advances in activating inert sites within low-cost catalytic materials. We begin by dissecting the physicochemical origins of catalytic inertness. Subsequently, we elucidate the mechanisms by which multi-scale strategies—including structural engineering, quantum state engineering, and microenvironment engineering—break local atomic symmetry, modulate electronic spin states, and construct unique reaction microenvironments, thereby transforming “spectator” atoms into highly efficient active centers. The review further highlights the performance breakthroughs achieved through these strategies in key reactions such as the oxygen evolution reaction and alkane dehydrogenation, where catalytic metrics now rival or even surpass noble metal benchmarks. Finally, we provide a critical assessment of the formidable challenges—stability, scalable synthesis, and cost-effectiveness—that hinder the transition of this technology from laboratory to industry. Future directions are also outlined, with an emphasis on multi-strategy synergy and artificial intelligence-assisted rational design. This review aims to provide both theoretical guidance and technological pathways for subverting the traditional noble-metal-dependent paradigm and developing next-generation efficient and low-cost catalytic systems.

title: Smart yet safe: a tumor-targeting scaffold for activatable NIR photosensitizers with complete toxicity reversal 智能且安全: 响应驱动可肿瘤靶向近红外光敏剂的毒性翻转
abstract: Activatable photosensitizers (aPSs) are currently effective tools for improving the specificity of tumor phototherapy. However, most existing dye-based aPSs to date have often exhibited weak photosensitizing activity and poor tumor-targeting capability, thus compromising the therapeutic efficacy. Moreover, high doses of aPSs are usually required for in vivo therapeutic applications, leading to unavoidable dark toxicity, which significantly hinders the clinical translation of aPSs. Herein, we discovered a novel scaffold (CS3) that simultaneously minimized the photo/dark toxicity of aPSs. CS3 with an appropriate p K cycle value undergone structural rearrangement after being modified by the response substrate of H 2 O 2 , forming a non-conjugated aPS (CS3-H 2 O 2 ), which blocked energy acquisition of the aPS at the source and minimized its phototoxicity. The aPS possessed no intrinsic charge, effectively eliminating the dark toxicity attributable to charge effects. Upon activation with specific biomarkers, the aPS restored intramolecular π -conjugation and photosensitizing activity. More notably, CS3 and CS3-based aPS equipped a better tumor-targeting capability compared to their parent molecules. The optimization of these biological properties has significantly enhanced the precision of phototherapeutic intervention, and has provided a robust and generalizable approach for developing highly biosafe phototherapeutic agents.

title: Surface dye-coordination for efficient upconversion nanosystems 表面染料配位构建高效上转换纳米体系
abstract: Abstract Lanthanide-doped upconversion nanoparticles (UCNPs) exhibit distinctive optical characteristics, including excellent photostability, large anti-Stokes shifts, narrow emission bands, and tunable luminescence lifetimes. Despite their advantages, UCNPs suffer from inherently weak light absorption because of the 4f-4f transitions of lanthanide ions. Near-infrared dye-sensitization has emerged as an effective strategy to enhance their absorption, yet the photoconversion performance remains constrained by photobleaching and interfacial energy losses. In this review, we systematically analyze the surface coordination environments and energy transfer pathways that govern dye-sensitized UCNPs. We evaluate critical molecular parameters, such as dye frameworks, surface binding affinity, and triplet-state energy alignment, in conjunction with nanoparticle structural features, including dopant concentration, core-shell architectures, and surface electronic configurations. By providing a fundamental assessment of these photophysical and photochemical processes, we propose targeted optimization strategies to enhance the performance and stability of these hybrid materials for advanced applications.

title: Advances in piezoelectric materials with diverse crystal structures: from design to applications 不同晶体结构的压电材料研究进展: 从设计到应用
abstract: Piezoelectric materials are the cornerstone of modern electromechanical energy conversion, critical for advancing technologies ranging from sensors to precision actuators. While their performance is intrinsically linked to the piezoelectric coefficient, which dictates energy conversion efficiency and device sensitivity, optimizing this property remains a challenge due to the profound influence of diverse microscopic structures. This review comprehensively examines three fundamental crystalline architectures, namely perovskite, wurtzite, and fluorite, and critically analyzes performance optimization strategies tailored to each structure. We delve into five principal modification approaches, including defect engineering, elemental doping, heterostructure films fabrication, composite films design, and buffer layer incorporation, with a focus on elucidating the underlying physical mechanisms that govern property enhancements. By providing a cross-structural comparison of these strategies, this review establishes clear structure property relationships, offering a foundational guide for material selection and design. Furthermore, we highlight the implications of these advanced materials for next-generation applications in energy harvesting and smart devices. Finally, the review concludes with a forward-looking roadmap, outlining emerging research directions and addressing key technical challenges to guide the development of next-generation high-performance piezoelectric materials.

title: Topology-derived construction of single-crystal two-dimensional binodal covalent organic frameworks toward inclined AB stacking

Carbazole-based aqueous supramolecular organic frameworks enabling cascade energy transfer-regulated ROS photocatalysis for metal-free C–S and P–S bond formation 基于咔唑的水性超分子有机框架材料: 实现连续能量传递调控的活性氧光催化反应以促进无金属的C–S和P–S键形成
abstract: Constructing aqueous supramolecular organic frameworks (SOFs) that integrate efficient multistep energy transfer with versatile photocatalytic reactivity remains a central challenge in artificial photosynthesis. Herein, a carbazole-based two-dimensional SOF is assembled via cucurbit [8]uril-mediated host-guest recognition, followed by sequential incorporation of Rhodamine B (RhB) and Sulfo-Cyanine5 (Cy5) to enable cascade fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET) with a second-step efficiency of 91.4% in water. The cascade energy migration regulates reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation toward enhanced superoxide anion radicals (O 2 •− ) production, allowing metal-free aerobic C–S and P–S bond formation under mild aqueous conditions with broad substrate scope. Mechanistic studies reveal an O 2 •− -mediated sulfur radical pathway that directly couples supramolecular energy transfer with selective bond construction. This work establishes design principles for multifunctional aqueous supramolecular photocatalysts and advances sustainable photochemical synthesis based on SOFs.

title: A comprehensive review on double-redox reaction towards high-performance polyanionic sodium-ion batteries 双电子氧化还原反应助力高性能聚阴离子钠离子电池开发
abstract: Polyanionic cathode materials are widely considered as potential cathode materials for sodium-ion batteries due to their strong three-dimensional framework and intrinsic thermal safety. Nevertheless, the limitation of the specific capacity and energy density hindered their application, which can be ascribed to the common reliance of single-electron redox reaction of the transition metal. By realizing the reversible double redox reaction of vanadium-based and manganese-based polyanion cathodes, researchers have successfully opened up a new way to break through the long-term performance limitations. Recent studies disclose that vanadium and manganese-based polyanionic cathodes exhibit the possibility of realizing a reversible double-redox reaction, which opened up new avenues to overcome the capacity dilemma. However, many fundamental issues remain unclear, including insufficient structural stability at high operating voltages, irreversible structural evolution induced by sodium extraction, sluggish electronic and ionic transport kinetics, and Jahn-Teller distortion. Therefore, it is imperative to summarize recent work in order to clarify the pathway for future investigation. In this review, the key challenges associated with the activation of the double-redox reaction are outlined, followed by the realization and regulation of the double-redox reaction in polyanionic cathode materials. A systematic summary of recent studies is performed for both vanadium and manganese-based compounds, which could contribute to the fundamental understanding of the double-redox reaction mechanism. Combined with the modification strategy and future perspective, this review provides insights into the rational design of polyanionic cathodes with a reversible double-redox reaction. It also offers insights into the development of high-energy-density cathode materials for next-generation sodium-ion batteries.

title: Correction to: Intrinsic pseudocapacitive Na0.44MnO2 prepared by novel ion-exchange method for high rate and robust sodium-ion (Vol. 66, Issue 10, pages 3810–3816, 2023)
Lattice distortion effect in high entropy thermoelectric materials: mechanisms and optimization strategies 高熵热电材料的晶格畸变效应: 机理协同与性能优化
abstract: 在全球能源危机与环保技术日益受到重视的背景下, 热电材料因能实现热能与电能的直接转换而成为研究热点. 近年来, 通过纳米结构工程、 能带工程及高熵工程等策略, 热电材料的性能显著提升. 其中, 高熵材料设计是热电领域的前沿方向之一. 其核心理念是利用多种主要元素占据同一晶格位点, 构筑具有高度无序特征的晶体结构. 基于这一独特结构, 高熵材料表现出四种核心效应, 为协同优化热电性能开辟了新途径. 本文围绕四大核心效应中的晶格畸变效应, 系统阐述其微观机制, 深入分析其对电输运和热输运性能的影响, 并进一步揭示高熵材料中晶格畸变与电声输运之间的复杂关系, 旨在为高熵热电材料的优化设计提供理论指导.

title: 3D printing of electro-ionic artificial muscles with rapid, large, and programmable deformations 具有快速、 大幅度和可编程变形的3D打印电离子型人工肌肉
abstract: Ionic-polymer metal composites (IPMCs) actuators are smart materials that have garnered increasing attention in the field of soft robotics due to their large bending deformation and rapid response to low operating voltages. However, conventional fabrication methods, such as solution-casting, have inherent limitations, including long fabrication times, simple geometries, and a single deformation mode. This study develops a polylactic acid (PLA)-reinforced perfluorosulfonic acid resin (PFSR) composite filament for fabricating IPMC actuators with programmable deformation via fused filament fabrication (FFF) 3D printing. Incorporating PLA into soft PFSR filaments improves printability and allows the printed parts to be reshaped into desired geometries that are difficult to print directly. The 3D-printed actuator exhibits superior actuation performance, with a bending angle of 169° (5.72% bending strain) under a DC voltage of 3 V and a swing speed of 56° s −1 at 3 V, 1.0 Hz sinusoidal voltage. Interestingly, its shape morphing can also be pre-programmed to switch between bending and helical deformation by controlling printing parameters. These deformations can be predicted by the proposed finite element numerical method. As proof-of-concept demonstrations, various intriguing applications, including a U-shaped structure, a spiral structure, a bionic flower, and a microarchitecture for robotic metamaterials, are fabricated, revealing the potential of the 3D printing method in the realms of stimuli-responsive materials, robotic applications, biomimetic devices, and beyond.

title: Promoting CO2 electrocarboxylation to C6+ dicarboxylic acids by tuning Co-Fe interactions 调控Co-Fe相互作用促进CO2电羧化反应生成C6+双羧酸
abstract: 纳米材料科学的进展为CO 2 与有机底物的电化学羧化反应开辟了新途径, 使目标产物能够实现高选择性和高转化率. 在本研究中, 我们合成了一系列Co/Fe比例可调的CoFeP双金属催化剂, 用于1,3-二烯烃与CO 2 的电羧化反应. 其中, CoFeP(1:1) (1:1表示Co/Fe的投料摩尔比)催化剂表现出最佳电羧化活性(约82%). 开路电位测试结果表明, CoFeP(1:1)对1,3-二烯烃具有稳定的吸附能力; 电化学原位光谱进一步证实, 在该催化剂表面能够高效生成关键中间体*CO 2ad , 这一实验结果与理论计算结论高度一致. 在完成2 × 2 cm 2 小型流动电解池中的初步性能评估后, 该催化剂成功放大至5 × 5 cm 2 流动电解池体系, 实现了6.54 g双羧酸产物的制备. 上述结果充分表明, CoFeP双金属催化剂在CO 2 电羧化反应中具有良好的实际应用前景.

title: Chemical confinement of short-chain sulfur into hierarchical porous hard carbon for ultra-stable high-capacity sodium-ion storage 短链硫在多级孔硬碳中的化学限域及其超稳定高容 量钠离子存储的应用
abstract: The pursuit of high-energy-density sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) necessitates the development of stable high-capacity anodes. While amorphous carbon is a promising anode candidate for SIBs, its practical application is hindered by limited capacity. Herein, we design a composite anode by chemically confining a high-content (∼25 wt%) short-chain sulfur into hierarchical porous hard carbon microspheres (SHHC) derived from microbe yeast. The SHHC anode exhibits a high reversible capacity of ∼807 mAh g −1 at 0.03 A g −1 (∼3 times that of conventional amorphous carbon) along with superior rate capability, and extraordinary long-term cyclability (almost 100% capacity retention after 2000 cycles at 1.0 A g −1 ). The high-content sulfur species contribute to superb redox reactivity for high-capacity sodium storage via a surface-dominated storage mechanism. The carbon matrix features an enlarged interlayer distance, which facilitates Na-ion intercalation and deintercalation for high-rate capability. Furthermore, the hierarchical porous structure with built-in cavities facilitates the Na-ion transfer and effectively accommodates the electrode’s volume expansion, achieving fast electrode kinetics and outstanding cyclability. Such a combination of favored properties leads to state-of-the-art comprehensive battery performance for Na-ion storage. Our finding envisions a new perspective on building stable high-capacity anode materials for SIBs.

title: Metal atomic clusters for oxygen-bearing materials: from adversity comes opportunity 金属原子团簇赋能含氧材料: 从困境到机遇
abstract: Atomic-level manufacturing receives widespread attention in different industries as a frontier technology enabling materials to achieve ultimate performance. To advance the interdisciplinary integration of atomic-level manufacturing processes and products, this study explores the potential applications and critical scientific issues of metal atomic clusters. Metal atomic clusters are predominantly utilized in catalysis, but their extremely strong intrinsic instability imposes long-standing fundamental challenges on their practical applications, including low yield, inconsistent size and structure, and high susceptibility to agglomeration, oxidation, and sintering. From adversity comes opportunity; we pioneer a novel concept that employs oxidized metal atomic clusters as dopants in oxygen-bearing materials (e.g., oxide dispersion strengthened (ODS) alloy, oxide-based cermet, and toughening ceramic). Taking ODS alloy as the proof-of-concept, Ni-NiO coupled cluster-strengthened metallic Ni exhibits finer grains, a larger proportion of low-angle grain boundaries, higher geometrically necessary dislocation density, and achieves a 38% enhancement in Vickers hardness. To further advance this novel concept, four critical scientific issues require urgent resolution: oxidation control, disaggregation and dispersion, effectiveness comparison, and physicochemical behaviors and mechanisms.

title: Ultra-high-crystallinity transparent glass-ceramic scintillators for high-temperature X-ray imaging 用于高温X射线成像的超高结晶度透明玻璃陶瓷闪烁体
abstract: High-temperature X-ray imaging requires scintillators of high crystallinity, efficient scintillation, and robust thermal stability, yet suitable scintillators remain scarce. In this study, an ultra-high-crystallinity transparent glass-ceramic (GC) scintillator is strategically designed through a controllable heat-treatment-induced crystallization process. A sequential precipitation method is employed, where cubic CaF 2 nanocrystals initially form, subsequently promoting the heterogeneous nucleation and growth of hexagonal BaAl 2 Si 2 O 8 . Due to intrinsic nanoscale phase separation into F-rich and O-rich domains, atomic diffusion distances are significantly reduced, resulting in an unprecedented crystallinity of up to 97.6%. Notably, the presence of defect traps (oxygen vacancy defects, likely located within the lattice or at the crystalline/amorphous interface) enables efficient carrier capture and thermally stimulated release, contributing to remarkable resistance to thermal quenching. Consequently, the proposed GC scintillator maintains 90.6% of its integrated X-ray excited luminescence (XEL) intensity at 300 °C, with the integrated XEL intensity reaching 94.2% of the commercial BL 4 Ge 3 O 12 (BGO) at room temperature, thus enabling stable high-temperature X-ray imaging with a spatial resolution of ∼10.4 lp mm −1 up to 225 °C. This work provides a versatile pathway for developing high-sensitivity scintillators for extreme-environment X-ray imaging.

title: Inhalable ROS-responsive liposomes for orchestrating microenvironment remodeling and epithelial regeneration in pulmonary fibrosis 可吸入活性氧响应型脂质体用于协同调控肺纤维化 中的微环境重塑与上皮再生
abstract: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a lethal interstitial lung disease with a limited cure rate. Herein, an innovative strategy is rationally designed to effectively coordinate antioxidant activity and functional epithelial regeneration for the synergistic treatment of IPF. Specifically, a multifunctional nebulized liposomal system (SAB/GC-1@Lip-cRGD) was synthesized via a thin-film hydration method to co-deliver the antioxidant salvianolic acid B (SAB) and the thyroid hormone receptor β (TRβ) agonist Sobetirome (GC-1). This system was constructed with reactive oxygen species (ROS)-responsive lipid matrix and surface-modified with cRGD peptides for targeted delivery to fibrotic lesions. Its negative surface charge further enhances mucus penetration and facilitates accumulation at fibrotic sites. In response to the high ROS characteristic of the fibrotic microenvironment, SAB/GC-1@Lip-cRGD undergoes structural destabilization, promoting the rapid release of GC-1 and SAB. Free GC-1 drives the differentiation of arrested Krt8 + transitional epithelial cells into functional alveolar type I (AT1) cells for restoring lung function. Meanwhile, SAB efficiently scavenges ROS to remodel the fibrotic microenvironment and abrogate fibrotic progression. Importantly, this synergy between microenvironment remodeling and epithelial regeneration achieves a robust anti-fibrotic effect and significantly accelerates the repair of damaged lung tissues, highlighting a new paradigm for combination therapy against IPF.

title: Core-shell type lipid versus polymer surface modified nanocarriers for enhanced colorectal cancer therapy
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) has drawn significant attention due to poor prognosis in its treatment. Oral nanomedicine is the most optimal strategy for effective therapy of CRC. However, the selection of appropriate nanoparticles (NPs) with required surface properties for effective oral therapy of CRC is very challenging. Therefore, there is a huge demand in surface engineering of polymer- and lipid-modified nanocarriers to improve oral therapy of CRC. In the current study, we develop a comprehensive library of chitosan (Ch)-, polyvinyl alcohol (PVA)-, polyethylenimine (PEI)- and D - α -tocopheryl polyethylene glycol succinate (TPGS)-modified silica nanoparticles (Si NPs) with controlled surface properties to facilitate effective oral therapy of CRC in preclinical mouse model. We have compared their morphology, size, structural characteristics, colloidal stability, estimated drug loading and release efficiency, studied in vitro and in vivo biodistribution, and evaluated oral therapy of CRC. It was found to have surface-dependent biodistribution and therapeutic outcome regarding the type of NPs. This study provides new insights into the development of oral nanomedicine for effective oral therapy of CRC.

title: Asymmetric small molecule acceptors for organic photovoltaics: insights from multiple perspectives 有机光伏器件中不对称小分子受体的多尺度综合分析
abstract: The rapid development of small molecule acceptors (SMAs) has recently enabled organic photovoltaics (OPVs) to achieve power conversion efficiencies exceeding 21%, while structural asymmetry has emerged as a particularly effective approach for boosting acceptor performance. To further exploit the efficiency potential, a comprehensive overview of asymmetric SMAs from the molecular scale to the nanoscale and macroscale is provided. The main text is organized into four sections, including molecular design strategies for structural asymmetry, crystal structure evolution from symmetry breaking, morphological characteristics revealed by advanced characterization techniques, and energy loss mechanisms involving asymmetric SMAs. At the molecular scale, asymmetry enables precise modulation of dipole moments and intermolecular interactions, directly affecting crystalline packing and charge-transport networks. At the nanoscale, it further regulates domain purity, phase continuity, and molecular orientation. Asymmetric designs can also help mitigate non-radiative voltage loss through modulation of charge-transfer state energetics. Overall, asymmetric molecular design introduces additional structural and electronic tunability, offering new opportunities for overcoming the trade-offs that limit OPV performance. Finally, we discuss ongoing challenges and outline future perspectives to guide continued development and innovation in asymmetric SMA design.

title: Cobalt phosphide-driven thermodynamic ordering for efficient organic solar cells 基于磷化钴驱动的热力学有序化实现高效有机太阳能电池
abstract: 在有机太阳能电池中, 理想的体异质结形貌需在分子级混溶(利激子解离)与纳米级纯相(利电荷传输)间精细折中, 这一内在权衡从根本上制约了器件性能. 我们提出以磷化钴纳米晶进行可控相纯化的新策略来突破该瓶颈. 将CoP引入D18:L8-BO共混体系, 同步增强了给、 受体相结晶度, 并促进更纯受体畴的生长. 这种CoP引导的重组形成高度有序、 低无序的异质结, 显著抑制非孪生复合, 使电荷传输更平衡高效. 优化器件效率达20.8%, 填充因子突破81%, 短路电流高且开路电压得以保持. 该工作为缓解高性能有机太阳能电池中混溶–结晶度权衡提供了可推广路径.

title: Engineering high-efficiency anthracene-based deep-blue emitters via spirofluorene bridge-mediated electronic structure modulation 通过螺芴桥介导的电子结构调控设计高效蒽基深蓝光材料
abstract: Deep-blue organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) present the most formidable challenge among primary-color emitters because of their stringent exciton energy requirements. To overcome this limitation, we strategically designed two innovative deep-blue emitters—SCZ-4AnCN and STPA-4AnCN—through systematic functionalization of an anthracene core with arylamino-decorated spirofluorene donors and cyano-substituted phenyl acceptors. Comprehensive theoretical and experimental analyses demonstrate that these spirofluorene-anthracene hybrids adopt precisely engineered distorted configurations, effectively suppressing detrimental intermolecular π-π stacking in condensed phases. The sp 3 -hybridized bridgehead carbons in spirofluorene units play a pivotal role by simultaneously restricting π-conjugation extension and fine-tuning donor-acceptor interactions, thereby stabilizing the lowest excited singlet (S 1 ) state with a dominant local excitation (LE) character. This sophisticated molecular engineering approach yields exceptional deep-blue emission with remarkable efficiency. Notably, the materials exhibit unique high-lying reverse intersystem crossing (hRISC) behavior, enabling efficient triplet harvesting in OLED applications. Optimized doped devices incorporating SCZ-4AnCN achieve outstanding performance metrics, including a maximum external quantum efficiency (EQE max ) exceeding 10% and CIE coordinates (0.154, 0.052) that approach the demanding BT.2020 blue standard. Furthermore, nondoped devices maintain impressive performance with an EQE max of 7.51% and superior operational stability, demonstrating less than 10% efficiency roll-off at 1000 cd m −2 . This seminal work not only validates anthracene-based molecular architectures for deep-blue electroluminescence but also establishes a transformative design paradigm for next-generation OLED emitters.

title: TMPU-based phase-locking strategy for spatiotemporally homogeneous crystallization enables ambient scalable perovskite photovoltaics
High-entropy noble-metal-based nanostructures with advanced regulations for electrocatalysis 高熵贵金属基纳米结构的先进调控及其电催化应用
abstract: High-entropy noble-metal-based catalysts (HENCs) have gained considerable attention as a prominent research focus, owing to their high atomic utilization efficiency, exceptional tunability, and broad compositional space. The unique anisotropic architecture of these materials endows them with advantages such as excellent dissolution resistance, rapid electron and mass transfer, thereby providing abundant catalytic active sites on their surfaces. To achieve superior catalytic performance, precise design and regulation of their nanostructures are essential. This review focuses on the rational design of HENCs with diverse configurations, systematically summarizing classifications such as grain boundary engineering, single-atom alloys, intermetallic compounds, amorphous structures, and core@shell construction for various electrocatalytic applications. HENCs demonstrate considerable potential in diverse electrocatalytic applications owing to their anisotropic architecture, structural flexibility, and enhanced catalytic behaviors. By integrating the aforementioned advanced classifications and regulation strategies, it is possible to effectively modulate the surface electronic states and lattice strain of the HENCs materials, thereby optimizing reaction kinetics and improving long-term durability. Despite notable progress, challenges remain in areas such as scalable synthesis, in-depth mechanistic understanding, and long-term operational stability, which require further research to advance their practical applications.

title: Anion modulation induced room-temperature ferromagnetism in two-dimensional CuCrSe2 二维CuCrSe2中阴离子调制诱导的室温铁磁性
abstract: 二维铁磁材料因其在自旋电子器件中的潜在应用而备受关注. 然而, 这类材料的居里温度大多仍低于室温, 这严重限制了它们的实际应用. 本研究通过脱除阴离子并调控退火工艺, 在经处理的CuCrSe 2 纳米片中实现了室温铁磁性, 同时保留了材料原有的层状结构. CrSe 2 层中的硒空位会使相邻与非相邻铬原子产生不同磁矩, 导致铬的投影态密度发生显著偏移, 超交换耦合作用大幅增强, 进而使材料的居里温度高于室温. 因此, 本研究结果为通过定向脱除阴离子的方式制备本征室温铁磁二维材料提供了一种可行方案.

title: Bidirectional bonding interfacial engineering enables high-performance Sb2S3/HgS heterojunction photodetector for intelligent healthcare applications 双向键合界面工程构筑高性能Sb2S3/HgS异质结光电探测器及其智能医疗应用
abstract: Self-powered broadband photodetectors are pivotal for next-generation intelligent healthcare. Solution-processed mercury sulfide (HgS) is an attractive near-infrared absorber but is limited by interfacial instability, high defects, and sluggish response. Inspired by sulfur-mediated adhesion in Alhagi sparsifolia , a bioinspired interfacial engineering strategy employs an antimony sulfide (Sb 2 S 3 ) interlayer to construct a bidirectional chemical bonding network. The Sb 2 S 3 interlayer simultaneously forms Sb–O bonds with fluorine-doped tin oxide (FTO) substrates and Sb–S/Hg–S bonds with the HgS layer, thereby reinforcing interfacial adhesion, passivating coordination-unsaturated defect states, and establishing a type-II heterojunction with a strong built-in electric field. The resulting Sb 2 S 3 /HgS photodetector exhibits self-powered operation, broadband sensitivity spanning the visible to near-infrared region (642–1550 nm), an ultrafast response time of 2.47 ms, a detectivity up to 1.7 × 10 11 Jones, and retaining nearly constant photocurrent over 5000 continuous on-off switching cycles as well as prolonged air exposure. Beyond device-level performance, we demonstrate its utility in intelligent healthcare scenarios, including machine-learning-assisted liquid drug identification, binary-coded optical wireless communication, and high-fidelity photoplethysmography monitoring. This work establishes biomimetic bidirectional bonding as a generalizable paradigm for stabilizing solution-processed chalcogenide optoelectronics and accelerates the integration of self-powered broadband photodetectors into intelligent healthcare systems.

title: Adjusting light absorption of defective UiO-66 for coupling photothermal evaporation with photocatalysis 调控缺陷型UiO-66光吸收以实现光热蒸发耦合光催化应用
abstract: Solar interfacial evaporation and photocatalysis exhibit intrinsic complementarity in energy utilization pathways and reaction mechanisms. Therefore, integrating photocatalysis into interfacial evaporation systems enables a synergistic platform for efficient evaporation and pollutant removal. In this study, a strategy of defect-engineering is developed for UiO-66 by covalently anchoring five carboxyl-containing organic dyes into its framework, in which steric hindrance and ligand substitution synergistically induce abundant structural defects. This approach produces a series of defect-rich UiO-66 materials by regulating of dyes. Among, the dye-sensitized UiO-66@dye-2 system features optimal light absorption capacity and vacancy defects. On the one hand, the dyes, which act as sensitizers, broaden the light absorption range and accelerate water evaporation. On the other hand, the defect-inducing dyes introduce abundant trap sites, thereby enabling rapid charge transfer and efficient spatial charge separation. Under 1-sun irradiation, it exhibits an outstanding water evaporation rate with a high solar-to-vapor conversion efficiency of 97.8%, along with excellent photocatalytic performance, achieving 95.4% degradation of phenol pollutants. Notably, it maintains stable degradation performance across highly acidic and alkaline environments, ensuring its reliability for long-term operations in complex conditions. This work provides a molecular-level strategy for constructing defect-rich UiO-66 derivatives and offers valuable insights for designing next-generation materials for integrated photothermal-photocatalytic environmental remediation.

title: Small molecular modulation for high-performance near-infrared photodetectors: a dipole-active all-organic electron transport layer in N2200 matrix 用于高性能近红外光电探测器的小分子调控策略: N2200基体中的偶极活性全有机电子传输层
abstract: Near-infrared (NIR) organic photodetectors (OPDs), owing to their solution processability and intrinsic mechanical flexibility, hold strong promise for next-generation wearable electronics and imaging systems. However, their practical deployment remains limited by insufficient responsivity ( R ), high noise current ( i noise ), and unsatisfactory specific detectivity ( D *), which require more effective control of interfacial charge extraction and leakage suppression, particularly at the electron transport layers (ETLs). Here, we establish a design principle for an all-organic electron transport layer using a representative N2200:PBOAnp system. In this strategy, a dipole-active, insertion-compatible small-molecule dopant with mixed local-excitation/charge-transfer character is incorporated into the N2200 matrix to improve vertical transport continuity and modulate cathodic interfacial energetics while largely preserving the primary host-packing motif. As a result, OPDs based on this all-organic ETL exhibit an ultralow dark current density ( J d ) of 7.01×10 −11 A cm −2 at 0 V and a high D * of 1.16×10 14 Jones. This work establishes a competitive all-organic interfacial design concept that integrates low leakage current, high sensitivity, and improved interfacial compatibility within a solution-processable organic framework. Moreover, the optimized OPD demonstrates practical utility in photoplethysmography monitoring, and a sensing array integrated with lightweight neuromorphic signal processing is further constructed, providing a foundation for device-algorithm co-design in next-generation flexible human-machine-interactive bioelectronics.

title: High-entropy oxides for catalysis: from entropy-stabilized lattices to multi-functional reaction platforms 用于催化的高熵氧化物: 从熵稳定晶格到多功能反应平台
abstract: High-entropy oxides (HEOs), featuring multiple metal cations randomly distributed within a single solid-solution lattice, have recently emerged as a versatile platform for heterogeneous catalysis. Enabled by high configurational entropy, HEOs exhibit exceptional structural stability, pronounced lattice distortion, and diverse local electronic environments, fundamentally distinguishing them from conventional oxides. This review provides a critical overview of HEOs for catalytic applications, focusing on mechanistic origins, synthesis strategies, and representative reactions. We discuss the collective role of entropy-induced disorder, lattice distortion, sluggish diffusion, and multi-cation synergy in generating statistically distributed active sites and stabilizing reactive intermediates. Recent advances in HEO synthesis and structural engineering are summarized, highlighting routes to control phase stability, defects, and morphology. Representative applications in thermocatalysis, electrocatalysis and photocatalysis are reviewed, revealing the governing roles of entropy-enabled electronic modulation and dynamic surface reconstruction in catalytic performance. We further highlight HEOs as robust supports for single-atom catalysts to enhance catalytic activity and stability and also summarize emerging theoretical and machine-learning-driven approaches for accelerating rational design across the vast high-entropy compositional space. Overall, HEOs represent a paradigm shift in catalyst design, where controlled compositional complexity and structural disorder are harnessed to achieve robust and adaptable catalytic systems.

title: Activated water molecular dissociation enhances nitrate electrochemical reduction activity by rational design of binary CoCu-Pi catalyst 分子解离活化增强硝酸盐电还原活性的机制研究: 基于二元钴铜磷酸盐催化剂的理性设计
abstract: Electrochemical reduction nitrate reaction (NO 3 RR) to ammonia presents a promising yet challenging route for treating high-concentration wastewater and recovering nitrogen. However, its efficiency is limited by a complex reaction pathway involving multiple proton-electron transfers and stringent competition from side reactions. Herein, we developed a series of binary CoCu phosphates with precisely tailored Co/Cu ratios to investigate their synergistic catalytic effects. A volcano-shaped relationship exists between the Co/Cu ratio and the electrocatalytic activity, with Co 0.5 Cu 1.5 (OH)PO 4 exhibiting optimal performance by facilitating electron transfer and enriching active sites. In 1 M nitrate electrolyte at a high current density of 200 mA cm −2 , the Co 0.5 Cu 1.5 (OH)PO 4 achieves a remarkable Faradaic efficiency (FE) of 99.0% for ammonia, simultaneously delivering a high production rate of 9.18 mg h −1 cm −2 , while maintaining stable performance over continuous electrolysis for more than 200 h. DFT calculations attribute the superior performance to the optimized Co/Cu ratio. Specifically, the Co sites promote water dissociation to ensure a sufficient supply of active hydrogen, while the adjacent Cu sites utilize this hydrogen to drive the deoxygenation and hydrogenation steps. This effective division of labor significantly lowers the reaction energy barrier, thereby enhancing the intrinsic kinetics of the NO 3 RR process. This work demonstrates that precise regulation of dual-site functionality in transition metal phosphates provides a novel strategy to break the activity-selectivity trade-off in electrocatalytic nitrate-to-ammonia conversion.

title: Strategies for enhancing multi-properties of medium- and high-entropy soft magnetic alloys 中高熵软磁合金多性能提升策略
abstract: Traditional soft magnetic alloys have long suffered from a performance trade-off, where enhancing magnetic properties often comes at the expense of mechanical and other properties, limiting their applications in high-efficiency power industries and advanced electronic systems. The design concept of medium- and high-entropy alloys (M/HEAs) offers possibilities for breaking this trade-off. By leveraging multi-principal-element compositions and tailorable microstructures, medium- and high-entropy soft magnetic alloys (M/HE-SMAs) hold promise for integrating superior soft magnetic properties with exceptional mechanical strength-ductility synergy, high electrical resistivity, good thermal stability, and excellent corrosion resistance. This article discusses the design strategies for achieving synergistic enhancements of the multiple properties in M/HE-SMAs, aiming to provide a comprehensive and up-to-date understanding of the recent progress in the development of high-performance M/HE-SMAs. A variety of strategies, e.g., blending multiple ferromagnetic and even non-ferromagnetic elements into solid solution, triggering local chemical orders in crystalline materials, tailoring nanoprecipitates, controlling grain size, and engineering dual/multi-phase structures, are summarized and discussed. The cooperative interactions of the different strategies or mechanisms are also considered. Some potential research directions for further development and practical applications of high-performance M/HE-SMAs are proposed.

title: Advances in silicon anodes for solid-state batteries: from the particle “size effect” perspective 固态电池中硅负极的研究进展: 从颗粒“尺寸效应”的 角度
abstract: Silicon-based (Si-based) anodes have become the core candidate material for the next generation of high-energy solid-state batteries (SSBs) due to their high theoretical capacity. However, Si-based anodes are still constrained by the “size effect” in SSBs. The matching of Si-based anodes with mainstream sulfides and organic-inorganic composite solid-state electrolytes (SSEs) is the core direction of technological breakthroughs, providing a feasible path to solve the problems of ion conduction and interface impedance caused by the “size effect”. This paper adopts a technical route of mechanism analysis-classification discussion-comprehensive outlook. Firstly, we systematically discuss the main functional parameters of sulfides and organic-inorganic composite SSEs, starting from the “size effect” of Si-based materials, deeply revealing the different failure mechanisms of nano-silicon (nSi) and micro-silicon (mSi). Subsequently, a systematic classification and summary were conducted on the key processes of these two electrolytes and the improvement strategies for achieving Si matching, systematically reviewing the latest research progress and focusing on analyzing the structural and interface modification mechanisms. Finally, the core research challenges and future development prospects of Si-based SSBs are proposed, which provide theoretical support for the fabrication of high-performance Si-based SSBs via “size effect” regulation and accelerate the commercialization of high-energy Si-based SSBs.

title: Synergistic multi-metal and defect engineering for high-efficiency hydrogen evolution reaction 多金属协同结合缺陷工程实现高效析氢反应
abstract: Abstract Electrochemical water splitting is crucial for the scalable production of green hydrogen; however, the practical implementation requires cost-effective electrocatalysts with high activity and durability. This study introduces a low-cost, three-dimensional (3D) nanoporous ZrVFeCoNi material, fabricated via chemical dealloying, at just 0.16% of the cost of Pt. The structure-activity relationship between its microstructure and hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) performance was systematically explored. The lattice defect effects from multiphase intermetallic compounds, combined with multi-metal synergy, optimize H + adsorption energy and electron transfer kinetics. The 3D nanoporous design provides a high electrochemical surface area with abundant active sites, thereby enhancing electrolyte penetration and reducing interfacial mass transfer resistance. Consequently, the ZrVFe-CoNi electrode exhibits outstanding HER performance, requiring only a 38 mV overpotential to reach 10 mA cm −2 and maintaining stable operation for 1000 h at 500 mA cm −2 . Integrated into a full water electrolyzer (ZrVFeCoNi ∥ IrO 2 /Ni), the system achieves a cell voltage of 1.60 V at a current density of 400 mA cm −2 . Advanced characterization and density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that interfacial interactions and charge transfer at heterointerfaces drive the catalytic activity, showcasing the potential of 3D nano-structured multiphase intermetallic compounds as high-performance electrocatalysts for green hydrogen systems.

title: Synthesis, structure, properties and applications of high-entropy borides 高熵硼化物陶瓷制备、 结构、 性能及应用研究进展
abstract: High-entropy borides (HEBs), as an emerging branch of high-entropy materials, have become a prominent research frontier in the field of ultra-high-temperature ceramics (UHTCs). The high configuration entropy effect is used to stabilize single-phase solid solution structures, which exhibit comprehensive properties that are difficult to achieve by traditional binary borides. This review aims to systematically summarize the research progress on HEBs, first covering their theoretical predictions and component design based on first-principles methods. Then, some typical systems are described and the main preparation techniques such as arc melting and spark plasma sintering are summarized. The core of this paper is to comprehensively evaluate the outstanding performance characteristics of HEBs, which not only include their exceptional mechanical properties such as ultra-high hardness and excellent fracture toughness, but also delve into their high-temperature friction and wear behavior, as well as their oxidation resistance. Finally, based on their unique performance advantages, the application prospects in extreme working conditions such as aerospace and cutting tools are prospected, and the challenges in this field are pointed out.

title: Transformative breakthrough in strength-conductivity-thermal stability of copper foils enabled by gradient super-nano domains
Grain boundary unlocks ferroelectric phase regulation
A composite electron transport layer enables functionally self-healing and high-efficiency perovskite solar cells 复合电子传输层实现功能自修复与高效率钙钛矿太 阳能电池
abstract: Perovskite solar cells (PSCs) exhibit strong commercial potential, yet their long-term stability is limited by fragile internal interfaces—particularly within the electron transport layer (ETL), where the interface between [6,6]-phenyl-C 61 -butyric acid methyl ester (PCBM) and bathocuproine (BCP) is prone to molecular aggregation, defect formation, and microcrack development. To address this, we engineered a cross-linked conjugated polymer, PIH, featuring a perylene diimide (PDI)-based semiconducting backbone integrated with dynamic disulfide bonds and a supramolecular hydrogen-bonding network. PIH was inserted between PCBM and BCP to form a composite ETL (C-ETL). This architecture enables “functional self-healing”, autonomously restoring both mechanical integrity and charge transport properties after damage. Inverted PSCs employing the PCBM/PIH C-ETL achieve a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.04% (24.91% for flexible devices). Notably, after severe bending, flexible devices recover 98.1% of their initial PCE after only 5 min of mild thermal annealing at 50°C. Moreover, the PIH network acts as an intrinsic encapsulation barrier, markedly enhancing resistance to environmental and thermal stressors. This work presents the first demonstration of a self-healing ETL and simultaneously delivers >26% efficiency, built-in encapsulation, and near-complete performance recovery—establishing a transformative design paradigm for intelligent interfacial materials and advancing optoelectronic devices toward adaptive, self-healing systems.
