From combinatorial explosion to targeted optimization: a hybrid strategy for high-entropy catalyst discovery 从组合爆炸到定向优化: 高熵催化剂发现的混合策略
abstract: The vast compositional space of high-entropy materials presents a fundamental challenge for catalyst discovery. Considering 21 candidate elements at a 1% atomic resolution, this combinatorial explosion exceeds 10 billion (>10 10 ) possibilities, rendering direct experimental exploration impractical. Furthermore, purely data-driven approaches often struggle to comprehend the intrinsic chemical roles of discrete elemental identities, yet they excel at mapping continuous concentration gradients. Recognizing this distinction, we transform this combinatorial explosion into a targeted optimization problem by decoupling elemental selection from compositional ratio refinement. Ultrafast carbon thermal shock (CTS) is first employed to screen viable elemental combinations and establish an optimal quinary framework. Machine learning (ML) is subsequently applied to optimize compositional ratios within this reduced space, where statistical modeling efficiently navigates the remaining high-dimensional landscape. Targeting the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) as a proof-of-concept, our hybrid framework pruned the search space from over 10 10 possible compositions down into 13 systems, ultimately identifying high-entropy oxide (HEO)-Fe 17.57 Co 28.45 Ni 31.27 Mo 10.57 Zr 12.14 as the optimal catalyst. The optimized high-entropy oxide exhibits an overpotential of 240 mV at 10 mA cm −2 and sustains stable operation at 1 A cm −2 for over 600 h in 1 M KOH. Mechanistic analysis reveals that Mo electronically tunes oxygen-intermediate adsorption, while Zr enhances structural robustness, collectively enabling high activity and durability. This work demonstrates that bridging discrete physical screening with continuous data-driven optimization provides an efficient and generalizable pathway for navigating high-dimensional material frontiers.

title: Advances in metal-chelated materials for organic photovoltaics 金属螯合材料在有机光伏中的研究进展
abstract: Organic photovoltaics (OPVs) offer a promising pathway to low-cost, flexible, and lightweight solar energy conversion, yet persistent limitations in charge generation, transport, and extraction continue to constrain power conversion efficiencies and long-term stability. While metal-chelated materials have shown remarkable versatility in modulating electronic structure, interfacial energetics, and excitonic processes through coordination chemistry, their application in OPVs remains underexplored relative to dye-sensitized and perovskite systems. Most prior reviews focused on synthesis and structural diversity across multiple solar cell technologies, with only peripheral coverage of OPVs and limited mechanistic depth. This review adopts a mechanism-oriented framework that unites metal complexes and metal-organic frameworks under the concept of metal-chelated materials, systematically examining their roles across active layers, additives, and interfacial layers. We elucidate how metal incorporation enables dielectric constant modulation, exciton-vibration coupling control, triplet-state engineering, and redox-active interfacial tuning, thereby suppressing non-radiative recombination and enhancing charge extraction. Particular emphasis is placed on structure-property-performance relationships, revealing how metal identity, coordination geometry, and nanoscale organization govern optoelectronic performance and stability. By consolidating molecular- and framework-based strategies within a common coordination-chemistry perspective, this review clarifies current limitations and outlines design principles for developing scalable and stable OPV materials. Coordination-engineered systems thus represent a technical platform for advancing next-generation OPV technologies.

title: Polysaccharide-based networks-engineered orthopedic implant for synergistic antimicrobial defense and osteogenic regeneration to potentiate PI3K-AKT/HIF-1-mediated open fractures treatment 基于多糖网络工程的骨科植入物协调抗菌防御与成骨再生以增强PI3K-AKT/HIF-1介导的开放性骨折治 疗
abstract: Open fractures of the limbs pose a significant global clinical challenge due to their high infection rates, and the infection can further hinder fracture healing and lead to substantial morbidity and mortality. Therefore, it is crucial to develop orthopedic implant surfaces with both antibacterial and osteogenic properties. In this study, we develop a biomacromolecule network based on natural polysaccharides for reconciling antimicrobial defense and osteogenic regeneration. By precisely modulating the cross-linker, film-forming agent and functional components, we achieved an optimal balance between antibacterial efficacy and biocompatibility. Furthermore, using a Schiff-base reaction and a volatile film-forming technique, a functional coating (Ti-GOED) was developed on the surface of the titanium (Ti) alloy bone plates. Ti-GOED demonstrated excellent antibacterial activity (>99% killing efficacy against S. aureus and E. coli ) by effectively inhibiting peptidoglycan synthesis, disrupting bacterial cell wall and thereby compromising membrane integrity. Additionally, Ti-GOED promoted the proliferation of bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) in vitro , enhanced alkaline phosphatase activity, increased mineralized calcium deposition, and activated the HIF-1 signaling pathway to stimulate osteogenic differentiation and bone formation. In the rat tibial open fracture model, Ti-GOED effectively suppressed early-stage infections and promoted bone regeneration in vivo . This study provides a strategy for biofunctionalizing orthopedic implants, with promising clinical applications in fracture fixation and infection prevention.

title: Tuning phase stabilization through configurational entropy design in high-entropy layered oxide cathodes 通过构型熵设计调控高熵层状氧化物正极的相稳定性
abstract: P2-type Mn-based layered oxide cathode materials have attracted extensive attention owing to their advantages of low cost, high operating voltage, fast ion diffusion and favorable structural stability. However, the Jahn-Teller effect of Mn 3+ and the irreversible phase transition under high voltage (>4.2 V) severely restrict further improvement of their electrochemical performance. To address these issues, we constructed a high-entropy system composed of five elements (Ni, Mn, Co, Ti, and Li), and synthesized a series of Na 0.70 Ni 0.25 Mn 0.50− x Co 0.05 Ti 0.20 Li x O 2 (denoted as NMCTL- x ) cathode materials via Li substitution for Mn with different doping contents. The results demonstrate that the high-entropy effect effectively suppresses the detrimental phase transition and endows the material with enhanced structural stability. Meanwhile, Li substitution significantly inhibits the Jahn-Teller effect of Mn 3+ and oxygen loss at high potentials, and promotes fast Na + transport. Consequently, the NMCTL-0.05 cathode retains a capacity retention of 87.71% after 300 charge-discharge cycles at 1 C. This work verifies that the high-entropy configuration design based on Li substitution can synchronously optimize the structure and kinetics of P2-type Mn-based layered oxides, providing a new strategy for the design and development of high-performance cathode materials for sodium-ion batteries.

title: Self-photooxidation-restructuring enables NIR-II absorption of carbon dots for cancer phototherapy 自光氧化重构实现碳点在近红外二区吸收及癌症光疗
abstract: Carbon dots (CDs) with absorption in the second near-infrared window (NIR-II, 900–1700 nm) hold great promise for tumor theranostics. However, existing synthesis methods often involve complex procedures, harsh conditions, or lack precise control. Herein, we report a “self-photooxidation-restructuring” strategy that enables structural reorganization of the carbon core in CDs, achieving a significant redshift of absorption into the NIR-II region. Under the ultraviolet (UV) light irradiation, the precursor (B-CDs, absorption in UV region) generates singlet oxygen, which self-oxidizes aldehyde groups and the carbon skeleton of B-CDs to stronger electron-withdrawing carboxyl groups and carbon radicals, respectively. These processes facilitate the formation of new C=C bonds between isolated aromatic domains, thereby enabling the transformation of B-CDs into novel CDs (N-CDs) characterized by enhanced donor-acceptor interactions and a redshift in absorption toward the NIR-II window. Various experimental data, including high-resolution XPS, FTIR, NMR, and EPR, have proved the proposed formation mechanism of N-CDs. The novel N-CDs afforded a high photothermal conversion efficiency of up to 71.33%, which enabled 1064 nm laser-activated photoacoustic imaging (PAI)-guided photothermal therapy (PTT) in tumors. This work opens a new avenue for the synthesis and modulation of CDs in the NIR-II region.

title: Multi-interface engineering modulated bidirectional polysulfide conversion for advanced lithium-sulfur batteries 多界面工程调控增强锂硫电池多硫化物双向转化
abstract: Lithium-sulfur batteries (LSBs) are widely recognized as one of the core candidate systems for next-generation energy storage technologies, owing to their high theoretical specific capacity. Nevertheless, the shuttle effect of lithium polysulfides (LiPSs) persists as the paramount challenge limiting the cycle life and energy efficiency of current LSBs. Herein, we report a novel multi-interface engineering of MnO 2 -TiO 2 @Ti 3 C 2 MXene (MT@MX) heterojunction fabricated via a facile redox reaction between MXene and KMnO 4 , to modulate the bidirectional polysulfide conversion by promoting the migration and catalysis behaviors of LiPSs in LSBs. The experimental and theoretical results indicate that the 2D structure with excellent conductivity and abundant heterogeneous interfaces enables fast ion/electron transfer migration, reduces the reaction energy barrier, and enhances the binding effect dominated by the adsorption energy and d-band center. The produced stepped built-in electric field (BIEF) in MT@MX heterojunction remarkably lowers the migration energy barrier of LiPSs from the catalytic MXene terminal to TiO 2 , and then to the adsorptive MnO 2 terminal during the charging process, compared with MnO 2 @MXene, realizing the reversible migration among the multi-interfaces. The optimized heterointerfaces realize the synergistic integration of adsorption, diffusion, and catalytic conversion, endowing the battery with excellent cycling stability even at a high sulfur loading of 6.4 mg cm −2 . This work demonstrates that constructing heterojunctions provides a feasible approach to modulating BIEF and interfacial diffusion behavior, offering a new design strategy for high-performance electrocatalysts toward advanced LSBs.

title: Heating-mode-defined energy pathways govern non-contact release in shape memory polymer transfer printing 加热模式调控的能量路径主导形状记忆聚合物转移印刷中的非接触释放行为
abstract: Abstract Smart dry adhesion underpins transfer printing technologies for flexible electronics, micro light-emitting diode (LED) displays, and heterogeneous optoelectronic integration. Shape memory polymer (SMP)-enabled embedded transfer printing offers strong pickup capability and operational flexibility, where pickup is realized through controlled embedding into SMP stamps via either global or localized heating. However, these distinct heating modes often result in markedly different non-contact release reliability for planar microchips, and the mechanistic origin of this discrepancy remains insufficiently understood, limiting deterministic transfer printing. Here, we establish an experimentally and numerically resolved mechanistic framework that links pickup heating mode to strain energy pathways and non-contact release reliability in SMP-enabled embedded transfer printing. Combining systematic experiments with finite element simulations incorporating a thermo-mechanically coupled SMP constitutive model under identical laser-triggered release conditions, we reveal that localized heating induces spatially confined modulus reduction and effective strain energy accumulation near the embedded microchip, enabling efficient energy release and reliable detachment. In contrast, global heating leads to delocalized energy storage across the SMP adhesive, leaving only a limited fraction of recoverable energy available for chip release. Parameter-dependent transitions between localized and delocalized deformation regions further clarify the conditions required for effective energy confinement during pickup. The programmable transfer and assembly of LED chips into flexible display devices validate the practical applicability of the localized heating mode. Collectively, these results establish an energy-based design framework that renders non-contact release in SMP-enabled embedded transfer printing predictable and scalable, supporting reliable heterogeneous integration and industrial translation of flexible and micro-optoelectronic systems.

title: Room-temperature fabrication of bioinspired nano-reinforced flexible hollow aerogel fibers with radially oriented channels and anisotropic thermal conductivity 室温制备具有径向通道和各向异性导热性能的仿生纳米增强柔性中空气凝胶纤维
abstract: Biomimetic aerogel fibers offer significant advantages for thermal management owing to their lightweight, porous structure, and ultra-low thermal conductivity. However, their fabrication typically relies on energy-intensive methods such as freeze-drying or supercritical drying, which not only hinder scalable production but also often compromise structural uniformity and mechanical robustness. In this work, inspired by polar bear hair, we report a novel type of flexible hollow aerogel fiber featuring radially oriented channels and anisotropic thermal conductivity, fabricated at room temperature via a water-induced phase separation coaxial wet-spinning approach. Briefly, polyacrylonitrile (PAN) is used as the polymer matrix, while silicon dioxide (SiO 2 ) and boron nitride (BN) are incorporated as nano-reinforcements to enhance mechanical properties and thermal insulation. The resulting fibers exhibit a well-defined radial channel structure with continuous nanoporous inner walls. The mechanical testing shows that the addition of both nanomaterials significantly increases the elongation at break (900%–1100%) without sacrificing strength. Anisotropic thermal measurements reveal that the radially oriented channels lead to lower thermal conductivity in the perpendicular direction. The hollow structure effectively delays axial heat conduction, and the nano-reinforcements further enhance thermal insulation by up to 42%. The combination of scalable room-temperature fabrication, excellent weavability, and tunable thermal management makes these aerogel fibers promising candidates for advanced thermal-regulating textiles.

title: AlGaS3: a wide band gap ternary diamond-like infrared nonlinear optical material with high laser-induced damage threshold 具有高激光损伤阈值的宽带隙三元类金刚石红外非线性光学材料AlGaS3
abstract: Nonlinear optical crystals are the critical optical devices of all-solid-state lasers. Here, we report the rational design and synthesis of a new diamond-like (DL) compound, AlGaS 3 , assembled from two strategically selected tetrahedral units: a wide HOMO-LUMO gap [AlS 4 ] and an NLO-active [GaS 4 ]. Notably, AlGaS 3 crystallises in the noncentrosymmetric monoclinic space group Cc . It features a favourable tetrahedral stacking arrangement similar to that of β -ZnS. This compound exhibits a wide band gap (3.38 eV), a high laser-induced damage threshold (LIDT) of 6.0 × AgGaS 2 , and a phase-matchable second-harmonic generation (SHG) response of 0.5 × AgGaS 2 , achieving a desirable property balance for IR NLO candidates. Theoretical calculations show that both [AlS 4 ] and [GaS 4 ] contribute to the band gap, with [GaS 4 ] underpinning the NLO activity. Additionally, AlGaS 3 exhibits congruent melting behaviour, enabling the growth of high-quality bulk crystals via the Bridgman-Stockbarger method, a crucial step for practical applications of new materials. The results confirm AlGaS 3 as a promising IR NLO material with high tolerance to laser radiation and provide new insights into developing advanced photoelectric materials with tunable properties via partial tetrahedral substitution in the DL framework.

Interpretable machine learning integrated transformer-based TabPFN for evaluating transformation temperatures in TiNi-based, Ti-based and high entropy shape memory alloys 可解释机器学习联合TabPFN大模型评估TiNi基、 Ti基及高熵形状记忆合金的相变温度
abstract: Accurately predicting martensitic transformation temperatures is essential for the design and optimization of shape memory alloys. This study proposes an interpretable machine learning framework that integrates alloy composition and processing parameters to predict four key transformation temperatures in TiNi-based, Ti-based, and high-entropy shape memory alloys. Among various benchmarked models, the transformer-based TabPFN demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and generalization, particularly in high-dimensional and data-sparse compositional spaces. To enhance interpretability, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis was applied to quantify the contributions and interactions of input features, identifying electronegativity difference, shear modulus difference, valence electron concentration, and atomic size mismatch as dominant factors. Among the processing features, final heat treatment temperature and time were found to have the greatest influence. Based on SHAP insights, a generalized symbolic regression formula was derived, capturing nonlinear and synergistic effects with physically meaningful expressions. This unified approach combines the predictive power of TabPFN with the transparency of symbolic models, offering both accuracy and interpretability. In addition, the superior performance of TabPFN was further confirmed by designing three novel alloys, as it demonstrated the best agreement with experimental M s measurements among all evaluated models, achieving the lowest maximum error of less than 12%. The proposed framework provides practical guidance for the accelerated development of advanced SMAs across complex alloy systems.

Efficient green-solvent, additive-free and post-treatment-free organic solar cells enabled by dithiazolobenzotriazole-based polymer donors 基于二噻唑并苯并三唑聚合物给体实现绿色溶剂加工、 免添加剂的高效初铸态有机太阳能电池
abstract: Developing organic solar cells (OSCs) processable from green solvents without additives or post-treatments is essential for sustainable manufacturing, yet high power conversion efficiency (PCE) remains difficult due to limited morphology control. Herein, we develop a new electron-deficient building block, dithiazolo[4′,5′:3,4;5″,4″:5,6]benzo[1,2- d ][l,2,3]triazole (DTzBT), which fuses benzo[ d ][1, 2, 3]triazole (BTA) with thiazole to leverage S/N-mediated non-covalent interactions, enhance planarity and lower the HOMO. To isolate side-chain effects, two DTzBT-based donors, namely PTzMe-F ( N -methyl) and PTzEH-F ( N -2-ethylhexyl), have been designed and synthesized. PTzMe-F exhibits poor solubility and miscibility with L8-BO, yielding 2.64% PCE (chloroform). PTzEH-F exhibits excellent processability and favorable morphology, delivering 17.61% PCE (chloroform) and 19.17% as-cast from toluene without any additive or post-treatments. In addition, the ternary layer-by-layer device based on PTzEH-F/L8-BO:PC 71 BM achieved an impressive efficiency of 20.27%. Comprehensive characterization indicates that 2-ethylhexyl side chains afford optimal solubility while preserving strong intermolecular interactions and favorable phase separation. DTzBT mitigates BTA’s HOMO-raising tendency via electron-withdrawing thiazole fusion, reconciling aggregation tunability with energy-level control. These results show that precise backbone and side-chain co-design enables green-solvent, additive-free processing for high-performance OSCs, advancing sustainable photovoltaic manufacturing.

title: Dual-peptide-mimicking antifungal poly(2-oxazoline) micelles for treating biofilm-associated drug-resistant fungal keratitis 双肽模拟的抗真菌聚(2-口恶唑啉)胶束用于治疗生物被膜相关的耐药真菌性角膜炎
abstract: Fungal keratitis is a severe ocular infection caused by pathogenic fungi, whose treatment is further complicated by drug-resistant strains and biofilms. In this study, we designed and synthesized a series of dual-peptide mimicking poly(2-oxazoline) (C n -PArgOx 9 ) assemblies by mimicking both the cationic amphiphilic structure of host defense peptides (HDPs) and the guanidinium-rich motifs of cell-penetrating peptides (CPPs), aiming to treat biofilm-associated drug-resistant fungal keratitis. Among them, the optimal poly(2-oxazoline) C 6 -PArgOx 9 micelles exhibited potent antifungal activity in vitro , efficiently eradicating mature biofilms while showing low cytotoxicity towards mammalian cells. Moreover, C 6 -PArgOx 9 micelles can effectively permeate the cornea. In a murine keratitis model, topical application of poly(2-oxazoline) micelles significantly reduced fungal burden in corneal stroma and ameliorated tissue damage while maintaining excellent ocular biocompatibility. Collectively, the dual-peptide-mimicking poly(2-oxazoline) assemblies integrate antifungal efficacy, biofilm disruption, and corneal permeation, providing a promising topical therapeutic strategy for drug-resistant fungal keratitis.

title: Aza-pyran-type acceptors enable low-energy-loss organic solar cells via synergistic regulation of molecular ordering and energetic disorder 氮杂吡喃型受体通过协同调控分子有序性和能量无序度实现低能损有机太阳能电池
abstract: Achieving low-energy-loss organic solar cells requires precise regulation of energetic disorder and intermolecular packing, which remains challenging at the molecular design level. Here, we report an aza-pyran-type molecular design strategy that integrates a sp 3 -hybridized nitrogen-centered core with a pyran structural motif to regulate aggregation behavior, and energetic disorder in non-fullerene acceptors. Two representative acceptors, D10 and D11, are developed, both exhibiting broadened absorption and high open-circuit voltages, while D10 shows more balanced aggregation and improved long-range molecular ordering. When incorporated as guest acceptors into the PM6:L8-BO system, the optimized ternary device achieves a power conversion efficiency of 19.86% with a high V OC of 0.89 V. Detailed optoelectronic analyses reveal reduced non-radiative energy loss (Δ E 3 ≈ 0.23 eV), enhanced electroluminescence quantum efficiency (∼1.17 × 10 −4 ), and lowered energetic disorder ( E U = 25 meV) in the ternary blends. GIWAXS and charge-transport studies further demonstrate that the introduction of D10 promotes enlarged crystalline domains and more ordered π-π stacking, facilitating balanced carrier transport and suppressed recombination. This work establishes an effective molecular design paradigm that links aza-pyran molecular engineering with energy-loss management, providing new insights into the development of high-efficiency, low-energy-loss organic solar cells.

title: Heterodimensional superlattices: preparation, properties, and applications 异维超晶格: 制备、 性质与应用
abstract: Heterodimensional superlattices have garnered significant attention due to their unique electronic structures and exotic properties arising from the coupling of materials with different dimensionalities. In recent years, substantial advancements have been achieved in both innovative preparation methods and the exploration of novel physical properties. Herein, we comprehensively review the state-of-the-art fabrication strategies, distinctive properties, and diverse applications of these emerging systems. Beyond traditional epitaxial growth and chemical intercalation, we highlight transformative techniques such as rolling up van der Waals heterostructures into high-order superlattices and oxidative molecular layer deposition. These approaches enable precise engineering of interfaces, unlocking exceptional functionalities including anomalous Hall effects, chiral-induced spin selectivity, and enhanced electrocatalytic activity. Consequently, heterodimensional superlattices show immense promise for next-generation applications spanning optics, electromagnetics, spintronics, energy storage, and conversion. Finally, we offer a forward-looking perspective on remaining challenges and potential breakthroughs, aiming to guide future research toward realizing the full potential of heterodimensional engineering in practical devices.

title: Microenvironment-responsive therapeutic platforms: innovations for spinal cord injury repair
Electrocatalytic ammonia oxidation reaction: from active site regulation to industrial device systems 电催化氨氧化反应: 从活性位点调控到工业器件体系
abstract: This review comprehensively summarizes recent advances in the electrocatalytic ammonia oxidation reaction, a critical process for enabling sustainable ammonia utilization and closing the nitrogen cycle, with significant implications in energy conversion, environmental remediation, and resource recovery. Catalyst development has progressed across three main categories: noble metal systems, offering low onset potentials and high nitrogen selectivity; non-noble metal systems, particularly nickel-based catalysts, which balance performance and cost through phase engineering, multi-metal doping, and defect control; and emerging alternatives incorporating titanium, copper, manganese, and chromium. Mechanistic insights highlight the roles of reaction pathways, active site structures, and intermediate adsorption in governing activity, selectivity, and stability. Device integration within direct ammonia fuel cells, ammonia electrolyzers, and solid oxide fuel cells has demonstrated efficient ammonia-to-energy conversion. Nevertheless, challenges persist in product selectivity, long-term stability, and scalable synthesis. Future efforts should focus on mechanistic understanding, precise electronic and structural tuning, and device-oriented catalyst design to facilitate the transition from lab-scale innovation to real-world application.

title: An ionoelastomer-based bioinspired wearable electronics with tele-perception and tactile sensation for machine learning-assisted rehabilitation management 基于离子弹性体的仿生远程感知和触觉响应可穿戴电子器件用于机器学习辅助康复管理
abstract: A comprehensive assessment of a patient’s rehabilitation efficiency is essential for designing appropriate training programs for better musculoskeletal functional recovery. Existing contact-receptor-dependent rehabilitation assessment systems mostly focus on assessing the restoration of muscle function by evaluating grip strength or joint flexion angle; however, parameters reflecting neuromuscular synergistic function are always overlooked. Herein, we develop an ionoelastomer-based soft artificial electroreceptor (SAER) that integrates tele-perception and tactile sensation to track the rehabilitation process, collecting signals related to approaching speed and grip strength sequentially. The SAER uses polyurethane ionoelastomer incorporated with quasi-solid conductive salt as the electric field receptor, and is integrated on a rehabilitation-training ball after assembly to establish an untethered detection device; this enables the remote capture of hand-approaching parameters within a 9 cm range, followed by the quantification of grip strength when contacting and grasping. Furthermore, a data-driven assessment system is established by integrating machine learning, which accurately classifies rehabilitation efficiency into six levels; it supports rehabilitation evaluation and adjustment of training programs. Overall, the SAER-based rehabilitation management system establishes a paradigm that synergistically evaluates parameters corresponding to neuromuscular functional restoration and holds strong potential for home-based active rehabilitation for minimizing dependence on frequent clinical supervision.

title: Single-component MXene-based sensor array generates independent and high-dimensional characteristics for discriminating volatile organic compounds 基于单组分MXene的传感器阵列产生独立高维特征用于挥发性有机化合物的判别
abstract: 挥发性有机化合物(VOCs)的有效识别依赖于独立高维特征 (IHC)的产生, 而这些特征来源于传感材料与VOC分子之间不同的相互作用. 生物嗅觉为实现这种相互作用多样性提供了一个有益范式. 生物体仅利用少数几种基本元素(C、 H、 O、 N、 P、 S 等)组成嗅觉受体阵列, 便可获得卓越的气味辨别能力. 这种策略并非依赖元素种类的多样性, 而是通过构建结构多样的嗅觉受体, 使其与不同VOC分子产生差异化的相互作用强度. 受此原理启发, 本研究在不改变碳化钛MXene (Ti、 C、 O、 F、 H)化学组成的前提下, 通过调控其横向尺寸来调节悬挂键/基团(DBGs)的吸附行为. 该横向尺寸效应驱动策略能够在电子鼻(E-nose)中产生差异化的IHC, 并实现了对环己酮、 己醛、 己醇、 己酸、 正己烷和环己烷的概念验证性识别, 识别准确率达到86.11%. 通过石英晶体微天平(QCM)测量结合角分辨X射线光电子能谱(ARXPS)的差分光谱分析(DSA), 进一步阐明了DBG吸附行为对横向尺寸的依赖机制. 值得注意的是, 位于TM边缘的“C–Ti–F”物种可能在调控VOC吸附过程中发挥主导作用. 随着横向尺寸减小, 边缘位点所占比例增加, 从而提高了“C–Ti–F”边缘构型的密度, 并最终增强了对VOC分子的吸附能力. 密度泛函理论(DFT)模拟进一步验证了这种“尺寸-边缘-吸附”关系. 总体而言, 这种化学组成保持不变、 由横向尺寸调控的策略, 为产生差异化IHC提供了一条新途径, 并拓展了VOC识别的基础设计原则.

title: Microwave-absorbing materials with strong environmental adaptability for corrosion protection, anti-icing and thermal management 微波吸收材料在防腐、 防冰及热管理领域的环境适应性研究
abstract: As advanced equipment and electronic systems evolve toward higher stealth, enhanced reliability, and extended service life, naval vessels, aircraft, and critical electronic devices face severe operational challenges under the coupled effects of complex electromagnetic environments, marine salt-spray corrosion, and extreme temperatures. Traditional microwave-absorbing materials (MAMs) can no longer meet the required protection standards. Consequently, the development of advanced absorbing materials that combine high-efficiency electromagnetic wave absorption with excellent environmental adaptability, including corrosion protection, anti-icing, and thermal management, is of great significance. This paper provides a systematic review of research progress on three categories of absorbing materials suitable for complex environments, namely anti-corrosion absorbing materials, anti-icing absorbing materials, and thermal management absorbing materials. Firstly, the fundamental principles of electromagnetic loss and impedance matching for absorbing materials are elaborated. Secondly, focusing on these three novel categories, the synergistic mechanisms, innovative design strategies, and comprehensive performance characterization methods are discussed in detail, and representative material systems along with their properties are summarized. Finally, the current state of development in this field is assessed, and future research directions are prospected, including smart adaptive absorbing materials, multi-physics-field coupled simulation methods, and multifunctional integrated environmentally friendly absorbing materials. This review aims to provide a theoretical basis and technical support for the design, construction, and engineering development of next-generation high-performance absorbing materials for applications in aerospace, electronic equipment, and marine equipment.

title: Janus interface materials: reshaping liquid-to-vapor mass transfer through asymmetry Janus界面材料: 不对称性重塑液-气传质
abstract: Liquid-to-vapor mass transfer underpins diverse energy and environmental processes. While conventional distillation is governed by vapor-liquid equilibrium, emerging non-boiling processes, such as membrane distillation and interfacial solar evaporation, are largely dominated by material-mediated transport, in which interfacial structure and chemistry directly regulate mass-transfer behavior. Janus interface materials, featuring spatially separated hydrophilic and hydrophobic domains, offer a compelling strategy to regulate liquid-to-vapor mass transfer by introducing architectural asymmetry. This review summarizes recent advances in Janus interface materials for liquid-vapor mass transfer, highlighting key mechanisms, including the cooperative “pump-valve” effect, nanoconfinement-enhanced transport, and the mitigation of fouling and scaling. Representative applications, including membrane distillation, solar-driven evaporation, and personal thermal-moisture management, are systematically discussed. Finally, key challenges and future opportunities are outlined, particularly in advancing fundamental understanding, scalable fabrication, and practical implementation.

title: Ultrasonic vibration-assisted mechanical coating of Cr powders on 45 steel for superior corrosion resistance 超声振动辅助铬粉机械沉积于45钢表面以实现优异耐腐蚀性能
abstract: Preparing functional coatings on metallic substrates is an effective approach to anti-corrosion for metallic materials. However, conventional methods are usually time-consuming and highly dependent on heating samples, and thus there are inevitable thermal effects leading to an under-dense layer and weak bonding strength, which ultimately causes catastrophic delamination in service. In order to enhance the service reliability and preparation efficiency of coatings, there is a pressing need for an approach that can achieve coating quickly at low temperatures and with strong bonding strength. Herein, we proposed an ultrasonic vibration-assisted mechanical coating (UVAMC) technique and successfully applied it to deposit Cr powders on the 45 steel substrates near room temperature. The uniform and dense Cr coatings with controllable thicknesses (1.85, 13.4, and 23.5 µm) were fabricated within one second under a low processing stress of 31 MPa. The coating had an exceptional interfacial strength of 66.0 MPa, which was attributed to the 10–20 nm zone of interdiffusion at an atomic scale. Simultaneously, the deposited coatings exhibited a corrosion current density close to that of the 304 stainless steel in the 3.5 wt% NaCl solution, indicating excellent corrosion resistance. The compressive and tensile strengths of the deposited samples remain unchanged. In addition, we also deposited Cu, Al, and 316 stainless steel powders and designed the shape of “SZU” on 45 steel through the UVAMC technique. Our results demonstrated that the UVAMC technique is an efficient and flexible way to coat functional powders on metallic materials and enhance specific properties.

title: Self-assembled metal-amino acid coordination networks on drug nanocrystals for potent antitumor therapy via synergistic enhancement of disulfidptosis and apoptosis 基于药物纳米晶体的自组装金属-氨基酸配位网络, 通过协同增强二硫化应激性细胞死亡与凋亡实现高效抗肿瘤治疗
abstract: Developing multifunctional nanoplatforms that efficiently regulate both emerging and classical cell-death mechanisms to overcome the adaptive resistance of malignant cells toward diverse cell-death modalities remains a significant challenge. Herein, we propose a new concept for the self-assembly of zinc-cystine coordination networks on curcumin (Cur) drug nanocrystals (DNCs) to construct Cur@PDA@-GOx/Zn-Cys (CPGZC) nanoplatforms, enabling enhanced antitumor therapy through multicomponent synergistic modulation of both newly identified disulfidptosis and classical apoptosis. At the tumor site, GOx-mediated glucose depletion reduces nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADPH) levels, which can inhibit the intracellular conversion of cystine to cysteine. Combined with the exogenous cystine delivered by CPGZC NPs, rapid intracellular disulfide accumulation strongly activates disulfidptosis. Simultaneously, the reduction in NADPH levels inhibits glutathione (GSH) biosynthesis, augmenting the intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels elicited by Cur DNCs within the CPGZC nanoplatforms. Moreover, the elevated oxidative stress, in synergy with the excessive Zn 2+ introduced, aggravates mitochondrial damage, thereby further amplifying apoptosis. Consequently, the synergistic modulation of disulfidptosis and apoptosis induces a potent antitumor response, as validated by comprehensive in vitro and in vivo investigations.

title: A diatomic Cu catalyst modulated with local Cu–S coordination enables selective CO2 electroreduction to methane 局域Cu–S配位调控双原子Cu催化剂实现选择性电还 原CO2产甲烷
abstract: Electrocatalytic CO 2 reduction to methane is an effective strategy to achieve carbon neutrality and renewable energy storage. Although Cu-based catalysts exhibit significant potential for deep CO 2 electroreduction, the *CO desorption and C–C coupling often limit high CH 4 selectivity and activity. Herein, a diatomic Cu catalyst featuring local Cu–S coordination, denoted as Cu 2 @SC, has been synthesized through S-doping in HKUST-1 followed by pyrolysis. In CO 2 electroreduction reaction (CO 2 RR), the optimal Cu 2 @SC-50 catalyst achieves a CH 4 faradaic efficiency \((\text{FE}_{\text{CH}_{4}})\) up to 63.5% and a CH 4 partial current density \((j_{\text{CH}_{4}})\) of −539.6 mA cm −2 , and in the meantime presents excellent stability in both structure and catalytic performance. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, X-ray absorption spectroscopy, in situ infrared spectroscopy combined with density functional theory calculations disclose the shortening of Cu–Cu distance and the decrease of Cu oxidation state due to the partial substitution of O by S on dual Cu sites, which are found to be responsible for the bridge adsorption of *CO (*CO bridge ) and the energy barrier reduction of the rate-determining step (*CO bridge hydrogenation to *CHO) for methane production. This work provides an effective strategy for active site modulation of Cu-based electrocatalysts for CO 2 RR to produce CH 4 with high selectivity.

title: Spatial adjacency engineering of hydrophilic moieties toward fluorinated segment for enhanced 19F magnetic resonance imaging 亲水基团邻近距离调控策略增强含氟聚合物19F磁共振成像
abstract: 19 F磁共振成像( 19 F MRI)具有组织穿透深、背景干扰低等诸多显 著优势, 但含氟链段的固有疏水性及化学等效氟原子数量有限, 使 19 F MRI的信号强度调控存在困难. 本文报道了一种超亲水性含氟聚合物 (PMAF), 通过对亲水性羧基与含氟烷基之间的精确空间距离调控, 实 现性能优化. 在相同条件下, PMAF的 19 F MRI信噪比(SNR)相比对照聚 合物(PCysF)提高了8倍以上. 理论分析表明, PMAF比PCysF具有更快的 分子运动以及更高的水合能. 其较高的氟含量(20 wt%)以及单一窄峰 (半峰宽(Δ ν 1/2 )=42.9 Hz)表明其更适用于体内 19 F MRI成像, 同时表现 出良好的生物相容性和快速肾清除特性. 此外, 该体系易于连接功能基 团, 可作为一种通用平台用于多功能活体成像及诊疗.

title: Gradient conductivity boosts flexible tactile sensors to record sensitivity and linear range
A dual-window NIR-responsive high-entropy oxide nanozyme for photothermal-catalytic synergistic therapy of drug-resistant bacterial wounds 双窗口近红外响应的高熵氧化物纳米酶用于光热-催化协同治疗耐药菌感染创面
abstract: Chronic infections caused by biofilms of drug-resistant bacteria pose a significant challenge in clinical treatment. Traditional near-infrared region I (NIR-I) photothermal therapy has limitations, including restricted tissue penetration and potential damage to normal tissues due to high temperatures. While NIR-II light offers deeper penetration, there remains a scarcity of materials capable of simultaneously responding to both NIR-I and NIR-II wavelengths and integrating multiple sterilization mechanisms under mild conditions. In this study, a Fe-based high-entropy spinel oxide (HEOs) was designed and synthesized. Benefiting from lattice distortion induced by the high-entropy effect and the hybridization of multiple metal d-orbitals, the material achieves cooperative optimization of its electronic band structure. Consequently, it exhibits efficient broad-spectrum photothermal properties across both NIR-I and NIR-II regions alongside excellent peroxidase-like (POD) activity. Under dual-wavelength laser irradiation, the material enables mild yet efficient photothermal conversion (<50 °C) while simultaneously catalyzing hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ) to generate abundant hydroxyl radicals (·OH), thereby constructing a synergistic antibacterial system combining dual-window photothermal therapy and enzymatic catalysis. In vitro experiments confirmed that the HESO possesses potent bactericidal and biofilm eradication capabilities against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria. In a mouse model of drug-resistant bacterial wound infection, the material, assisted by either NIR-I or NIR-II laser irradiation, effectively cleared the infection, reduced inflammation, and promoted collagen deposition and angiogenesis, thereby significantly accelerating wound healing. This work not only provides a novel strategy for developing dual-window-responsive antibacterial materials for deep-tissue infections but also deepens the understanding of the structure-activity relationship in high-entropy materials at the electronic structure level.

title: High-pressure sintering of binderless TiCN with limited grain growth by plastic deformation as dominating mechanism 以类塑性变形为控制机制的高致密度、 晶粒有限长大、 无黏结相TiCN陶瓷材料高压烧结技术
abstract: Titanium carbonitride (TiCN) ceramics are significant in machining applications for their exceptional hardness and wear resistance. However, achieving full densification of TiCN while suppressing grain coarsening remains a challenge due to its intrinsically high melting point and low self-diffusion coefficients. In this study, binderless TiCN ceramics with a relative density of 98.4% and an average grain size of only 369 nm were successfully fabricated by using high-pressure spark plasma sintering (HPSPS) with submicron powders. The application of high pressure significantly accelerated densification through a plastic deformation mechanism while effectively inhibiting grain growth. Microstructural analysis revealed a high dislocation density 6.04×10 14 m −2 in high-pressure sintered samples, which was three times that observed in conventional low-pressure samples. Due to the synergistic effects of fine-grain strengthening and strain hardening induced by high dislocation density, the Vickers hardness reached 21.58 GPa, which was 27% higher than that in the low-pressure counterpart. Consequently, the ceramics exhibited superior tribological performance, characterized by a 14.8% lower coefficient of friction and 31.2% higher wear resistance. This study elucidated the critical role of high-pressure-induced plastic deformation in the densification of refractory ceramics and provided a novel strategy for fabricating high-performance binderless ceramics.

title: Rare earth dilute alloys unlock fast water dissociation for alkaline hydrogen evolution 稀土稀合金实现碱性析氢中的快速水解离
abstract: Ruthenium (Ru)-based alloys are promising alternatives to commercial Pt/C catalysts for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) owing to their low cost and favorable hydrogen adsorption properties. However, the sluggish water dissociation on Ru catalysts remains a major kinetic bottleneck in alkaline solutions. Herein, we report a rare earth (RE) dilute alloy strategy by incorporating a trace amount of cerium (Ce, ~1 at%) into a RuCu alloy to promote interfacial water activation. The oxophilic Ce sites strengthen H 2 O adsorption and reduce the energy barrier for water dissociation, thereby accelerating the Volmer step during alkaline hydrogen evolution. Consequently, the RuCuCe catalyst delivers 10 mA cm −2 at an overpotential of only 18 mV in 1.0 M KOH and maintains stable operation for over 100 h at 500 mA cm −2 in a membrane electrode assembly. In situ electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and pH-dependent measurements verify the facilitated Volmer process induced by Ce incorporation. Temperature-dependent analysis further shows that the apparent activation energy decreases from 47.4 kJ mol −1 for RuCu to 26.4 kJ mol −1 for RuCuCe, consistent with enhanced water dissociation kinetics. This work establishes RE dilute metal alloys as an effective platform for boosting the intrinsic activity of Ru-based alloy catalysts, in which RE incorporation promotes water dissociation while inducing charge redistribution in the alloy matrix.

title: Dynamically crosslinked liquid metal-complexing elastomer as robust solvent-free 3D printing ink for reprocessable flexible electronics 用于可再加工柔性电子器件的动态交联液态金属复合弹性体无溶剂3D打印油墨
abstract: The three-dimensional (3D) printing of thermoset liquid metal (LM)-based flexible electronics holds considerable promise for various applications. However, the high surface tension and density of LM tend to cause sedimentation during the printing process, presenting significant challenges for 3D printing. Additionally, current 3D-printed thermoset LM-based flexible composite materials are not recyclable, resulting in resource wastage. In this work, a disulfide bond-based dynamically crosslinked polyurethane (SPU) is introduced as a solvent-free ink for fabricating an elastomer-liquid metal composite (SPU-LM). The crosslinking units in the SPU-LM ink are designed as Diels-Alder (DA) adducts, which undergo reversible dissociation upon heating, transitioning into a molten state. The multifunctional disulfide bonds facilitate interactions between the LM micro-nanoparticles and the polymer network, improving the dispersion of the LM and preventing sedimentation. These disulfide bonds also enhance the mechanical properties and self-healing capability of the material. The printed SPU-LM wires exhibit excellent stretchability, mechanical durability, near-infrared light-induced self-healing, and conductivity. Notably, these wires retain their mechanical and electrical properties even after multiple printing cycles. The results demonstrate the potential for sustainable printing of LM-based flexible electronics. Furthermore, the LM can be easily recycled, contributing to sustainability in flexible electronics fabrication.

title: Vortex-mediated piezoelectric enhancement in bulk ferroelectrics
Surface engineering-guided functional design of carbon nanomaterials for precision biomedicine 表面工程驱动的碳纳米材料功能设计及其在精准生物医学中的应用
abstract: Carbon nanomaterials exhibit exceptional promise in precision biomedicine due to their tunable biocompatibility, programmable surface engineering, large specific surface area, and quantum confinement effects. However, fully realizing their potential requires precise interfacial engineering to address challenges such as aggregation, poor physiological dispersibility, and limited targeting specificity. This review systematically elaborates on surface engineering strategies, encompassing covalent functionalization, non-covalent assembly, and heteroatom doping, to further optimize and enhance the multifunctionality, biocompatibility, and targeting capabilities of carbon nanomaterials at the nano-bio interface. We further explore how engineered interfaces enable advanced applications across biosensing, stimuli-responsive drug delivery, multimodal bioimaging, antibacterial therapy, and regenerative tissue engineering. Finally, we discuss the challenges and future development directions, aiming to provide references for relevant research and inspire innovative studies to expedite the clinical application of surface-engineered carbon nanomaterials.

title: Amino acid intercalated iron-rich NiFe-LDHs with low-spin Fe3+ for oxygen evolution reaction electrocatalysis 氨基酸插层诱导低自旋Fe3+的富铁NiFe-LDHs作为析 氧反应电催化剂
abstract: Regulating the spin state of active metal centers is crucial for enhancing the kinetics of the oxygen evolution reaction (OER). Here, we report an anion intercalation strategy based on L-tryptophan (L-Trp) and 2-methylimidazole to engineer the spin configuration of Fe 3+ in NiFe-layered double hydroxides (NiFe-LDHs) with a high Fe content of 74%. The hydrophobic indole groups create a confined interlayer microenvironment that modulates the hydration shell of the metal ions, thereby prompting L-Trp to expand the interlayer spacing and induce local lattice disorder. Magnetic measurements, low temperature electron paramagnetic resonance, and X-ray absorption spectroscopy demonstrate that ferromagnetic high-spin Fe 3+ in pristine NiFe-LDHs is partially transformed into paramagnetic low-spin Fe 3+ . Density functional theory calculations reveal that L-Trp intercalation induces low-spin Fe 3+ , narrows the band gap, and reduces the work function. The synthesized d -50NiFe-LDH catalyst exhibits outstanding OER performance in alkaline media, delivering low overpotentials of 246 and 282 mV at current densities of 10 and 100 mA cm −2 , respectively, together with a low Tafel slope of 36 mV dec −1 and excellent stability. This work establishes amino acid intercalation as a powerful approach for spin state engineering and provides a new dimension for the design of high performance spintronic electrocatalysts.

title: Design strategies and research advances in 3D-printed organic room-temperature phosphorescent materials 3D打印有机室温磷光材料的设计策略与研究进展
abstract: Organic room-temperature phosphorescence (RTP) materials exhibit large Stokes shifts, high signal-to-noise ratios, and prolonged emission lifetimes, thereby demonstrating substantial application potential in advanced anti-counterfeiting, bioimaging, sensing, and display technologies. Although considerable progress has been made in the development of RTP materials based on free radicals, crystal engineering, host-guest doping systems, polymer matrix confinement, and supramolecular assembly, explorations integrating RTP materials with three-dimensional (3D) printing technology remain scarce. This emerging frontier opens up a novel avenue for the development of organic RTP materials, enabling the rapid, precise, and customizable fabrication of complex 3D architectures. Moreover, the 3D printing process is capable of constructing a rigid microenvironment that effectively suppresses non-radiative transitions and stabilizes triplet excitons, thereby significantly prolonging the phosphorescence lifetime. This paper systematically reviews the design strategies and research advances in 3D-printed organic RTP materials. The luminescence mechanisms and regulation strategies of organic RTP materials are elaborated, and mainstream 3D printing methods including vat photopolymerization and extrusion-based printing are introduced. The application progress in information encryption and anti-counterfeiting, sensor detection, dynamic display, and other fields is highlighted. Furthermore, the existing technical bottlenecks in material systems, structure-property relationships and processing stability are analyzed, and future development trends are prospected. This review aims to offer theoretical references and research ideas for the further development of 3D-printed organic RTP materials.

title: Na+-assisted 2D melt growth of ferroelectric cyclic-spacer hybrid perovskite thin layers Na+辅助二维熔融生长铁电环状间隔阳离子杂化钙钛矿薄层
abstract: 二维有机-无机杂化钙钛矿因结构可调及优异的光电、 介电与铁电性能, 在低维半导体与功能器件领域具有重要应用潜力. 然而, 采用环状有机间隔阳离子的二维钙钛矿层间作用力强、 结构致密, 传统机械剥离难以获得厚度均一、 面积可控的高质量薄层. 本文以铁电环状钙钛矿(CHA) 2 PbBr 4 为对象, 提出Na + 辅助二维熔融生长策略, 在SiO 2 /Si衬底上实现薄膜的可控制备. 通过构建Na x PbBr y 无机籽晶层, 在有机前驱体蒸气作用下形成稳定熔融相, 促使液态钙钛矿二维铺展并经可控冷却重结晶为连续微米级单晶薄层. 结构与铁电表征表明薄膜具有高结晶性及稳定、 可电调控的极化行为. 该工作为低维铁电钙钛矿薄膜的规模化制备与硅基集成应用提供了新路径.

title: A microenvironment-adaptive hydrogel enabled by an MXene-based coordination nanoreactor drives immune-osteogenic cascade for infected bone defects regeneration 整合MXene基配位纳米反应器的微环境自适应水凝胶驱动感染性骨缺损的免疫-成骨级联再生
abstract: The treatment of infected bone defects remains a major clinical challenge, requiring sequential and dynamic management of infection, inflammation, and regeneration. Here, a microenvironment-responsive hydrogel system is developed that integrates pH sensitivity with external near-infrared (NIR) regulation to enable cascade-amplified immunomodulation and osteogenic support. The hydrogel is constructed by incorporating preassembled Mg 2+ /epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) coordination networks on Ti 3 C 2 T x MXene nanosheets into a silk fibroin matrix, forming an integrated nanoplatform with programmable therapeutic behavior. By leveraging inflammation-associated pH changes in infected bone defects, this system exhibits microenvironment-adaptive release, enabling stage-matched therapeutic action, while NIR irradiation provides precise, on-demand modulation of treatment intensity. Under inflammatory conditions, the hydrogel orchestrates dual-node immunoregulation by suppressing the TLR2/MYD88/NF-κB inflammatory axis and concurrently inhibiting STAT1 activation via EGCG-STAT1 interaction, thereby reprogramming macrophages toward an anti-inflammatory phenotype. This cascade-amplified immunoregulatory response, together with Mg 2+ -associated osteogenic activation, ultimately facilitates effective bone regeneration at the defect sites. Overall, this study demonstrates that integrating MXene-based coordination chemistry with microenvironment sensing and externally tunable regulation enables the coordination of stage-matched immunomodulation and subsequent osteogenic activation, providing a materials-driven strategy for the treatment of complex infected bone defects.

title: Construction of fully octahedral-coordinated Co3O4 for efficient acidic water electrolysis
Bioinspired temperature-responsive anisotropic cilia surface for flexible manipulation of underwater bubbles 基于温度响应的各向异性仿生纤毛表面实现水下气泡的灵活操控
abstract: Underwater bubble manipulation has gradually drawn worldwide attention to the tremendous academic and industrial fields such as water electrolysis, heat transfer, and mineral flotation. To accurately manipulate the motion of the underwater bubble, buoyancy or Laplace gradient forces arising from the surface geometry are widely applied by employing asymmetric surface. However, these strategies suffer from limited manipulation flexibility and restrains the applicability to many fields. Herein, a temperature-responsive anisotropic cilia surface (TRAS) is introduced to achieve bidirectional long-range bubble transport. Relying on the temperature-responsive property of the TRAS, elastic modulus and stiffness of the TRAS surface can be flexibly regulated. This unique characteristic of TRAS enables the bidirectional transport of underwater bubbles by modulating the asymmetric three-phase contact line and viscous resistance. The temperature-responsive strategy presents promising applications in heat transfer, electrochemistry, and so on.

title: Beyond planarity : engineering molecular packing for high-performance organic solar cells

Boosting the operational stability of near-infrared perovskite LEDs utilizing a zinc ion-chelated hybrid electron-transport layer: the critical role of interfacial reactions 利用锌离子螯合的杂化电子传输层提升近红外钙钛 矿发光二极管的工作稳定性: 界面反应的关键作用
abstract: Near-infrared perovskite light-emitting diodes (NIR-PeLEDs) with high efficiency and superior radiance are promising in biosensing, phototherapy, and optical communication applications. Currently, high-performance NIR-PeLEDs are typically fabricated on electron-transport layers (ETLs) processed from zinc-oxide (ZnO) colloidal nanocrystals (NCs), a device architecture in which persistent chemical reactions at the buried interface pose an intrinsic threat to their long-term operational stability. In this work, we developed an alternative zinc ion-chelated hybrid ETL with well-modulated surface properties for efficient NIR-PeLEDs with superior operational stability. The hybrid ETL derived from Zn 2+ -chelated ethoxylated polyethylenimine (PEIE) partially inherited chemical features of ZnO but possessed significantly reduced defects and surface-adsorbed hydroxyl groups compared with conventional ZnO-NCs. The desired surface properties promote perovskite crystallization but markedly suppress the deprotonation of organic cations after film formation, significantly mitigating degradations of perovskite emitters and the buried electron-transport interfaces. We demonstrated NIR-PeLEDs with a peak external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 20.1% and an exceptional half-lifetime of 270.7 h at 100 mA cm −2 , which represents a more than fivefold improvement over devices using conventional ZnO-NCs. Our results present a facile yet effective ETL strategy for high-performance NIR-PeLEDs, underscoring the critical role of delicate engineering of the buried interface in stabilizing perovskite optoelectronic devices.

title: Nanoparticle-reinforced self-assembled molecular interfaces enable mechanically robust flexible organic solar cells 纳米粒子增强自组装分子界面实现高机械稳定性的 柔性有机太阳能电池
abstract: Self-assembled molecular interlayers have emerged as promising hole-selective contacts for high-efficiency organic solar cells (OSCs) due to their well-defined energy alignment and minimal parasitic absorption. However, the intrinsically limited mechanical robustness of ultrathin molecular layers often leads to structural degradation and performance loss under mechanical deformation, restricting their application in flexible devices. Here, we report a nanoparticle-reinforced self-assembled composite interface that simultaneously enhances mechanical reliability and optoelectronic performance. Uniformly dispersed SiO 2 nanoparticles are introduced as high-modulus reinforcing building blocks without disturbing molecular self-assembly. In contrast to NiO x nanoparticles, which suffer from aggregation and parasitic absorption, SiO 2 nanoparticles exhibit excellent dispersion and optical transparency, enabling the formation of a structurally compatible hybrid interface. Mechanistic studies reveal that SiO 2 nanoparticles redistribute interfacial stress and form dynamic hydrogen-bond networks with phosphonic acid groups of [2-(9 H -carbazol-9-yl)ethyl]phosphonic acid (2PACz), providing efficient energy dissipation during cyclic deformation. Meanwhile, modulation of interfacial polarity extends the crystallization time window of the active layer, resulting in enhanced molecular ordering and improved charge transport. As a result, devices based on the SiO 2 /2PACz composite interface achieve a power conversion efficiency of 20.14% for rigid devices and 19.30% for flexible devices, placing the flexible devices among the highest-performing flexible OSCs reported to date, while retaining over 90% of their initial efficiency after repeated bending cycles. This work establishes a general strategy for overcoming the trade-off between electronic selectivity and mechanical robustness in ultrathin self-assembled molecular interfaces, providing design insights for high-performance flexible organic optoelectronics.

title: Recent advancements and outlook of electrocoagulation for wastewater treatment 电絮凝废水处理的研究进展与展望
abstract: Electrocoagulation (EC) is a water treatment technology that employs soluble metal electrodes to release metal ions under an applied electric field. These ions undergo hydrolysis, forming metal hydroxide flocs that adsorb and remove pollutants from water. In recent years, amid increasingly stringent environmental regulations, research on EC has advanced in applications involving dyeing wastewater, oily wastewater, heavy metal wastewater, and high-concentration organic wastewater. Provide a comprehensive overview of the current status of EC technology, improve treatment efficiency, and promote new research in these areas. This review summarizes its application in pollutant degradation and precious metal recovery, as well as the advantages and limitations of the technology. Additionally, the influence of various operational parameters on the EC process is discussed, including electrode material and configuration, current density, solution pH, conductivity, electrode spacing, electrolyte type and concentration, reaction time, and pollutant concentration and type. The disinfection performance of EC is also evaluated, along with its treatment efficiency for specific waste streams such as car wash wastewater, textile industry effluents, pulp and paper industry discharges, oily wastewater, brewery effluents, surfactants, humic acids, and heavy metals. This review aims to provide a systematic theoretical reference for the in-depth research and engineering application of electrocoagulation technology, promoting the development of this field towards greater efficiency and sustainability.

title: Scale-up fabrication of metal-organic framework membranes toward olefin/paraffin separation
Dimensionally programmable COFs via reversible coordination-directed clip-off strategy and their application in uranium extraction
Failure mechanism of NNFMO//HC sodium-ion pouch cells under mechanical-electrochemical service conditions NNFMO//HC软包电池力-电服役工况下的失效机理
abstract: Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) hold great promise for grid-scale storage and low-speed electric vehicles. However, their electrochemical behavior is governed by intricate mechanical-electrochemical coupling effects, rendering their failure mechanisms not yet fully understood. Herein, we develop an in-situ pressure-electrochemical monitoring system and reveal the failure mechanism of commercial Ah-level NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 //hard carbon (NNFMO//HC) sodium-ion pouch cells using this platform. Under an initial external pressure of 500 kPa, the full cell retains 90.07% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. Operating at the optimal pressure of 500 kPa effectively avoids heterogeneous sodium deposition in HC anodes, suppresses gas evolution from electrolyte decomposition, and prevents irreversible phase transitions in NNFMO cathodes during long-term cycling, thereby mitigating capacity degradation.

title: Achieving efficient and stable near-infrared perovskite quantum dot light-emitting diodes by synergistic nanosurface reconstruction and device engineering 纳米表面重构与器件工程协同实现高效稳定的近红 外钙钛矿量子点发光二极管
abstract: Near-infrared perovskite quantum dot light-emitting diodes (NIR-PeLEDs) hold promising potential for applications in biological imaging, optical communications, and interactive displays. In particular, FAPbI 3 perovskite quantum dots (QDs) are highly suitable for achieving emission wavelengths beyond 750 nm. However, the soft lattice surfaces with high defect density and inefficient charge recombination exacerbate exciton quenching, rendering the realization of efficient and stable NIR-PeLEDs a persistent challenge. In this work, we employed the small molecule tetrafluoroborate guanidine (GABF 4 ) to reconstruct the QDs nanosurface. Multidentate GABF 4 effectively passivates the QDs soft surface, enhancing carrier transport and recombination and thereby boosting radiative efficiency. Consequently, the external quantum efficiency (EQE) of the NIR-PeLEDs increased from 7.66% to 17.59%. Furthermore, a cuprous thiocyanate (CuSCN) layer was introduced to buffer hole transport, which balanced charge injection and extended the device’s half-lifetime ( T 50 ) by 11-fold. The optimized NIR-PeLEDs achieved a high radiance of 30 W sr −1 m −2 at 774 nm and a peak EQE of 24.1%, representing one of the most efficient performances reported in this field to date. The fabricated large-area device (2.25 cm 2 ) exhibits uniform and bright electroluminescence. This synergistic strategy provides a new perspective for developing efficient and stable NIR-PeLEDs, thereby advancing their practical applications.

title: Integrated visual sensing and computing via symmetry-reconfigurable photodiodes
Mechanically customizable polymers for ionic skins 用于离子皮肤的机械可调聚合物
abstract: To reliably acquire high-fidelity motion monitoring signals, strain-sensitive ionic skins require robust mechanical adaptability and compliance with human body joints. However, current ionic skins demonstrate limited conformability and durability in accommodating the mechanical variations of different body joints. Herein, we achieve the mechanical customization of ionic skins through thermal post-treatment-controlled hydrogen bond network evolution. This is enabled by a polymer composite composed of poly (ethylene glycol) (PEG) and a fluorinated acrylate copolymer (PTFAA). Along with the thermally triggered transition from weak to strong hydrogen bond types, the mechanical strength and Young’s modulus of the PEG-PTFAA composites increase by 3.2–8.2 and 4.7–11.7 times, respectively. We also show that incorporating lithium bis(trifluoromethane)sulfonimide (LiTFSI) into polymer networks enables mechanically customizable and conductive PEG-PTFAA-LiTFSI ionic skins. Through a simple heat treatment, the mechanical properties of PEG-PTFAA-LiTFSI can be customized, with mechanical strength linearly growing from 1.6 to 7.0 MPa, and Young’s modulus linearly growing from 66.2 to 308.1 kPa, while maintaining high ductility and stable sensing performance. This approach allows ionic skins to flexibly adapt to the mechanical characteristics of different human body joints, offering a new pathway for customizing the on-skin motion monitoring sensors.

title: Electronic structure tailoring of COFs photocatalysts via triazine moieties for efficient H2O2 generation and water decontamination 基于三嗪基团空间工程调控COFs电子结构以促进光催化产H2O2及水净化
abstract: Developing efficient photocatalysts for hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ) synthesis is vital for sustainable chemistry, yet optimizing the electronic structure of triazine-based covalent organic frameworks (COFs) through precise spatial engineering remains a challenge. In this work, we constructed four model COFs to systematically decode how the spatial arrangement and incorporation level of triazine moieties regulate the electronic structures and H 2 O 2 production efficiency. Combined experimental and theoretical analyses revealed that FB-AT achieved an optimal donor-acceptor architecture via rational spatial arrangement of triazine and benzene moieties. This configuration established an intramolecular potential gradient, which not only promoted charge separation by suppressing the exciton binding energy but also enriched the electron density at triazine sites. These electron-rich active centers significantly facilitated the oxygen reduction reaction by lowering the thermodynamic energy barrier for *OOH intermediate formation. Consequently, FB-AT exhibited a remarkable H 2 O 2 production rate of 11055 µmol g −1 h −1 in pure water, along with a superior solar-to-chemical conversion efficiency of 1.16%. Additionally, FB-AT enabled complete degradation of phenol, tetracycline, and rhodamine B within 5–15 min of visible light irradiation. This work provides crucial guidance for the molecular-level design of high-performance COF photocatalysts.

title: Breaking the bottleneck in flexible AI computing: a high-performance digital compute-in-memory chip
Single-polymer materials with high refractive index contrast for one-step fabrication of optical waveguides 具有高折射率对比度的单聚合物材料用于一步法制作光波导
abstract: Optical waveguides employ the principle of total internal reflection to transmit signals via photons, offering benefits such as high transmission speed, low loss, and robust anti-interference capabilities. Polymer waveguides facilitate the miniaturization and integration of complex optical circuits due to their flexible chemical synthesis and simple processing compared to inorganic counterparts. Nevertheless, the refractive index ( n ) tunability of most existing single-polymer optical waveguide materials is limited (Δ n < 0.03), often requiring the combination of multiple polymers with different n values and the use of multi-step development processes to fabricate waveguide structures that meet specific requirements. In this study, a cinnamic acid-functionalized single-polymer waveguide material is introduced, which exhibits a broadly tunable n (Δ n ∼ 0.07) and allows for one-step fabrication of optical waveguide structures. By synergistically increasing molecular chain packing density and polarizability through ultraviolet (UV) induction, the polymer achieves a significant n increase while maintaining nearly 100% transmittance in the optical communication window. The resulting optical waveguide exhibits low propagation loss of 0.56 dB cm −1 at 1310 nm, outperforming most reported polymer materials (0.8–2.0 dB cm −1 ). Furthermore, the reversible erasability of the polymer enables reconfigurable optical paths. This study provides a novel material platform for next-generation low-cost, customizable integrated photonics.

title: Anisotropic strain tuning of near-infrared exciton emission in phosphorene 各向异性应变可调少层黑磷近红外激子光发射
abstract: Strain engineering serves as a powerful tool for dynamically modulating the electronic and optoelectronic properties of two-dimensional (2D) materials. While extensive research has focused on strain-tunable excitonic emission in isotropic 2D semiconductors, primarily transition metal dichalcogenides in the visible range, the anisotropic strain response of excitons in low-symmetry systems remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the anisotropic excitonic behavior of few-layer phosphorene under uniaxial strain applied along its crystallographic armchair (AC) and zigzag (ZZ) directions. We achieve continuous photoluminescence (PL) tuning across a broad spectral range from 950 to 1600 nm by applying tensile and compressive strain to bilayer and trilayer phosphorene, fully spanning key telecommunication bands. Remarkably, strain applied along the AC direction induces significantly larger emission shifts than strain along the ZZ direction, demonstrating strong directional dependence in exciton modulation. Tight-binding model analysis reveals that different out-of-plane Poisson’s ratios across crystallographic directions contribute to the distinct anisotropic mechanical response. The experimental findings are further consistently supported by density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Moreover, phosphorene retains robust polarization characteristics with no degradation in emission polarization under applied strain. This work offers fundamental insights into anisotropic strain engineering in low-symmetry 2D semiconductors and provides practical guidance for developing tunable near-infrared light-emitting devices.

title: Lewis acid and hydroxyl enabled PEO electrolytes for solid-state lithium metal batteries Lewis酸与羟基协同调控PEO基聚合物电解质用于高性能固态锂金属电池
abstract: 聚氧化乙烯(PEO)基聚合物电解质因其良好的柔韧性和安全性, 在固态锂金属电池中受到广泛关注, 但其本征离子电导率低、 锂离子迁移数小, 限制了其实际应用. 本文通过在PEO中引入单斜相沸石咪唑酯骨架-8 (ZIF-8)与SiO 2 进行改性, 构筑了一种新型PEO基复合聚合物电解质(PZS). 其中, 高长径比M-ZIF-8纳米片提供丰富的表面Lewis酸性位点与双(三氟甲磺酰)亚胺阴离子(TFSI − )配位, 促进锂盐解离并释放更多自由Li + ; SiO 2 表面的羟基则作为额外的Li + 结合位点, 构建连续的锂离子传输通道以降低界面传输阻抗. 研究结果表明, 优化后的PZS电解质离子电导率提高至原来的4倍, 电化学稳定窗口拓宽至5.2 V, 锂离子迁移数提升约3倍. 基于该电解质的Li∥Li对称电池可稳定循环超过1200 h, LiFePO 4 ∥PZS∥Li全电池在0.5 C下循环400次后容量保持率达80%. 本研究将为高性能PEO基复合聚合物电解质用于固态锂金属电池的设计与合成提供有效策略.

title: Boosting mechanoluminescence of sphalerite ZnS:Mn2+ via rational heterojunction design for surface roughness detection 合理的异质结设计增强闪锌矿ZnS:Mn2+力致发光及其在表面粗糙度检测中的应用
abstract: As the earliest reported self-recoverable elastic mechanoluminescent (ML) system, ZnS:Mn 2+ represents a key material with broad applications in self-powered sensing, flexible electronics, and optoelectronic devices. However, its efficient ML typically relies on the high-temperature wurtzite (wt-ZnS) phase, whereas the thermodynamically stable sphalerite (sp-ZnS) phase remains largely inactive due to its high structural symmetry. Here, we propose a rational heterojunction design to boost the ML potential of sp-ZnS:Mn 2+ by introducing structurally compatible cubic MgO. The constructed sp-ZnS/MgO:Mn 2+ heterojunction forms a semi-coherent interface that induces local coordination distortion of Mn 2+ ions, effectively relaxing symmetry constraints and markedly enhancing both ML and photoluminescence to a level comparable with conventional wt-ZnS:Mn 2+ . Comparative studies with wt-ZnS/MgO:Mn 2+ reveal that the semi-coherent interface in sp-ZnS/MgO fundamentally differs from the incoherent wt-ZnS/MgO interface in defect distribution and energy transfer pathways, thereby governing distinct luminescence behaviors. Furthermore, by extending interface engineering from internal heterostructures to external contact interfaces, we demonstrate that ML intensity is highly sensitive to surface roughness, enabling visual detection of microscopic frictional features. This work provides a rational strategy for developing high-performance ML materials and establishes a new route toward surface roughness sensing using ML materials.

title: Surface/triplet-state-engineered carbon nanodots for efficient inactivation of Gram-negative bacteria 表面/三重态工程碳纳米点用于高效灭活革兰氏阴性菌
abstract: Photodynamic therapy serves as a promising strategy for combating drug-resistant bacteria. However, the impermeability of Gram-negative bacterial outer membranes compared with that of Gram-positive bacteria limits the efficacy of most photosensitizers in combating Gram-negative bacteria. Here, we demonstrate surface/triplet-state-engineered carbon nanodots (T-CNDs) as efficient photosensitizers against Gram-negative bacteria, featuring enhanced reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation ability and elevated bacterial affinity. The incorporation of abundant nitrogen atoms into the T-CNDs through a branching polyethyleneimine (PEI) strategy provides lone pair electrons to the valence band, which facilitates intersystem crossing and significantly increases the population of triplet state electrons. Furthermore, the dissipation of triplet state electrons due to molecular vibrations is minimized by the formed PEI matrix around the T-CNDs. Thus, the ability of the T-CNDs to generate 1 O 2 is enhanced by 160% compared to the original CNDs, and total ROS production in water is 530% greater than that of methylene blue. Additionally, the T-CNDs undergo a charge reversal, with their surface charge changing from −28 to +31 mV, facilitating electrostatic interaction with Gram-negative bacteria. As a result, under light irradiation, T-CNDs synergistically combine electrostatic interactions and enhanced ROS generation, achieving a bactericidal efficiency of up to 99.99% against Gram-negative bacteria and demonstrating promising potential for the treatment of Gram-negative bacterial infections.

title: Unveiling space-charge-regulated etching in MAB ceramics: a novel vacuum molten salt strategy for Mo2AlB2 揭示MAB陶瓷中空间电荷调控的刻蚀机制: 一种用于制备Mo2AlB2的新型真空熔盐策略
abstract: The development of two-dimensional boride materials has been restricted by the lack of reliable etching strategies and unclear reaction pathways. To date, conventional methods often lead to unstable or impure products, limiting both fundamental studies and practical applications. Here, we introduce a new generalised vacuum molten salt approach that enables controlled synthesis of a layered Mo 2 AlB 2 material with uniform honeycomb morphology. By combining advanced microscopy with first-principles charge density analysis, we identify a correlation between local spatial charge redistribution and selective Al removal, suggesting that the local electronic environment may influence the etching behaviour of MoAlB. This new mechanistic insight provides a route to transform etching of these important materials from a trial-and-error process into a designable strategy, opening the door to systematic synthesis of previously inaccessible 2D materials. The resulting Mo 2 AlB 2 shows exceptional microwave absorption performance, achieving a minimum reflection loss of −57.68 dB at a thickness of only 1.5 mm. Our findings establish a new framework that unites synthesis methodology with atomic-scale mechanisms, paving the way for rational development of next-generation functional ceramics.

title: Polymer-templated molecular ordering of hole transport layers enables high efficiency and stable organic photovoltaics 聚合物引导空穴传输层分子有序化实现高效稳定的有机光伏器件
abstract: Carbazole phosphonic acid-based self-assembled molecules (SAMs) have emerged as highly effective hole-selective contacts in organic solar cells (OSCs). However, their molecular packing and aggregation behavior critically govern hole transport and long-term device durability, yet remain difficult to control during solution processing. Herein, we introduce a polymer-templated self-assembly strategy to regulate molecules organization through the fabrication of hybrid hole transport layers (HTLs) via one-step spin-coating the (2-(9H-carbazol-9-yl)ethyl)phosphonic acid (2PACz)/PEDOT:PSS blend solution. The polycationic PEDOT + framework serves as a template that provides supplementary anchoring interactions that promote ordered molecular arrangement while suppressing unfavorable agglomeration. A pronounced face-on orientation and enhanced structural coherence of 2PACz within the polymer matrix have been evidenced. This templated ordering improves vertical charge transport, interfacial homogeneity, and film morphology. When incorporated into binary OSCs based on PM6:BTP-eC9, the hybrid HTLs enable a champion PCE of 20.26% (comprising an open-circuit voltage ( V OC ) of 0.874 V, a short-circuit current ( J SC ) of 28.97 mA cm −2 , and a fill factor (FF) of 80.02%). Furthermore, benefiting from the PEDOT:PSS polymer template, the device based on hybrid HTLs demonstrated exceptional operational stability, retaining over 90% of initial PCE ( T 90 ) after 405 h of continuous operation at the maximum power point (MPP). This work establishes polymer-directed SAM assembly as an effective route to simultaneously optimize nanoscale molecular packing, interfacial energetics, and long-term device stability, offering a scalable strategy for high-performance OSCs.

title: Fluorooxoborate crystal NH4B4O6F: a high-performance candidate for practical vacuum ultraviolet nonlinear optics
Reconfigurable radio-frequency microchips enabled by two-dimensional memristive switches
Editorial: special topic on high-entropy materials
Reframing interfacial solar desalination: a closed-loop paradigm for circular agriculture
Bandgap-engineered ε-Ga2O3 with enhanced ultraviolet absorption for high-efficiency and photostable perovskite solar cells 带隙工程调控ε-Ga2O3用于增强紫外吸收并实现高效光稳定的钙钛矿太阳能电池
abstract: Abstract Ultraviolet-induced degradation remains a critical obstacle to the long-term stability of perovskite solar cells (PSCs). Current protection strategies mainly rely on inter-facial modification or internal ultraviolet-absorbing layers, which may introduce processing complexity and optical loss. This study reports vanadium-doped ε-gallium oxide (ε-Ga 2 O 3 : V) epitaxial films grown on sapphire by low-pressure mist chemical vapor deposition (mist-CVD) for use as ultraviolet-protective encapsulation layers for PSCs. V incorporation regulates the band-edge electronic structure of ε-Ga 2 O 3 while preserving its crystal structure, crystallinity, and large-area uniformity. The optical bandgap narrows from 4.56 to 4.40 eV, deep-ultraviolet absorption is enhanced, and the attenuation window extends from the intrinsic ultraviolet C region into the ultraviolet B and part of the ultraviolet A region while maintaining low visible-light loss. First-principles calculations indicate that V preferentially substitutes at the Ga II site and reconstructs the near-band-edge electronic structure through hybridized V 3d and O 2p states, accounting for the red-shifted absorption edge. With ε-Ga 2 O 3 :V-coated sapphire as the encapsulation layer, PSCs sustain a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 20.14% after 1000 h of continuous 254 nm ultraviolet irradiation, extending the ultraviolet operational lifetime by more than fourfold relative to bare-sapphire-encapsulated PSCs. This work establishes a band-edge-engineering route for transparent oxide encapsulation and ultraviolet-protective spectral management in perovskite photovoltaics.

title: Intrinsically crosslinked self-assembled long-lived polymeric room-temperature phosphorescent microspheres 本征交联自组装的长寿命室温磷光聚合物微球
abstract: Room-temperature phosphorescence (RTP) polymer materials have attracted significant attention due to their unique tunability and ease of processing, offering broad potential for applications in flexible electronics and information encryption. However, thermally responsive RTP materials have shown promise in temperature sensing and thermal imaging, polymeric RTP systems that simultaneously combine high thermal sensitivity, reversible multicolor emission, and long phosphorescence lifetime ( τ Phos ) with high quantum yield ( Φ Phos ) remain extremely rare.
