Herein, we report an in-situ cross-linked self-assembly strategy that converts flexible polymers into rigid polymer microspheres, achieving long τ Phos , high Φ Phos , and both thermally and time-dependent tunable RTP. The resulting RTP microspheres (PM 0.1–0.01–1 ) exhibit a maximum τ Phos of 1754 ms and Φ Phos of 42.83%, markedly superior to previously reported intrinsic polymer RTP materials. Remarkably, at 77 K, these microspheres display ultralong green emission with a lifetime of 6019 ms and visible afterglow lasting up to 99 s. Moreover, the cross-linked microspheres enable time-dependent, continuously tunable RTP and thermally responsive color switching, while maintaining excellent phosphorescence stability in aqueous and high-temperature environments, providing a versatile platform for dynamic information encryption, full-color afterglow LEDs, and temperature sensing. This strategy establishes a general design principle for developing multidimensional, controllable, and stable high-performance polymer RTP materials.

title: Designer entropy enables negative and zero thermal expansion beyond 1000 K 通过熵设计策略实现1000 K以上的负热膨胀和零热膨胀
abstract: Negative thermal expansion (NTE) materials offer valuable opportunities to understand the fundamental physics of thermal expansion and to enable engineering applications in inorganic functional materials. However, their practical use is often constrained by a limited operating temperature window. In this work, we propose an entropy-designing strategy to regulate the operating temperature windows of NTE and zero thermal expansion (ZTE) beyond 1000 K in K 0.4 (Mg 0.25 Mn 0.25 Co 0.25 Ni 0.25 ) 0.4 Sc 1.6 Mo 3 O 12 (CE 0.4 MO). Variable-temperature synchrotron X-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, and first-principles calculations were employed to elucidate the entropy-driven mechanism responsible for tuning the thermal expansion temperature window. The results demonstrate that a reduction in configurational entropy weakens the lattice distortion effect in materials, thereby lowering their intrinsic structural flexibility. This change in structural properties inhibits the dynamic lattice evolution of the materials during heating, which enables a broadening of the operating temperature range for NTE and ZTE effects. This work provides theoretical guidance for the design and development of thermally stable materials with controllable thermal expansion at high temperatures.

title: Breaking the conductivity–selectivity trade-off in Nafion via synergistic molecular modification for high-performance vanadium redox flow batteries 分子协同改性Nafion膜: 突破电导率-选择性权衡实现高性能全钒液流电池
abstract: Developing ion exchange membranes with both high proton conductivity and high selectivity is crucial for vanadium redox flow batteries (VRFBs). Commercial Nafion membranes suffer from severe vanadium crossover, while conventional additives often aggregate, disrupting ion domains and significantly reducing proton conductivity. To overcome this conductivity-selectivity trade-off, we propose a modification strategy based on molecular-level functionalization. Two complementary additives, polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) and a fluoroalkyl-grafted polyoxometalate cluster (8FSiW 11 ), are introduced into the Nafion matrix to achieve precise, cooperative regulation of ionic domains. PVP fills ion domains via hydrogen bonding and electrostatic interactions, constructing an efficient barrier against vanadium ions. Simultaneously, 8FSiW 11 anchors at the hydrophilic/hydrophobic interface, providing additional proton sources and hopping sites to compensate for proton neutralization by PVP. The resulting hybrid membrane exhibits a proton/vanadium selectivity of 1 × 10 6 S min cm −3 , 8.6 times higher than commercial Nafion 212 (NR212), and enables VRFB energy efficiencies of 88.9% at 100 mA cm −2 and 83.2% at 200 mA cm −2 . This work demonstrates the potential of a synergistic molecular modification strategy to break the conductivity-selectivity trade-off in membrane design for next-generation high-performance VRFBs.

title: Grafting redox polymers onto covalent organic frameworks for fast charge transport 共价有机框架接枝氧化还原聚合物以实现快速电荷传输
abstract: Current supercapacitors suffer from limited active site utilization and sluggish electron/ion transport, hindering their rate capability and energy density. Here, we synthesize a novel molecularly wired covalent organic framework (COF)-polymer architecture via Buchwald-Hartwig coupling to synergistically enhance charge-transport kinetics and active-site utilization. In this design, redox-active poly-(1,5-diaminoanthraquinone) (PDAQ) is covalently wired onto an imine-linked COF scaffold. The as-synthesized COF-grafted PDAQ composite (PDAQ- g -COF) features an integrated π-conjugated architecture that enables efficient charge delocalization, while retaining the ordered channels and high surface area of the COF. These structural merits effectively facilitate rapid ion/electron diffusion and active site exposure. Consequently, the PDAQ- g -COF electrode delivers a high specific capacitance of 715 F g −1 at 1 A g −1 , representing a 36% enhancement compared to pristine PDAQ. It also exhibits excellent rate capability (65% retention at 10 A g −1 ) and remarkable cycling stability (81% retention after 10,000 cycles). Furthermore, the assembled symmetric supercapacitor achieves a maximum energy density of 73 Wh kg −1 at a power density of 350 W kg −1 and retains an impressive 51 Wh kg −1 even at 3000 W kg −1 , with practical viability successfully demonstrated in pouch cells. This work demonstrates a practical approach to molecularly wiring pseudocapacitive polymers onto COFs for high-performance supercapacitors.

title: Engineering 3D heterogeneous electrodes for optimized mass transfer and reaction kinetics in energy-saving hydrogen production via hybrid seawater electrolysis 构建三维异质电极优化传质与反应动力学实现混合海水电解节能制氢
abstract: Seawater electrolysis represents an attractive route for future hydrogen (H 2 ) production, yet it has been severely hindered by precipitation blockage, competitive chlorine evolution, and high energy consumption. Herein, a 3D heterogeneous cobalt-phosphide-based catalyst supported on nickel foam (CoP-NC/Co x P/NF) with optimized electron transfer and intermediate adsorption has been successfully fabricated. The constructed bead-like architecture enhances electrolyte permeation, facilitates rapid bubble release to prevent precipitation accumulation, and accelerates charge transfer. Theoretical calculations reveal that the cobalt phosphide heterogeneous interface promotes interfacial electron transfer, thus improving water adsorption and dissociation while optimizing the intermediate H adsorption free energy, thereby boosting the hydrogen evolution process. Notably, the urea-assisted seawater electrolyzer constructed with a symmetric CoP-NC/Co x P/NF electrode achieves a remarkably low cell voltage of 1.67 V at 500 mA cm −2 , which is well below the chlorine oxidation potential. Furthermore, the power consumption decreased significantly from 4.16 to 3.66 kW h m −3 H 2 at 500 mA cm −2 by coupling with the urea oxidation reaction. This work provides new ideas for the design of heterogeneous electrodes for efficient hydrogen production through urea-assisted seawater electrolysis.

title: Liquid metal interconnects overcome the fill-factor limitations of stretchable pixelated electronic devices
Gradient structure and interface engineering in metal matrix composites for superior mechanical and functional properties 金属基复合材料中实现优异力学与功能性能的梯度结构与界面设计
abstract: Overcoming the strength-ductility trade-off remains a critical challenge for advanced structural materials. Metal matrix composites (MMCs) featuring spatially tailored gradient architectures and engineered interfaces offer a transformative solution. Herein, we systematically review recent advances in gradient-structured MMCs, highlighting the synergy between architectural heterogeneity and interfacial design. We elucidate the intrinsic deformation mechanismsnamely, geometrically necessary dislocation accumulation, back-stress hardening, and hetero-deformation-induced strengthening. Furthermore, we discuss how gradient interfaces mitigate reinforcement-matrix incompatibility and facilitate progressive strain accommodation. Advanced fabrication strategies, including severe plastic deformation, additive manufacturing, and gradient heat treatments, are evaluated alongside emerging multifunctional applications. Finally, we propose a unified framework for gradient interface engineering, emphasizing physics-informed machine learning and multiscale modeling as pivotal tools for the inverse design of next-generation MMCs.

title: Breaking the functionality-flexibility trade-off in ceramics: high-entropy engineered Bi4Ti3O12 ceramics
A self-renewing textile fluidic rectifier for continuous, high-fidelity wearable biochemical sensing in sweat 基于自更新织物流体整流结构的高精度可穿戴汗液传感系统
abstract: The transition toward continuous, personalized health management necessitates wearable platforms capable of high-fidelity biochemical monitoring. Although textile-based sensors provide ideal mechanical compliance and breathability, their analytical performance is fundamentally limited by sample stagnation and evaporative concentration drift, which cause temporal mixing and significant signal inaccuracy. Here, we report a self-renewing textile fluidic rectifier with directional sweat transport (DST) designed to achieve autonomous fluidic management and high-fidelity sensing. By engineering functionally decoupled zones including collection, transport, and evaporation zones within a hierarchical hydrophilic/hydrophobic fiber matrix, we establish an evaporation-induced water potential gradient that functions as an autonomous microfluidic pump. This architecture effectively rectifies the fluidic flux, ensuring unidirectional flow that continuously avoids sample mixing and clears the sensing interface. Consequently, compared with conventional textiles, the system dramatically improves the sensing accuracy from 39% to 96% and maintains stable electrochemical operation. We further integrated fiber-based electrochemical sensors into a monolithic, knitted wristband for real-time, wireless monitoring of Na + , K + , and glucose during exercise, which demonstrated high physiological correlation and mechanical robustness through 5000 bending cycles. Combining industrial scalability with sophisticated microfluidics, this self-renewing rectifier offers a robust hardware foundation for the next generation of digital health and personalized diagnostic platforms.

title: Co-doping enables band convergence, dopability preservation and dislocation engineering in PbTe thermoelectrics 共掺杂实现PbTe热电材料中的能带汇聚、载流子浓度优化与位错工程
abstract: 能带收敛已被证明是提升热电性能的有效策略. 除了天然嵌套 的价带或导带之外, 外源性方法通常需要对化学组分进行精确控制. 以 传统p型PbTe热电材料为例, 用其他二价阳离子替换Pb 2+ , 能够降低L和 Σ价带之间的能量偏移. 进一步的异价受主掺杂会向这些收敛的能带中 释放足够的载流子, 从而在不降低泽贝克系数的情况下提高电导率. 然 而, 在实现能带收敛的同时保持足够且可调的载流子浓度, 尤其是避免 因合金化导致的掺杂窗口收窄, 一直是一个挑战. 本文中, 我们引入Eu 和Mg共掺杂机制, 在确保能带收敛的同时, 有效规避了单一合金体系 中掺杂受限的问题; 并进一步采用Na掺杂来精确调控空穴浓度. 结果 表明, 材料的态密度有效质量显著增加, 且载流子浓度在宽范围内调 节. 与此同时, 异价Na掺杂诱导的高密度位错显著增强了中高频声子 的散射, 使晶格热导率大幅降低. 本工作实现了能带收敛、载流子浓度 优化与超低晶格热导率的协同调控, 获得了超过2.7的热电优值, 为提高 热电材料性能研究提供了一条可行途径.

title: Photocatalytic functional coatings at a turning point: from high-activity materials to service-ready surfaces 处于转折点的光催化功能性涂层: 从高活性材料到 可服役表面
abstract: 光催化功能性涂层在自清洁、空气净化、抗菌防污等方面具有 重要应用潜力, 但现有研究多聚焦于材料本征活性比较, 对真实服役条 件下的长期稳定性和工程可用性关注不足. 本文提出, 光催化涂层研究 应由高活性材料导向转向可服役表面导向, 并围绕表面服役能力构建 统一分析框架. 进一步从催化失活、界面相容性与附着稳定性、多功 能协同、应用导向评价体系以及规模化制造五个方面总结当前关键挑 战, 强调这些问题彼此耦合、共同决定涂层的实际应用价值. 本文旨在 为光催化功能性涂层的研究设计与工程转化提供新的思路.

title: Photolithographic organic field-effect transistors: from high-precision patterning to high-density integration 光刻有机场效应晶体管: 从高精度图案化到高密度集成
abstract: Organic field-effect transistors (OFETs) are key building blocks for flexible, large-area and wearable electronics. However, their practical deployment hinges on high-precision patterning and high-density integration, which remain long-standing bottlenecks. While photolithography provides exceptional resolution, scalability, and reproducibility, its harsh processing conditions severely degrade organic materials. Over recent decades, substantial progress has been made in developing compatible strategies to resolve this incompatibility. Here, we systematically review state-of-the-art photolithographic methods for patterning OFET core components, including organic semiconductors, polymer electrodes and organic dielectrics. We evaluate key strategies such as orthogonal photolithography, protective-layer photolithography, solvent-resistant molecular design, and photocrosslinking. Furthermore, we highlight landmark advances in full-photolithographic OFET arrays with ultrahigh integration density and preserved mobility, alongside emerging applications in logic circuits, flexible sensors, and display backplanes. Finally, we outline remaining challenges and future perspectives, offering a clear roadmap from high-precision patterning to high-density integration of organic electronics.

title: Thermoelectric-based all-day solar thermal management 基于热电的全天候太阳能热管理
abstract: 作为自供能传感器、可穿戴电子和分布式物联网节点的重要供 能途径, 热电能量收集的长期运行依赖于持续稳定的冷热端温差. 被动 辐射热管理利用太阳作为热源、外太空作为冷源, 通过光热吸收与辐 射冷却的光谱调控, 将低品位环境热流转化为热电发电机可利用的温 差. 近年来, 垂直堆叠、透明结构、水平布置、Janus器件和折纸结构 等设计不断发展, 推动了辐射冷却/光热与热电器件的协同集成. 然而, 该领域仍面临界面热阻、寄生热泄漏、热阻匹配、环境适应性和长期 稳定性等挑战, 现有评价也过度依赖瞬时峰值输出. 本文总结了全天候 辐射调节热电发电的代表性进展, 强调以有效Δ T 传递、24 h能量密 度、户外重复性和器件可制造性为核心的发展方向, 为低功耗自主供 能系统提供参考.

title: Hybrid graphene and carbon fiber reinforced composites: synthesis-structure-property relationships 石墨烯-碳纤维构型增强复合材料: 制备工艺、微观 结构与性能的关联机制
abstract: Graphene and carbon fiber have garnered significant attention as advanced reinforcing materials for polymers, metals, and ceramics, due to their superior electrical/thermal conductivity, high specific strength and other excellent characteristics. However, graphene’s proneness to stacking (due to strong π - π interactions) and carbon fiber’s poor interfacial bonding (from a smooth, inert surface) limit their standalone efficacy. Hybridization of graphene and carbon fiber has emerged as a pivotal solution, harnessing their synergies to optimize dispersion, interfacial compatibility, and multi-performance integration. This review first outlines the evolutionary development of composite reinforcement technologies and the core value of graphene/carbon fiber hybridization. It then summarizes key hybridization strategies, including chemical grafting, electrophoretic deposition, chemical vapor deposition, and physical methods, highlighting their configurations and mechanisms. Subsequently, it critically discusses the state-of-the-art progress of graphene/carbon fiber hybrid-reinforced polymer, metal, and ceramic matrix composites, elaborating on enhanced mechanical, electrical, thermal, and specialized properties (e.g., electromagnetic shielding, ablation resistance) and underlying synergistic mechanisms (e.g., interfacial engineering, multi-scale network construction). Finally, the review addresses current technical bottlenecks (e.g., controlled dispersion, cost-effective fabrication, extreme-condition stability) and envisions emerging opportunities for these advanced composites in aerospace, high-end manufacturing, and new energy fields.

title: Surface fluorination and liquid-bridge assembly of perovskite quantum dots for high-resolution displays
Amino trimethylene phosphonic acid solution rinsing stabilizes 4.6 V Ni-rich cathodes for lithium-ion batteries 胺基三亚甲基膦酸溶液清洗策略稳定4.6 V高镍正极
abstract: Ni-rich layered oxide cathodes are attracting increasing attention in lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) due to their capacity and cost advantages. However, lithium residues caused by unreacted precursors and the high surface reactivity of Ni-rich cathodes have compromised their cycling performance. Conventional water washing to remove lithium residues exacerbates the surface reconstruction problem. In this work, a one-step rinsing method was proposed to remove lithium residues by rapidly rinsing LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) with an aqueous solution of amino trimethylene phosphonic acid (ATMP) (NCM-ATMP). ATMP can strongly adhere to the cathode surface by electrostatic attraction and hydrogen bonding, creating a thin and uniform surface rock-salt layer. In addition, ATMP facilitates the formation of an even and LiF-rich cathode electrolyte interphase (CEI) film on the NCM-ATMP surface by decreasing the Gibbs free energy change of LiF formation. This three-in-one multilayer efficiently enhances thermal stability and inhibits electrolyte decomposition, transition metal dissolution, and gas evolution issues of NCM811. NCM-ATMP demonstrates considerably improved cycling stability and safety under aggressive working conditions (4.6 V cut-off voltage) as well as in pouch-type full cells. This work presents a simple and green strategy to remove lithium residues whilst stabilizing the cathode surface by multifunctional molecules, making it applicable for high-performance LIBs.

title: Spatially confined crystallization enables reversible stress imaging in dual-network polymers 双网络聚合物中基于空间限域结晶的可逆应力成像
abstract: The development of mechanically responsive materials that enable spatially resolved and reversible visualization is crucial for real-time, non-destructive stress sensing. However, conventional materials are limited by their non-selective responses and poor reversibility. Here, we introduce a “confined crystallization” strategy, which involves the fabrication of a dual-network film combining a crystallizable polyurethane (PU) network and a polyacrylate (PA) network with a high glass transition temperature ( T g ). At room temperature, the rigid PA network forms a kinetic cage, which locks the crystallization potential of the PU segments. Local mechanical forces selectively unlock this confinement, triggering rapid alignment and crystallization of the PU segments to convert invisible stress into visible patterns. Notably, the PA network also functions as a memory element. When heated to 50 °C, PU crystals melt, and the image is erased; however, the glassy PA network retains the stress-induced chain orientation as a “pre-oriented template”, allowing for precise image recovery upon cooling. The memory is only fully erased when the temperature exceeds the T g of the PA network, enabling a complete reset. We demonstrate the film’s potential in applications such as center-of-gravity shift detection, impact energy sensing, and motion analysis, offering a novel platform for next-generation mechanical vision sensors.

title: Photoblinking upconversion nanoparticles for super-resolution imaging
Photochemical steering in dual molecular motors
Biomimetic membrane design with ridge-netted dual-scale nanofiber-nanowire networks for high-performance acoustic vents 脊/网双尺度纳米纤/网仿生膜的设计及其高性能声学通风孔应用
abstract: Under extremely sub-zero conditions, intelligent acoustic devices suffer from poor reliability due to ice accretion that obstructs acoustic pathways, while most existing fibrous protective membranes still face trade-offs between anti-icing robustness and acoustic transparency. Herein, inspired by the hierarchical architecture of Papilio paris wings, we present an eco-friendly electro-ridge-netting strategy that enables facile fabrication of biomimetic dual-scale nanofiber-nanowire network (Bio-net) acoustic membranes through coupled electrohydrodynamic jet evolution and phase separation. This strategy creates ridge-like scaffold nanofibers seamlessly integrated with two-dimensional (2D) Voronoi nanonetworks composed of deep-subwavelength nanowires (∼14 nm), yielding fluorine-free superhydrophobic membranes with nanoscale pores (∼336 nm) for efficient water resistance. The Bio-net membranes exhibit prolonged icing delay of 593.2 s and low ice adhesion strength of 15.3 kPa, effectively suppressing ice accretion under extreme cold conditions. Simultaneously, their breathable porous architecture and ultra-low airflow resistivity minimize acoustic impedance mismatch, yielding exceptional acoustic transparency with transmission loss below 1.78 dB across 63–6300 Hz. When deployed in acoustic electronic systems, the membranes provide durable, high-fidelity acoustic protection at −20 °C. This study reconciles anti-icing robustness with broadband acoustic transparency, establishing a bioinspired design paradigm for next-generation fibrous acoustic protective membranes in extreme environments.

title: Unveiling the potential of Na5MSi4O12: a new paradigm in oxide solid electrolytes 揭示Na5MSi4O12的潜力: 氧化物固态电解质的新范式
abstract: Sodium-based solid-state batteries are considered promising candidates for next-generation energy storage due to their high energy density and intrinsic safety. However, the practical implementation is hindered by the inherent limitations of existing solid electrolytes, which struggle to simultaneously achieve high ionic conductivity, wide electrochemical stability, and cost-effectiveness. This review focuses on emerging Na 5 MSi 4 O 12 -type oxide fast ionic conductors as a potential solution. The historical discovery and development of these materials are first reviewed, followed by a discussion of their ionic transport mechanisms. The impact of synthesis methods, doping strategies, and interface engineering on conductivity and battery performance is covered. Finally, the advantages of this material family are summarized, and future research directions for advancing solid-state sodium-metal batteries are outlined, with the purpose of shedding light on the exploration of advanced solid electrolyte materials.

title: 3D-printable unitary functionally graded materials with spatiotemporal programmability via near-infrared regulation 近红外调控实现时空可编程的3D打印一体功能梯度材料
abstract: The localized gradient characteristics of material composition, structure, and function are widely present in nature. However, fabricating unitary functional gradient materials with spatiotemporal programmability remains a challenge. We develop a three-stage curing polymer system and construct a photocurable 3D printing nanocomposite by incorporating WO 3− x photo-thermal nanoparticles, achieving a unitary functionally graded material with spatiotemporal programmability. Three-stage curing enables modulus enhancement from 2 to 1.2 GPa while retaining ∼57% strain, achieving a three-order-of-magnitude gradient. Near-infrared irradiation (NIR) enables precise modulus control of printed structures with spatial resolutions of ∼2 mm ( X - Y direction) and ∼0.68 mm ( Z direction), allowing accurate fabrication of 3D architectures with arbitrarily distributed soft/stiff regions and seamless interfaces. Photocurable 3D-printed sensors from this material use NIR modulation for tensile non-contact sensitivity and finger motion microstructural reinforcement. Moreover, through NIR irradiation, we are able to inhibit crack propagation, effectively enhancing the service stability of materials.

title: Tandem catalysis in sulfur conversion: from general catalytic promotion to stepwise reaction regulation 硫转化过程中的串联催化: 从通用催化增效到分步反应调控
abstract: Lithium-sulfur and sodium-sulfur batteries are promising energy-storage systems owing to the abundance, low cost, and multielectron redox chemistry of sulfur. However, sulfur cathodes undergo stepwise conversion among long-chain polysulfides, shorter-chain intermediates, and final Li 2 S/Na 2 S products, which differ in solubility, redox kinetics, and deposition behavior. These stage-dependent challenges make single-function catalysts insufficient for regulating the whole pathway. Therefore, this review emphasizes tandem catalysis as stepwise regulation of consecutive sulfur conversion steps, rather than as a general description of enhanced adsorption, conductivity, or overall catalytic acceleration. Tandem catalysis offers a strategy in which different active sites, domains, or interfaces participate successively in consecutive sulfur conversion steps. In this mini-review, we summarize tandem catalytic regulation in Li-S and Na-S batteries, focusing on dual-site catalysts, heterostructures, and confined or core-shell systems. We further discuss mechanistic evidence, including step-resolved conversion, site-related catalytic roles, intermediate relay, and reversible metal sulfide formation/decomposition, and highlight future challenges in mechanism clarification, catalyst design, and practical cell validation.

title: Ce-induced dynamic electron buffering to regulate controllable surface reconstruction of Co for alkaline oxygen evolution reaction Ce诱导的动态电子缓冲作用, 用于调控Co在碱性氧析出反应中的可控表面重构
abstract: Transition metal hydroxides are considered highly promising catalysts for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER). In this work, Ce-doped Co(OH) 2 electrocatalysts were successfully prepared by a one-step electrodeposition method. The Ce 3+ /Ce 4+ ratio can be precisely controlled by tuning the electrodeposition temperature, thus influencing the OER reaction kinetics. The optimized Ce-Co(OH) 2 catalyst has an overpotential of only 236 mV at 10 mA cm −2 and exhibits a long-term stability of 200 h. Integrated into an anion-exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEMWE) system, the optimized Ce-Co(OH) 2 anode delivers a low cell voltage of 2.04 V at 1 A cm −2 and exhibits outstanding long-term stability over 500 h at 500 mA cm −2 . This work demonstrates that Ce 3+ /Ce 4+ dynamic electron buffering is an effective strategy for regulating surface reconstruction. It presents an innovative design strategy for highly efficient catalysts in alkaline water electrolysis.

title: Intrinsic planarity in partially fused electron acceptors enabled by furan thiophene linkage design 通过呋喃-噻吩连接设计实现部分稠环电子受体的本征平面性
abstract: Abstract Electron acceptors containing single-bond-linked building blocks offer attractive advantages for organic solar cells owing to their synthetic simplicity and structural modularity. However, achieving backbone planarity without compromising electronic compatibility remains a persistent challenge. Conventional conformational locking strategies based on alkoxy substitution can effectively suppress torsional freedom but often elevate the highest occupied molecular orbital energy level, limiting compatibility with widely used donor polymers. Here, we report a partially fused electron acceptor design that achieves intrinsic backbone planarity through heterocycle selection rather than side-chain-assisted conformational locking. By incorporating a benzodifuran core and furan-thiophene linkages, the resulting acceptors exhibit a near-coplanar backbone geometry as revealed by density functional theory calculations, without the need for electronically perturbing alkoxy groups. Devices based on the optimized acceptor (BDF-1) deliver a binary power conversion efficiency of 12.2%, and further improvement to 19.5% is achieved in a ternary blend with PM6 and BTP-eC9. The enhanced performance is accompanied by favorable morphology, balanced charge transport, and suppressed recombination losses. This work provides molecular-level insight into partially fused acceptor design and demonstrates that heteroatom-guided conformational locking offers a viable strategy for expanding the design space of acceptors with single-bond-linked building blocks while maintaining compatibility with mainstream donor systems.

title: Correction to: Facile preparation of cabazitaxel-loaded nanoparticles directly lyophilized from dioxane
Stable sodium metal batteries enabled by encapsulation and alloying-induced amorphization 基于合金化诱导非晶态封装结构构筑稳定钠金属电池
abstract: 钠金属电池因其能量密度高被认为是极具前景的下一代大规模储能技术之一, 但灾难性的钠枝晶生长严重阻碍了其实际应用. 亲钠形核/载体层策略在抑制枝晶方面已取得显著成功, 但对于多孔宿主内亲钠位点的尺寸依赖性及其空间分布的研究较少. 本文封装金纳米颗粒的空心碳纳米球(Au@HCN)作为形核/载体层, 实现可控钠沉积. 将晶态Au形核位点缩小至纳米尺度, 可诱导其在钠化过程中转化为非晶态Na-Au合金; 同时, 理论计算证明该合金相具有更高的亲钠性. 此外, 核壳结构可防止Au纳米颗粒在反复沉积/剥离循环过程中发生团聚与副反应. 因此, Au@HCN在半电池中实现了1000圈的循环与99.83%的高库伦效率, 在放电深度高达85%条件下, 其对称电池实现了4.5 Ah cm −2 的高累积容量. 其全电池表现出950圈的稳定循环和20 C的高倍率性能, 特别是软包电池可实现在N/P比仅为2.5的条件下稳定循环500圈, 容量保持率为93.4%. 本研究为面向实用的下一代金属电池亲钠界面设计提供了新思路.

title: Probing active-site structure and intermediates during electrocatalytic reactions with spatiotemporal coincidence using integrated operando XAS-SEIRAS 基于集成式工况XAS-SEIRAS技术对电催化反应活性位点结构及中间体的同时空探测
abstract: 我们发展了一种电催化工况X射线吸收谱(XAS)与表面增强红外光谱(SEIRAS)集成技术, 配备统一电化学池、 同步时钟电子触发、自动气液输运控制及机器学习辅助数据处理. 该耦合装置确保XAS与SEIRAS测量在空间和时间上的严格同步, 实现了活性位点结构与吸附中间体动态变化行为的直接关联. 利用该技术追踪CuO纳米颗粒的二氧化碳电还原过程, 发现关键中间体*COOH累积相对于CuO还原为金属Cu存在显著时间延迟. 这种异步行为表明由晶格氧介导的从体相至表面的氧迁移形成了空间不均匀的亚稳非平衡表面态CuO x , 解释了氧化铜衍生催化剂上C 1 与C 2+ 产物复杂选择性的来源. 本研究建立了在相同时空条件下直接关联催化剂重构与表界面中间体演变的通用方法, 为探究电催化反应的动态构效关系建立了范例.

title: Photothermal nanocomposite hydrogel actuators: from materials and structural integration to actuation behaviors 光热纳米复合水凝胶驱动器: 从材料与结构集成到驱动行为
abstract: Photothermal nanocomposite hydrogels (PNCHs) have emerged as a versatile class of light-driven soft actuators capable of wireless, programmable, and reversible deformation. By integrating photothermal nanomaterials (NMs) into thermoresponsive polymer networks, the PNCHs efficiently convert optical energy into localized heat, enabling programmable shape morphing and complex locomotion behaviors. While extensive efforts have focused on material selection and structural integration strategies, recent advances increasingly demonstrate that the actuation behaviors of the PNCHs ultimately define their value for soft robotic applications. In this review, we summarize recent advances in PNCHs, including photothermal NMs, hydrogel matrices, and structural integration strategies. Particular emphasis is placed on actuation behaviors, including shape morphing, locomotion, and autonomous dynamic responses under light stimulation. Finally, we discuss key challenges and future opportunities for advancing PNCHs toward robust, multifunctional, and application-ready light-driven soft robotic systems.

title: Graph neural networks for predicting and ranking drug loading in mesoporous silica nanoparticles 图神经网络用于介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒载药量的预测与排序
abstract: 药物载体的理性设计受到药物分子结构、 表面化学及载体孔结构参数共同决定的高维设计空间限制. 针对介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒(MSNs)载药体系中载药量预测与配方筛选困难的问题, 本文构建了一种用于MSNs载药排序的图学习网络(graph-learning-based network for drug-loading ranking in MSNs, GNDR), 用于预测载药量(DLC)并对潜在优选配方进行排序. GNDR融合预训练分子表示、 迁移学习与贝叶斯优化, 可实现表面改性剂和载药参数的协同推荐. 基于骨架划分的10折交叉验证结果表明, GNDR具有稳定的排序性能(Spearman’s ρ = 0.78), 且整体表现优于基于分子指纹和仅基于条件变量的基线模型. 对128种抗炎药的虚拟筛选进一步表明, MPTMS是提高载药性能的优选改性剂. 随后, 在独立合成的单孔MSNs体系中, 以布洛芬和地塞米松为模型药物开展实验验证, 结果证实了模型预测的改性剂排序趋势. 上述结果表明, GNDR可为MSN配方设计中实验搜索空间的缩减与候选体系的快速筛选提供有效工具.

title: Self-healing adhesives: mechanisms, design strategies, and applications 自修复胶黏剂: 机制、 设计策略及应用
abstract: Adhesives are indispensable structural materials for industrial, electronic, and biomedical applications. However, their passive nature after curing often leads to micro-cracks, resulting in mechanical degradation and catastrophic failure. Inspired by biological healing, self-healing adhesives have emerged as a transformative solution to restore structural integrity through autonomous or stimuli-triggered mechanisms. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the research progress in self-healing adhesives. The mechanisms and classifications are first summarized. Subsequently, three core design challenges (the trade-off between self-healing property and mechanical strength, self-healing property and interface/internal adhesion, and self-healing property and environmental tolerance) and their corresponding strategies are scrutinized. Furthermore, the practical applications of these materials are highlighted across diverse frontiers, including high-performance enhanced composites, flexible electronics, energy devices, and biomedical engineering. Finally, current limitations and future perspectives are outlined, offering a useful reference for the further development of self-healing adhesives.

title: Nanoscale electronic-structural synergy induced by Sr doping enables record-low room-temperature infrared emissivity in SmCoO3-based perovskites Sr掺杂诱导的纳米尺度电子结构协同效应实现SmCoO3基钙钛矿室温超低红外发射率
abstract: Till now, traditional room-temperature infrared (IR) stealth materials often suffer from high glossiness and poor environmental tolerance. While ABO 3 perovskites offer flexible structural tunability and high stability, their intrinsic room-temperature IR emissivity remains impractically high. Moreover, the fundamental correlation between localized nanoscale lattice distortions, electron transitions, and macroscopic IR radiation characteristics remains an unresolved core issue. Herein, we propose an atomic-level structural modulation strategy in Sm 1− x Sr x CoO 3 perovskites to achieve exceptional room-temperature IR stealth. By systematically introducing Sr doping, we induce high-concentration Co 3+ /Co 4+ mixed valence states and localized oxygen vacancy enrichment. This nanoscale defect engineering significantly reduces the band gap and accelerates carrier migration via double-exchange interactions, fundamentally enhancing electron transitions and macroscopic conductivity. Consequently, the room-temperature infrared emissivity of the optimal doping component in the 8–14 µm wavelength range decreased significantly from 0.752 for the undoped sample to 0.224. This value reached a relatively low level in the perovskite ceramic system and demonstrated excellent thermal camouflage properties. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that optimal Sr doping ( x = 0.5) effectively breaks local crystal symmetry, induces nanoscale charge rearrangement, and broadens the electron transition effect. Coupled with remarkable environmental tolerance, this synergistic nanoscale electronic and structural modulation provides a compelling paradigm for designing advanced, highly stable low-infrared stealth materials.

title: Multifunctional and flexible Sn-embedded SiTiOC ceramic fiber felts with tailored electronic interfaces for integrated multi-spectrum stealth and hydrophobicity 基于电子界面调控的锡嵌入型SiTiOC多功能柔性陶瓷纤维毡及其多频谱隐身与疏水一体化性能研究
abstract: Development of flexible materials integrating broadband electromagnetic wave (EMW) absorption, infrared stealth, and hydrophobicity is required for complex environments. In this work, flexible SiTiOC ceramic fiber felts embedded with Sn nanoparticles were fabricated via electrospinning followed by in-situ carbothermal reduction. The metallic Sn promotes carbon graphitization, forming a three-dimensional conductive network and establishing heterogeneous interfaces within the SiTiOC matrix. First-principles calculations indicate that the work function gradient ( Φ Sn < Φ C ) drives electron migration at the Sn/C interface, inducing interfacial polarization, while turbostratic carbon in the SiTiOC phase provides defect dipole polarization. The fiber felt exhibits an effective absorption bandwidth of 7.3 GHz at a thickness of 3.75 mm. The material integrates radar-infrared compatible stealth through low thermal conductivity and low emissivity, with a water contact angle exceeding 138°. These results provide an interface engineering strategy for multifunctional stealth materials in complex environments.

title: Lanthanide-based luminescence thermometry: from fundamentals and materials to applications 镧系发光测温学: 从基础与材料到应用
abstract: Temperature, as a fundamental thermodynamic variable, governs processes from cellular metabolism to microelectronics, necessitating precise, remote, and non-contact thermometry. Lanthanide-based luminescence thermometry has emerged as a leading platform, capitalizing on sharp line-like emission, microsecond-to-millisecond excited-state lifetimes, exceptional photostability, and thermally coupled levels (TCLs) that enable self-referenced ratiometric readout with high spatiotemporal resolution. This review presents a comprehensive overview spanning from fundamental photophysics and emerging lanthanide-based luminescence thermometric materials to cutting-edge applications. It details the underlying electronic energy-level structure and luminescence processes, systematically classifies thermometric mechanisms into TCL-based Boltzmann ratiometry, non-TCL strategies, lifetime-based approaches, and hybrid schemes, and establishes standardized performance metrics for objective cross-comparison. Beyond surveying six major material classes, the review highlights pivotal innovations such as anti-thermal-quenching (ATQ) strategies, a paradigm shift from single-parameter relative sensitivity to a multi-metric evaluation framework, and the integration of emerging platforms such as metal-organic frameworks and hybrid composites. Frontier applications in single-cell metabolic imaging, microelectronic thermal management, and aerodynamic thermal protection are showcased. Current challenges, including thermal quenching, limited quantum efficiency, and inadequate reproducibility, are critically examined, and forward-looking perspectives on ATQ development, multi-parameter co-optimization, and application-oriented standardized characterization protocols are outlined. This review offers a timely and valuable resource for accelerating the design and deployment of next-generation lanthanide luminescence thermometers.

title: Precision design of asymmetric cobalt single-atom catalysts for high-performance zinc-air batteries 用于高性能锌空气电池的非对称钴单原子催化剂的精准设计
abstract: The widespread application of zinc-air batteries (ZABs) relies on robust and cost-effective oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) catalysts. While Co-based single-atom catalysts (SACs) offer superior selectivity and stability over traditional Fe–N–C counterparts, boosting their intrinsic ORR activity remains a formidable challenge. Here, we alleviate the scaling-relation constraint among ORR intermediates by precisely engineering the coordination symmetry of Co SACs. Through a novel mild annealing strategy, we incorporated boron into the first and second coordination shells of Co centers to construct a typical asymmetric Co–N 3 B–O local environment. The first-shell B/O coordination modulates the electronic structure of the Co center, while the hydrogen bond between *OOH and the coordinated O atom further stabilizes the key intermediate, thereby synergistically enhancing ORR activity. Implemented in ZABs, our Co-BCN-950 catalyst delivers outstanding performance, achieving a peak power density of 216 mW cm −2 —a 43% enhancement over commercial platinum-on-carbon (Pt/C) (151 mW cm −2 ). Furthermore, it exhibits an exceptional open-circuit voltage of 1.43 V and a specific capacity of 790 mAh g −1 . These findings provide a compelling paradigm for tailoring the local coordination of SACs, paving the way for next-generation, high-stability energy storage systems.

title: Plastic processing induced multiscale microstructures for simultaneous thermoelectric and mechanical enhancements in PbTe 塑性加工诱导的多尺度微结构使PbTe的热电性能和机械性能同时增强
abstract: 微结构工程是一种调控材料功能的通用方法, 但性能与微结构间的复杂关系使得多性能优化极具挑战. 随着热电技术向大规模、 可靠应用转变, 同时提高转换效率和机械性能成为关键. 本工作采用热挤压工艺, 在二元PbTe中引入多维缺陷和特定织构. 多维缺陷在宽频范围内散射声子, 显著降低晶格热导率; 结合Te空位提升的电子浓度, 协同优化了功率因子. 同时, [100]织构使压缩强度和延展性均提高约100%. 与传统依赖复杂成分调控的热电材料不同, 本研究证明, 即使在二元PbTe中, 塑性加工也是一种可行策略, 能提供高重复性的热电与机械性能, 从而推动热电发展.

title: Thickness-insensitive A-D-A-A’ polymeric cathode interlayer for high-efficiency organic solar cells 厚度不敏感的A-D-A-A’型聚合物阴极界面用于高效率有机太阳能电池
abstract: Organic solar cells (OSCs) are a promising next-generation photovoltaic technology owing to their low cost, light weight, flexibility, solution processability, and compatibility with large-area fabrication. Despite recent power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) exceeding 20%, developing cathode interlayers (CILs) that simultaneously enable high efficiency, thickness tolerance, and operational stability remains a critical challenge for scalable applications. Herein, we report a novel alcohol/water-soluble polymeric CIL, PDPP2F-NDI-N, constructed with an acceptor-donor-acceptor-acceptor’ (A-D-A-A’) backbone synthesized via direct arylation polycondensation (DArP). The incorporation of multiple electron-deficient units endows PDPP2F-NDI-N with strong electron-withdrawing capability, effective work-function modulation, an enhanced built-in potential, high crystallinity, and ordered molecular packing. With PDPP2F-NDI-N as the CIL, binary and ternary OSCs achieve high PCEs of 19.61% and 20.44%, respectively. Notably, the ternary device retains 92.8% of its peak PCE even with a 30 nm-thick CIL, demonstrating excellent thickness insensitivity. Moreover, the PDPP2F-NDI-N-based device shows outstanding operational stability with a T 80 lifetime exceeding 1700 h under photothermal aging. This work presents a poly (A-D-A-A’) back-bone design combined with DArP synthesis as an effective strategy for developing thickness-insensitive polymeric CILs toward efficient, stable, and scalable OSCs.

title: Revealing a hidden buried-defect origin of weak-response pixel clusters in HgCdTe infrared focal plane arrays 碲镉汞外延层界面缺陷热激活诱发焦平面弱响应像元团簇研究
abstract: 碲镉汞红外焦平面中的弱响应像元簇会导致探测器成像质量显著下降, 但相关起源仍缺乏直接证据. 本文发现, 碲锌镉与碲镉汞界面附近的富Te沉积相是诱发弱响应像元簇的来源之一. 通过第一性原理计算、 薄膜性能及结构分析, 确定了弱响应像元簇形成及演化过程. 在高温退火过程中, 界面处的Te沉积相与薄膜因热失配使薄膜产生局部位错增殖, 沉积相中Te原子借助位错通道快速扩散, 进而加剧位错团簇的进一步扩大, 最终形成数十微米的高位错密度团簇. 位错团簇中载流子复合速率较常规区域快, 导致该区域信号降低. 据此, 本文在衬底与薄膜吸收区之间引入高Cd组分隔离层, 有效阻断位错团簇向吸收区延伸, 形成了对弱响应像元簇的有效控制.

title: Modulating crystallization kinetics via polymer molecular weight to achieve 20.55% efficiency in non-halogenated solvent based organic solar cells 通过聚合物分子量调控结晶动力学, 实现基于非卤溶剂的有机太阳能电池20.55%的效率
abstract: While D18 has enabled the power conversion efficiency (PCE) of organic solar cells (OSCs) to surpass 21%, its combination with the representative non-halogenated solvent, ortho-xylene ( o -XY), exhibits lower efficiency due to poor regulation of film-forming kinetics. Herein, a series of D18 polymers with molecular weights from low to high (41.6–70.9 kDa) are produced to systematically address this concern. The crystallization kinetics results reveal that as the molecular weight decreases, the film solidification process is continuously shortened. An excessively fast or excessively slow crystallization rate leads to either excessive aggregation or insufficient phase separation, respectively. In contrast, the moderate crystallization rate enabled by the medium molecular weight allows for favorable phase separation, achieving a device efficiency of 20.55%, which represents one of the highest values for non-halogenated solvent-processed OSCs. In addition, the energy loss evaluation indicates that although conjugated polymers prefer to demonstrate higher luminescence in the low molecular weight region, the blend film’s emission characteristic depends more on the exciton environment, which is strongly determined by film morphology. Therefore, this work not only realizes impressive PCE, but also presents new insight into the morphology-performance relationship.

title: Stabilizing anionic redox of P2-type cathode with ligand-to-metal charge transfer by neodymium for sodium-ion batteries Nd诱导的配体-金属电荷转移对钠离子电池P2型正极材料阴离子氧化还原的稳定作用
abstract: P2型层状氧化物作为钠离子电池正极的候选材料之一, 因其优异的反应动力学和成本优势而受到广泛关注. 然而, 结构不稳定性以及不可逆的阴离子氧氧化还原反应限制了其实际应用. 因此, 本工作制备了Nd掺杂的P2-Na 0.67 (Mn 0.7 Ni 0.2 Co 0.1 ) 0.97 Nd 0.03 O 2 材料(Nd-MNC), 以研究Nd在提高阴离子氧氧化还原可逆性方面的作用. 密度泛函理论(DFT)结果表明, Nd取代能够降低e g 轨道的分裂能, 从而抑制姜-泰勒畸变, 且Nd的能态位于e g 轨道与t 2g 轨道之间, 可容纳来自氧的电子以缓解不可逆的阴离子氧氧化还原反应. Nd-MNC的扫描透射电镜-高角环形暗场(STEM-HAADF)图像显示, 过渡金属离子呈P2型有序排列. 非原位X射线光电子能谱(XPS)与X射线吸收精细结构谱(XAFS)结果揭示了配体到金属的电荷转移过程(M n + –O 2− →M ( n −1)+ –O − ). 原位电化学阻抗及弛豫时间分布(DRT)分析表明, Nd-MNC具有更小的电荷转移电阻.

title: Water-mediated highly reversible Mg-O2 batteries 水分子介导的高可逆性镁-氧电池
abstract: 镁-氧(Mg-O 2 )电池因其潜在的高比容量和低成本优势而备受关注. 然而, 其实际应用仍受到循环稳定性差和能量效率低的严重制约, 这主要源于传统MgO x 放电产物可逆性有限. 在本研究中, 我们揭示了一种由电解液中微量水诱导的反应机制, 该机制促进形成具有化学活性的Mg 2 (OH) 3 Cl·4H 2 O作为主要放电产物. 基于该机制, 我们提出了一 条全新的正极反应路径: 8Mg 2+ + 4Cl − + 3O 2 + 22H 2 O ⇋ 4Mg 2 (OH) 3 -Cl·4H 2 O. 与传统MgO x 路径相比, 该路径显著提升了电化学氧化还原反应的可逆性. 基于这一水介导反应化学, 所构建的Mg-O 2 电池实现了超过324次的循环和高达92%的能量效率, 达到目前Mg-O 2 体系的最高水平. 本工作为实现可逆Mg-O 2 电化学反应提供了一种普适性策略, 并为实用化镁基储能体系的设计提供了全新思路.

title: Fe redox mediators for reversible lattice oxygen redox in sodium-ion batteries
Hollow flower-sphere TiO2 nanoreactors: enabling ultrahigh-loading and speciation-controlled Cu sites for solar H2 evolution 中空花球TiO2纳米反应器: 实现超高负载及物种可调控单原子Cu活性位用于光催化产氢
abstract: Overcoming the intrinsic loading ceiling of oxide-supported single-atom catalysts remains a long-standing challenge, because oxide frameworks generally provide limited capacity for accommodating high densities of isolated metal species. Here, we report a hollow TiO 2 nanoreactor that effectively addresses the long-standing loading limitation of oxide-supported catalysts by coupling high-capacity ion exchange with structural confinement. The multiscale framework is derived from a sodium titanate hollow flower-sphere assembled from ultrathin nanosheets. It enables broad accessibility of exchange sites and facilitates high Cu uptake prior to oxide formation. Subsequently, during Ar-assisted transformation into oxygen-vacancy-rich TiO 2 , the incorporated Cu species remain highly dispersed within the framework, while vacancy-mediated metal-support interactions further enhance their stability. As a result, controllable Cu speciation is achieved at ultrahigh loadings of 7.4 wt% as spatially isolated single atoms and 12.4 wt% as single-atom/subnanometer-cluster hybrids. The optimized hybrid catalyst delivers a hydrogen evolution rate of 28.8 mmol g −1 h −1 under simulated sunlight, surpassing conventional low-loading Cu/TiO 2 systems under comparable conditions. This strategy is readily extendable to other transition metals (Fe, Co, and Ni), establishing a structural design principle for constructing high-density and speciation-controlled metal sites on oxide supports.

title: Titanous coordination stabilized zero-valent ruthenium for triboelectric nanogenerator driven electrochemical chlorination of ballast water 钛配位稳定单质钌助力摩擦纳米发电机驱动压载水电化学氯化体系
abstract: Electrochemical in-situ production of active chlorine (AC) via chlorine evolution reaction (CER) can alleviate hull corrosion and residual chlorine overage, which is a highly reliable disinfectant for sewage and ballast water. Nonetheless, the primarily competitive oxygen evolution reaction and gradual anode passivation hinder its practical application. Herein, we employed the in-situ hydrothermal strategy to synthesize Ru/TiO 2− x to realize high activity and selectivity of CER. The robust interaction of Ru sites and TiO 2− x achieved via a one-step hydrothermal synthesis strategy, the structural and valence state characterizations confirm that Ti 3+ stabilizes Ru solely in the metallic state (Ru 0 ) via structural confinement effects, effectively inhibiting catalyst oxidation. As a result, the Ru/TiO 2− x requires only an over-potential of 33 mV to reach 10 mA cm −2 , and possesses strong catalytic durability, sustaining continuous operation for 100 h with negligible current decay. Further integration with a triboelectric nanogenerator successfully realizes the generation of AC, which demonstrates a >99.9% inactivation efficiency against Escherichia coli in simulated seawater environments, while also effectively degrading ammonia nitrogen and urea contaminants in domestic wastewater.

title: Inkjet printing organic light-emitting diodes 喷墨印刷有机发光二极管
abstract: Highly efficient solution-processed technologies for organic optoelectronic devices are highly demanded. Inkjet printing technology is being developed as an alternative to the traditional techniques for organic materials deposition. Compared with traditional techniques, inkjet printing technology exhibits profound advantages in the fabrication of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), which is highlighted by recent breakthroughs enabling printed devices to achieve maximum external quantum efficiencies (EQEs) exceeding 20% and remarkable LT90 lifetimes of over 1000 h. In this review, recent development of inkjet printing OLEDs including materials and technology are discussed at length, which would provide a deep understanding of materials design and inkjet printing technology. Prospects and challenges of inkjet printing OLEDs are also given at the end.

title: From passive barriers to active regulators: unified bilayer membranes for stage-adaptive bone regeneration
Strategies for controllable siRNA delivery in gene silencing and cancer therapy 用于基因沉默与癌症治疗的siRNA可控释放策略
abstract: The therapeutic potential of small interfering RNA (siRNA) has attracted broad interest in oncology; however, its therapeutic efficacy is often constrained by endosomal/lysosomal barriers, which impede cytosolic accessibility. To achieve cytosol-accessible, functional delivery of siRNA, innovative carrier-free systems and stimuli-responsive carriers have been developed. Carrier-free approaches usually employ coordination chemistry, molecular self-assembly, or peptide conjugation to ensure stable siRNA delivery, followed by intracellular dissociation or unpacking. In contrast, stimuli-responsive carriers leverage endogenous tumor cues (e.g., pH, GSH, specific enzymes, and ATP) or exogenous triggers (e.g., light, ultrasound, and magnetic fields) to achieve spatiotemporally controlled endosomal escape and cytosolic release, thereby increasing RISC loading and enhancing gene silencing. This review summarizes the major barriers and key methodologies for cytosolic siRNA delivery. Additionally, this review also highlights the applications of carrier-free systems and stimuli-responsive carriers in cancer therapy. Finally, discussions on key challenges and future directions for the clinical translation of siRNA-based anticancer strategies are also provided.

title: Interface-engineered nanoclay heterostructures with switchable ROS regulation for proactive physical-chemical-biological photoprotection 具有可切换活性氧调控能力的界面工程化纳米黏土异质结: 用于主动式物理-化学-生物协同光防护
abstract: Traditional mineral ultraviolet (UV) filters often suffer from restricted absorption spectra and the generation of secondary phototoxic reactive oxygen species (ROS), limiting their holistic biosafety. Herein, a proactive physical-chemical-biological synergistic photoprotection platform is architected by engineering a heterostructure of Mn 3 O 4 nanoparticles in-situ grown on natural halloysite nanotubes, coupled with luminal tannic acid (TA) loading (MHT composite). Interface engineering induces strong electronic coupling, evidenced by a distinct 1.4 eV positive shift in Mn 2p binding energy, which significantly facilitates charge separation and suppresses radiative electron-hole recombination. This unique architecture endows the composite with programmable ROS management, enabling switchable peroxidase-like and photocatalytic activities while inherently preventing secondary ROS generation. Biologically, the sustained release of TA profoundly modulates the inflammatory microenvironment. Under a high cumulative UV dose (2.52 × 10 6 J m −2 ) in vivo , the MHTS sunscreen cream demonstrates near-complete macroscopic photoprotection, substantially outperforming a commercial benchmark (Anessa) by maintaining near-normal epidermal thickness (15 µm vs. 26 µm) and critically mitigating hyperkeratosis (24% vs. 35% relative keratin area). Driven by potent tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) downregulation and targeted nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) antioxidant pathway activation, this work transcends the conventional passive blocking paradigm, providing a robust blueprint for advanced bio-interfacial materials in next-generation dermato-therapeutics.

title: Charge-transfer-coupled oligoindole composite as a low-cost anode interfacial layer for efficient organic solar cells 电荷转移耦合型低聚吲哚复合材料制备低成本阳极界面层实现高效有机太阳能电池
abstract: Anode interfacial layers (AILs) play a critical role in regulating hole extraction, interfacial recombination, and device stability in conventional organic solar cells (OSCs). Developing low-cost AILs that combine efficient interfacial charge regulation with good solution processability remains important for advancing OSCs toward practical application. A new charge-transfer-coupled oligoindole-based composite, denoted as PIn:PMA, was developed through phosphomolybdic acid (PMA)-initiated oxidative polymerization of indole. Notably, PIn:PMA combines facile synthesis and ambientstable powder storage with high optical transmittance, a favorable work function, and an ultralow working-solution cost of 1.35×10 −3 USD mL −1 . Moreover, PIn:PMA concurrently optimizes interfacial energetics and carrier dynamics, enabling more efficient charge collection and hole transport while suppressing bimolecular and trap-assisted recombination, lowering interfacial resistance, and strengthening the built-in electric field. Notably, PM6:L8-BO- and D18:L8-BO-based OSCs employing PIn:PMA achieve power conversion efficiencies of 18.51% and 20.45%, respectively, outperforming those of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrenesulfonate) (PEDOT:PSS)-based counterparts. This work demonstrates that charge-transfer-driven interfacial electronic regulation provides a practical route toward low-cost, highperformance AILs for OSCs.

title: Optoelectronic memristors based on ZnS-passivated CdZnSe quantum dots for neuromorphic synaptic emulation enabling information encryption 基于ZnS钝化CdZnSe量子点的光电忆阻器用于神经形态突触模拟及信息加密
abstract: Quantum dot (QD)-based optoelectronic memristors hold great promise for neuromorphic computing and bio-inspired vision systems. However, instability arising from surface defects in colloidal QD-based memristors severely limits their practical performance in neuromorphic vision applications. Here, we designed an optoelectronic memristor based on type-I band-aligned CdZnSe/ZnS core/shell QDs, in which the ZnS shell significantly enhances device performance by synergistically combining defect passivation and band engineering to passivate surface trap states and suppress non-radiative recombination through interfacial charge transfer. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that strongly polar Cd-S bonds are formed at the core/ shell interface, accompanied by a 0.87e charge transfer that effectively passivates surface defects and generates interfacial dipole fields. Experimental evidence further confirms that this interfacial effect directly governs threshold-voltage stabilization, reducing the standard deviation of threshold-voltage drift to 0.0214 V (mean 0.138 V). Simultaneously, it synergizes with quantum-confinement effects to reconstruct deep-level traps, extending non-volatile retention from 10 3 to 10 4 s. Furthermore, the interfacial dipole field assists the type-I band alignment in suppressing non-radiative recombination, yielding a thirty-fold increase in photocurrent density to 2.1 A cm -2 . The device successfully emulates brain-like functionalities such as excitatory postsynaptic current (EPSC) and paired-pulse facilitation (PPF). Moreover, it establishes a physical-layer encryption framework integrating optoelectronic synaptic devices with recurrent neural networks (RNNs), achieving high security and anti-interference capability. This work provides a scalable device solution for the synergistic optimization of QD-based memristor performance and offers key technical guidance for large-scale integration.

title: Synergistic spectral modulation and thermal management for multilayer visual/infrared camouflage composite with electromagnetic interference shielding capability 光谱调控与热管理协同的多层可见光/红外伪装电磁屏蔽复合材料
abstract: Modern reconnaissance systems integrate optical, infrared (IR), and radar technologies for cross-band cooperative detection, rendering multispectral camouflage essential for battlefield survivability. However, in complex or extreme operational environments, current camouflage materials remain limited by insufficient environmental stability, high weight, and inadequate mechanical flexibility, constraining their long-term and reliable performance. Herein, we design a multilayer composite consisting of a colorful yet IR-transparent visible reflection layer (VR), a low-emissivity (low- ε ) graphene (LEG) layer for bothIR camouflage and electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding, and an aramid nanofiber aerogel (ANF) layer for thermal insulation and flexibility. The VR layer provides widely tunable visible colors, enabling visual camouflage without disturbing the low- ε feature of the underlying LEG. The LEG layer provides both IR camouflage and EMI shielding capabilities, while the ANF aerogel reduces thermal conduction to the camouflage surface. Through the synergistic effect of thermal insulation and low- ε , the multilayer composite reduces the IR radiation intensity by 40% with tunable colors, efficiently realizing visual/IR dual-band camouflage. Furthermore, the multilayer composite demonstrates effective EMI shielding performance and environmental stability against corrosive media, including acid, alkaline, seawater, and organic environments. This work provides a novel strategy for environmentally robust multispectral camouflage materials suitable for harsh environments.

title: Large intrinsic piezoelectricity in intramolecular modified relaxor ferroelectric polymers near the morphotropic phase boundary 双键构筑诱导铁电聚合物高压电系数的准同型相界
abstract: 铁电聚合物中发现诱导高压电性的准同型相界(MPB)促使其压电系数 d 33 大幅提升至100 pC N −1 . 基于此, 本文报道了在碳碳双键改性的P(VDF-TrFE-CFE)三元弛豫铁电共聚物中构筑新型MPB, 并在相界附近发现了超高压电响应, d 33 高达−129.0 pC N −1 , 优于以往基于MPB策略获得结果. 正、 逆压电系数 d 33 测试结果相互支撑, 证实高 d 33 响应源自聚合物材料本征压电效应, 因此适用于无源机电转换应用场景. 本工作为研发新型高性能柔性可穿戴电子器件、 人形机器人触觉系统、 健康监测等提供了新思路.

title: A cartilage-inspired polymer cushion that stops brittle battery cathodes from cracking
Anion-engineered sequential Cs-salt treatment synergistically boosts the efficiency and stability of CsxFA1−xPbI3 perovskite solar cells 基于阴离子工程的分步铯盐处理协同提升CsxFA1−xPbI3钙钛矿太阳能电池的效率与稳定性
abstract: Homogeneous Cs-doping in Cs x FA 1− x PbI 3 perovskite is crucial for high photovoltaic performance. Going beyond conventional sequential Cs incorporation, which primarily addresses doping uniformity, we introduce an anion-engineered sequential treatment that leverages the chemical interaction between selected Cs-salt anions and the perovskite. While ensuring a uniform Cs + distribution, this approach concurrently slows crystal growth, passivates surface defects, aligns energy bands, and enhances hydrophobicity. We establish that the anion-perovskite interaction strength quantitatively governs crystallization kinetics, with PF 6 − inducing the strongest effect and yielding the largest grains and lowest defect density. Consequently, the best CsPF 6 -treated solar cell achieves a power conversion efficiency of 25.43%. Remarkably, the initial efficiency of the unencapsulated CsPF 6 -treated device retains 80% after 1735 h in ambient air (ISOS-D-1) and 830 h under continuous photothermal stress (ISOS-L-2), outperforming that of the conventional CsHCOO-treated device by more than a factor of two. This work provides a mechanistic framework for anion-directed interface design and delivers a simple yet powerful processing strategy for durable high-efficiency perovskite photovoltaics.

title: Recent advances in wood-based electromagnetic interference shielding materials 木基电磁屏蔽材料研究进展
abstract: High performance and sustainable shielding materials are in high demand for mitigating electromagnetic radiation. In recent years, wood-based shielding materials have been widely studied. However, there is still a lack of a new perspective to deeply understand the structure, properties and function relationships of micro-/nanostructures and components of natural wood, to explore the potential of EMI shielding materials with different dimensions. Emerging shielding materials have put forward high requirements for lightweight and functional integrity. Wood and its derivative materials in EMI shielding field have many advantages, including light weight, low cost, easy processing, natural porosity, pore structure adjustment and anisotropy. Herein, the research progress of the design and construction methods of shielding materials with wood as the main material in recent years is reviewed. The hierarchical structure and characteristics of natural wood, including cellulose and lignin are introduced. The latest research progress of wood-based metals, conductive polymers and carbon shielding materials, cellulosebased shielding materials, including layered structure films/papers, aerogels and hydrogels, and lignin and derived carbon shielding materials are reviewed. Finally, the problems, challenges and development trends of wood-based materials in electromagnetic shielding research are prospected, which provides a comprehensive reference for exploring biomass electromagnetic interference shielding materials.

title: Hierarchical MoS2 microspheres with strong absorption and ultra-broad bandwidth toward radar stealth and wireless communication 具有强吸收性和超宽带特性的MoS2微球在雷达隐身和无线通信中的应用
abstract: The rapid development of wireless communication, radar surveillance, and electronic countermeasure systems urgently requires high-performance electromagnetic materials that integrate strong microwave attenuation and broadband radiation capabilities. In this work, hierarchical 1T/2H coexisting molybdenum disulfide (MoS 2 ) nano-flower microspheres were synthesized via a facile hydrothermal method. The as-prepared material delivers excellent microwave absorption performance with a minimum reflection loss of -65.72 dB and an effective absorption bandwidth of 6.80 GHz covering the major X and Ku bands. Radar cross section (RCS) simulation results reveal its promising radar-stealth capability with a minimum RCS value of -36.69 dB m 2 . Taking advantage of its tunable dielectric-magnetic loss, MoS 2 composite substrates with different loading contents were further adopted to fabricate microwave devices. The constructed planar equiangular spiral antenna achieves broadband responses across the S-Ku bands and exhibits an ultra-wide 3-dB angular coverage of 122.3° in the S-band. Meanwhile, the absorptive Wilkinson power divider realizes stable power division within the X/Ku bands and achieves better stray-field suppression compared with traditional lossless substrates. This work demonstrates the great application potential of MoS 2 nano-flower microspheres for multifunctional microwave devices toward integrated radar-stealth and next-generation wireless communication systems.

title: Correction to: Investigation on graphene growth by roll-to-roll chemical vapor deposition (vol 65, issue 4, page 1042, 2022)
Gate-tunable PdSe2/WSe2 van der Waals heterostructures for ultrahigh light on-off ratio polarization-sensitive photodetection 栅压可调PdSe2/WSe2范德华异质结用于实现超高开关比偏振敏感光电探测
abstract: Narrow-bandgap two-dimensional materials, particularly palladium diselenide (PdSe 2 ), exhibit significant potential for integrated polarimetric photodetection owing to their highly anisotropic crystal structure and strongly polarization-dependent optical absorption. Despite substantial progress in PdSe 2 -based photodetectors, practical implementation remains limited by intrinsic drawbacks, including high electron-hole recombination rates and elevated intrinsic conductivity. These factors lead to large dark currents and necessitate external bias operation, thereby impeding high-performance polarization detection at room temperature. Here, we report a high-performance van der Waals heterojunction photodetector realized by integrating PdSe 2 with WSe 2 . The formation of an atomically clean interface with enhanced interlayer coupling yields a favorable type-I band alignment, enabling efficient photocarrier separation together with robust electrostatic tunability. As a result, the device exhibits an ultra-low dark current of ~10 −13 A and a high light on-off ratio of 4.3×10 5 . Notably, operating in the self-powered mode, the synergistic effect of the pronounced intrinsic linear dichroism of PdSe 2 and the clean heterointerface gives rise to a large dichroic ratio up to 55.38, markedly surpassing previously reported PdSe 2 -based architectures. This work not only establishes a high-performance platform for self-powered polarimetric photodetection but also highlights its potential for dual-channel polarization-encoded communication systems.

title: UV-assisted coaxial DIW 3D printing: a strategy for fabricating environmentally adaptive ionic hydrogel sensors 紫外光辅助同轴3D打印: 一种用于制备环境适应性离子水凝胶传感器的策略
abstract: Ionic conductive hydrogels have gained extensive attention in the field of intelligent sensing due to their good flexibility, tunable electrical conductivity, and multi-stimuli responsiveness. However, hydrogels easily freeze, dehydrate, or swell in external environments, thus losing their original structure and functions. Therefore, improving the environmental adaptability of conductive hydrogels remains a challenge. Herein, ionic hydrogels were encapsulated in real time via UV-assisted multi-material coaxial direct ink writing (DIW) 3D printing, and ionic conductive hydrogel sensors with array structures were prepared. The core ionic conductive hydrogel is isolated from the external environment by the hydrophobic photocurable polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) shell resin. The sensor exhibits excellent environmental adaptability with stable sensing performance after 60 days in dry environments or underwater, accurate temperature monitoring across a wide range of −20–120 °C, reliable sensing capabilities at both high and low temperatures, and stable application in acid, alkali, and organic solvents. This work proposes a simple strategy for fabricating a new type of ionically conductive hydrogel sensor, which overcomes the environmental application limitations of traditional hydrogel sensors.

title: Homogeneous dip-coating of ion-modulated self-assembled monolayers for large-area perovskite photovoltaics 离子调控自组装单分子层的浸涂制备及其大面积钙钛矿光伏应用
abstract: Self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) have emerged as highly effective hole-selective contacts for inverted perovskite solar cells, yet their scalable deposition on rough substrates remains challenging due to molecular aggregation, disordered packing, and incomplete adsorption. Herein, we propose a practical hybrid strategy for depositing high-quality, large-area SAMs by incorporating 4-(piperidin-4-yl)butanoic acid hydrochloride (PBACl) into the (4-(9′-Phenyl-9H,9′H-[3,3′-bicarbazol]-9-yl)butyl)phosphonic acid (4PABCz) solution during the scalable dip-coating process. This approach effectively inhibits molecular aggregation, yielding a homogeneous coverage with optimized substrate wettability. Concurrently, the piperidine and carboxyl groups of PBACl interact with perovskites via hydrogen bonding and coordination, which efficiently passivates buried interfacial defects. As a result, the small-area solar cells achieve a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.09%, while a scaled-up 5 cm × 5 cm mini-module (aperture area of 14.4 cm 2 ) delivers a remarkable PCE of 23.29%, validating the feasibility of this strategy for large-area fabrication. In addition to its high efficiency, the PBACl-modified device also exhibits excellent operational stability, with an encapsulated device maintaining 80% of its initial PCE after 1350 h maximum power point tracking under continuous light illumination. This work establishes an ion modulation strategy for bridging molecular-level interface control with scalable processing, providing a viable pathway toward industrially relevant perovskite photovoltaics.

title: Potential-dependent stability of iridium-cobalt oxide nanosheets for proton exchange membrane water electrolysis 铱钴氧化物纳米片的电位依赖稳定性及高性能质子交换膜水电解应用
abstract: Proton exchange membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE) demands highly active and durable oxygen evolution reaction (OER) catalysts under acidic conditions, yet iridium (Ir) scarcity limits large-scale application. Therefore, developing cost-effective Ir-based catalysts with enhanced utilization efficiency and durability is critically important. Here, we report an iridium-doped cobalt oxide nanosheet catalyst derived from a zeolitic imidazolate framework template. After carbon removal, the optimized catalyst exhibits an overpotential of 253 mV at 10 mA cm −2 in acidic media. In a PEMWE cell, the catalyst achieves a cell voltage of 1.635 V at 1 A cm −2 with an Ir loading of 0.4 mg cm −2 and sustains stable operation for over 2740 h with a voltage decay rate of 33.82 µV h −1 . Potential-dependent dissolution analysis reveals that catalyst dissolution is markedly suppressed under higher operating potentials. These findings elucidate the intrinsic relationship between catalyst stability and applied potential and can guide the rational design of stable electrocatalysts for diverse practical operating conditions.

title: Recent advances in electrically actuated functional materials for microrobot locomotion 电驱动功能材料在微型机器人运动领域的研究进展
abstract: Electrically actuated microrobots are promising for applications including environmental monitoring, miniature object manipulation, and exploration in confined or hazardous environments. Electrically actuated functional materials play a central role in this process, converting electrical energy into the mechanical work that powers microrobots. The electromechanical performance of these materials directly governs the microrobots’ key locomotion capabilities, including obstacle-crossing ability and energy efficiency. Furthermore, the distinct electromechanical properties of different material types also determine their applicability to specific locomotion modes. Focusing on various electrically actuated functional materials, this review systematically investigates the intrinsic coupling mechanisms between their electromechanical performance parameters and the diverse locomotion modes of microrobots, thereby identifying the current performance boundaries in this field. Finally, we summarize the challenges and future trends in microrobot locomotion to help researchers set their research direction and goals.

title: Enhanced γ-ray detection performance of Cs3Cu2I5 single crystals via suppression of second-phase formation 通过抑制第二相的形成改善Cs3Cu2I5单晶的γ射线探测性能
abstract: Single-crystalline Cs 3 Cu 2 I 5 has attracted considerable interest owing to its excellent scintillation performance and favorable stability. Nevertheless, second phases induced by peritectic reactions during melt growth give rise to deteriorated scintillation properties and promote crystal cracking. In this work, the effects of non-stoichiometric ratios of raw material ( n (CsI) = 0.57, 0.62, and 0.63) on the crystallization behavior and scintillation properties were systematically investigated. The results show that the crystal quality is optimal at n (CsI) = 0.62, featuring high transparency, absence of macroscopic inclusions, and crack-free, with a PLQY of 79.3%. Temperature-dependent photoluminescence verifies the self-trapped exciton emission mechanism with strong ex-citon-phonon coupling, giving an exciton binding energy of 473.9 meV and a Huang-Rhys factor S of 79.8. The as-grown crystal exhibits an optimized light yield of 24,380 photons/MeV, an energy resolution of 3.8% for 137 Cs (662 keV) γ-rays, a dominant decay time of 957 ns, and excellent linear response in the medium-to-high energy region. Precise regulation of the raw material stoichiometry can effectively suppress the formation of second phases, yielding high-quality Cs 3 Cu 2 I 5 single crystals whose comprehensive performance demonstrates promising application potential in γ-ray detection.

title: Mismatching in meso-/microscopic orientation drives optical anisotropy to unlock multicolor nonreciprocal circularly polarized luminescence in chiral polymer elastomeric films 介观/微观取向失配驱动聚合物弹性体薄膜中的光学各向异性并解锁手性多色非互易圆偏振发光
abstract: Thin films with nonreciprocal circularly polarized luminescence (CPL) emit circularly polarized light with opposite handedness from their two opposite sides, holding great promise for advancing optical multiplexing technologies. Herein, we introduce component orientation mismatch into chiral composite films via stretching, which leads to macroscopic optical anisotropy and accordingly drives the films to show nonreciprocal CPL activity. Stretching triggers linear dichroism-linear birefringence (LD-LB) coupling to realize nonreciprocal circular dichroism (CD) in elastomer films consisting of thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) and chiral polyacetylene ( R / S -PSA). Moreover, fluorescence anisotropy-linear birefringence ( f -LB) coupling occurs after introducing fluorescent groups into the films to achieve multi-color nonreciprocal CPL. The unstretched films exhibit reciprocal CPL with a luminescence dissymmetry factor (∣ g lum ∣) of 10 −1 , with handedness determined by PSA’s intrinsic helical chirality. In the stretched films, the oriented fluorescent groups undergo f -LB coupling with matrix crystallization, resulting in nonreciprocal CPL (∣ g lum ∣=10 −2 ). Based on this distinctive chiroptical feature, we have developed chiral logic gates, multidimensional optical encryption systems, and enantioselective photopolymerization platforms to demonstrate the potential uses of the as-obtained CPL films. This work provides both fundamental insights into and a versatile material platform for developing smart nonreciprocal photonic systems with advanced chiroptical functionality.

title: Dual-modulation of carbon coating and high-valence Nb5+ doping toward high-performance Na3V2(PO4)2O2F 包覆与高价态Nb5+掺杂对Na3V2(PO4)2O2F的双重调控策略及电化学性能
abstract: Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 2 O 2 F (NVPOF)具有较高的理论比容量、 高能量密度以及结构可调性, 被认为是极具潜力的钠离子电池正极材料. 然而, 其本征电子电导率较低、 Na + 扩散动力学缓慢, 仍制约其实际应用. 为解决上述问题, 本工作采用水热法合成了Nb掺杂并经聚多巴胺包覆的Na 3 V 1.94 Nb 0.06 (PO 4 ) 2 O 2 F@PDA正极材料(记为NVPOF-Nb-C). Nb掺杂能够稳定晶体结构并优化Na + 传输通道, 从而加速Na + 扩散; 同时引入的Nb–O键有助于缓解循环过程中结构退化. 另一方面, 由聚多巴胺(PDA)衍生的均匀导电碳骨架进一步提升了电子传输能力. 电化学测试结果表明, NVPOF-Nb-C在0.5 C下的初始放电比容量为134.5 mAh g −1 ; 在1 C条件下循环700次后容量保持率约为97.12%; 在20 C条件下循环7000次后仍保持91.08%的容量, 表现出优异的倍率性能与超长循环稳定性. 密度泛函理论计算表明, 高价态Nb 5+ 的引入可改善电子传输并增强结构稳定性并降低Na + 迁移能垒. 其与硬碳(HC)负极匹配组装的全 电池(NVPOF-Nb-C//HC)在1 C下可获得130.3 mAh g −1 的可逆容量与487.2 Wh kg −1 的能量密度, 并在20 C下循环3000次后容量保持率仍达91.51%, 展现出优异的长循环稳定性. 本工作为高性能钠离子电池正极材料的设计提供了一种可行策略.

title: Ammonium vanadate cathodes in aqueous zinc-ion batteries: design strategies and research progress 水系锌离子电池中钒酸铵阴极的设计策略及研究进展
abstract: Abstract Aqueous zinc-ion batteries (AZIBs) have attracted increasing attention as promising candidates for large-scale energy storage, owing to their high safety, environmental friendliness, and abundant zinc resources. Nevertheless, the development of high-performance AZIBs is constrained by cathode materials. Traditional cathode materials suffer from structural collapse, slow ion diffusion, and poor conductivity. In contrast, ammonium vanadates (AVOs) are being widely applied due to their unique structural advantages and higher Zn 2+ diffusion coefficients. This review focuses on the recent advancements in AVOs as high-performance cathode materials for AZIBs, analyzing the morphological variations among different AVOs and comparing their structural and electrochemical characteristics to elucidate the underlying structure-performance relationships. Moreover, key strategies to optimize their electrochemical performance are systematically discussed, such as defect engineering, interlayer spacing modulation, and composite construction with conductive materials. Finally, the review outlines current challenges and future research directions for advancing AVOs’ cathodes in practical AZIBs applications.

title: Crumpled and multi-scale porous Fe-N-C catalyst with enhanced site accessibility and mass transport in oxygen reduction 褶皱多尺度孔道结构Fe-N-C催化剂提升氧还原反应 的活性位点可及性与物质传输性能
abstract: 无铂族金属Fe-N-C催化剂是替代铂基催化剂用于氧还原反应的 理想候选催化剂, 但该类催化剂普遍存在活性位点利用率低、物质传 输能力差等问题, 严重制约其催化性能. 本文通过喷雾热解结合高温金 属刻蚀法, 制备了一种以褶皱多孔石墨烯为载体的Fe-N-C单原子催化 剂. 材料独特的褶皱形貌与丰富的面内孔结构产生协同效应, 有效提升 了活性位点可及性并加快反应过程中的物质传输. 原位亚硝酸盐溶出 测试结果表明, 该催化剂具有较高的活性位点密度(2.74×10 19 sites g −1 ) 与铁原子利用率(51.7%). 旋转圆盘电极测试显示, 其半波电位可达 0.91 V; 气体扩散电极及锌空气电池测试进一步证实, 该催化剂具备优 异的大电流工况适配能力. 本研究提出的形貌与孔结构一体化调控策 略, 为高性能无铂族金属催化剂的结构优化及其在实际能源转化装置 中的应用提供了高效可行的方案

title: Dual-mode and cross-scale energy dissipation in densified carbon nanotube films for extreme dynamic protection 用于极端动态保护的致密碳纳米管薄膜的双模和跨 尺度能量耗散
abstract: The development of advanced protective materials is hindered by the inherent trade-offs among low density, high specific strength, and efficient energy absorption, particularly under extreme dynamic loading. Here, we propose that the mass density of carbon nanotube (CNT) assemblies serves as a master switch governing their dynamic energy dissipation pathways. Through spark plasma sintering (SPS), we achieve precise and continuous tuning of CNT film density from 1.43 to 1.70 g cm −3 . We demonstrate that density not only greatly enhances the intrinsic properties of the films (achieving an electrical conductivity of 8.09 × 10 4 S m −1 , a 97.8% increase compared with the pristine CNT film, and a 1019% increase in hardness from 0.26 GPa of the pristine CNT films to 2.91 GPa of the SPS-CNT films) but, more importantly, dictates the impact response mode. Within an optimal density window, the films exhibit a unique dual-mode dissipation mechanism: at low-to-moderate velocities (⩽200 m s −1 ), synergistic interlayer friction and CNT buckling yield an exceptional specific energy absorption ( E p ) of 1.4–1.8 MJ kg −1 ; at higher velocities (>250 m s −1 ), density regulates the balance between energy transmission and dissipation, enabling a tunable transition from rebound to penetration. This density-governed performance modulation allows SPS-CNT films to surpass conventional metals, polymers, and other carbon-based materials in the lightweight-strong-energy-absorbing design space. Our work establishes a materials-by-design paradigm where a single processing parameter (density) programs the dynamic behavior of carbon nanostructures, paving the way for adaptive protection systems in aerospace and defense applications.

title: MRI-compatible flexible neuroelectronics with bio-adaptive interfaces for brain spatiotemporal analysis at ultra-high magnetic fields 基于组织适配界面的超高场磁共振兼容柔性神经电 子器件用于脑功能时空联合分析
abstract: Achieving synchronous neural recording during magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for high temporal-spatial resolution brain analysis and diagnosis, but conventional devices induce imaging artifacts and radio-frequency heating. Here, we report MRI-compatible neuroelectronics (MRI-FNe) with bio-adaptive interfaces. Leveraging elastic on-skin and rough implantable recording interfaces, MRI-FNe can adapt to skin and intracranial tissue, forming large-area, stable dry contacts through simple pressure that fills skin texture. In contrast, the high surface area of implantable ones enables low-impedance in vivo interfaces—both achieving impedance reductions of over tenfold compared to gold films and spin-coated polymer electrodes. Based on these bio-adaptive interfaces, combining proper conductivity and a magnetic susceptibility close to the human body, we achieve artifact-free, safe, and high-fidelity MRI-synchronized neuroelectric signal recording at ultra-high magnetic fields in various scenarios, overcoming the limitations of traditional devices. We demonstrate MRI-FNe for 9.4 T implantable and 3 T on-skin MRI-synchronized recordings across rodents and humans, enabling spatiotemporal joint analysis of brain function with potential for neuroscience and clinical translation.

title: Strain-engineered Ir-based nano-alloys for enhanced acidic oxygen evolution reaction 应变工程Ir基纳米合金促进酸性析氧反应
