abstract: Surface strain effects play a crucial role in modulating the catalytic properties of electrocatalysts towards the acidic oxygen evolution reaction (OER). However, most existing catalytic systems primarily focus on electronic effects, making the accurate interpretation of strain effects a long-standing challenge. In this study, a series of Ir-M nanoalloys (M = Fe, Co, Ni) with tunable compressive strain was synthesized via an impregnation-reduction method. Experimental results reveal that the compressive strain in Ir-M alloys increases as the atomic radius of the 3d transition metals decreases, accompanied by a gradual downshift of the d-band center. Notably, IrCo/C exhibits an optimal d-band center, which corresponds to the optimal adsorption strength for reaction intermediates during the OER process. As a result, IrCo/C exhibits optimal acidic OER catalytic performance, with an overpotential of only 271 mV at a current density of 10 mA cm −2 . Additionally, IrCo/C exhibits remarkable catalytic long-term durability. This work provides fundamental guidance for the rational design of strain-engineered catalysts, providing general principles for subsequent research in this field.

title: Atomically coherent boundaries unlock solid state proton spillover for efficient photocatalytic H2 evolution 原子级相干界面解锁质子溢流促进高效光催化析氢
abstract: Photocatalytic hydrogen evolution fundamentally requires synchronized proton-coupled electron transfer. However, traditional multiphase architectures predominantly optimize spatial charge separation while systematically neglecting localized proton delivery, inherently creating a severe kinetic bottleneck. Herein, we engineer a highly coherent ZnCdS/ZnCo 2 S 4 (ZnCdS/ZnCoS) heterojunction featuring an ultralow lattice mismatch of merely 2.96% to construct an efficient bioinspired catalytic cascade. This precise atomic registry establishes a three-fold synergistic effect. First, rapid hole extraction on ZnCdS drives highly selective (94.8%) benzyl alcohol (BA) oxidation, effectively circumventing deleterious overoxidation. Second, a robust internal electric field accelerates photogenerated electrons toward the metallic ZnCoS domains. Third, a distinct thermodynamic gradient establishes a highly conductive solid-state conduit, propelling surface protons to migrate strictly along the structurally coherent interface. Rigorous multidimensional validations, including kinetic isotope effect measurements and in situ infrared spectroscopy, clearly demonstrate this directed proton spillover pathway culminating at the cobalt coordination sites. Consequently, this precise spatiotemporal colocalization effectively addresses the kinetic mismatch, achieving unprecedented hydrogen and benzaldehyde (BAD) evolution rates of 84.3 and 75.1 mmol g −1 h −1 , respectively. This work establishes coherent interface engineering as a universal paradigm for synchronizing electron routing and proton spillover in advanced energy catalysis.

title: Recent progress in anti-ablation C/C composites for extreme conditions: material optimization, structural design and performance evaluation 极端条件下抗烧蚀C/C复合材料的最新进展: 材料优化、结构设计和性能评估
abstract: The ongoing evolution of aerospace vehicles is driving the demand for high-performance hot-end components capable of enduring extreme environments. Carbon/carbon (C/C) composites, as a typical representative of high-temperature structural materials, possess advantages such as low density, high specific strength, and excellent high temperature stability, making them irreplaceable materials for application in thermal protection and propulsion systems. However, the tendency to oxidize carbon materials at high temperatures limits their mechanical robustness, which constrains their broader development and applications. Through implementing performance optimization strategies targeting both material and structural, the oxidation and ablation resistance of C/C composites can be significantly improved. This review systematically summarizes the latest research progress of anti-ablation C/C composites for extreme conditions, following the logical framework of “material optimization-structural design-performance evaluation”, focusing on the material optimization strategies and structural design methods of C/C composites, and then the research status of typical simulated special-shaped component evaluation. Finally, the key scientific issues and future development trends of advanced C/C composites are prospected, aiming to provide a comprehensive technical reference for the development and engineering application of C/C composites in extreme conditions.

title: Facilitated diffusion of organic ammonium salts via OD-induced porous PbI2 for efficient two-step inverted perovskite solar cells 通过OD诱导的多孔PbI2促进有机铵盐扩散用于高效 两步法反式钙钛矿太阳能电池
abstract: The pre-deposited lead iodide (PbI 2 ) film in two-step inverted perovskite solar cells (PSCs) often exhibits a dense structure, which impedes the diffusion and reaction of organic ammonium salts, leading to unreacted PbI 2 residues and compromised device performance. To address this, 2,4-oxazolidinedione (OD) is introduced as a molecular additive into the PbI 2 precursor solution. Owing to its stronger coordination with PbI 2 , OD effectively modulates its crystallization behavior, resulting in a porous structure. This porous structure significantly facilitates the diffusion and infiltration of organic ammonium salts, thereby minimizing PbI 2 residue and enhancing the completeness of the perovskite conversion. Furthermore, OD and the constructed porous network jointly retard the crystallization kinetics of perovskite, promoting the formation of perovskite films with improved crystallinity and preferred crystal orientation. Therefore, the optimized PSCs achieve a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.31% and demonstrate excellent operational stability, retaining 90.24% for 1500 h at 25 °C and 90.47% for 1000 h at 65 °C of their initial PCE after maximum power point tracking (MPPT), respectively. This work offers a viable approach for optimizing the two-step sequential deposition process and constructing high-performance inverted PSCs through microstructure regulation of PbI 2 .

title: Nanovesicle-hybridized hydrogels: construction, functionalization, and biomedical applications 纳米囊泡杂化水凝胶: 构建、功能化及生物医学应用
abstract: Nanovesicle-hybridized hydrogels represent a sophisticated class of bioactive materials that synergistically integrate the structural stability of polymer networks with the intrinsic biological functions of nanoscale vesicles. While conventional hydrogels often face challenges such as swelling-induced mechanical degradation, uncontrollable cargo release, and difficulties in integrating multiple bioactivities, the strategic hybridization with nanovesicles offers a robust solution to these limitations. This review systematically delineates the evolution of construction strategies, transitioning from simple physical entrapment to advanced chemical crosslinking involving noncovalent supramolecular interactions and covalent conjugation. We further elucidate how these integration methods fundamentally enhance mechanical strength, enable spatiotemporally controlled release of vesicles and their cargos, and endow the composite systems with multifaceted bioactivities. The diverse biomedical applications of these hybridized platforms in drug delivery, tissue engineering, and disease therapy are thoroughly discussed. Finally, current technical hurdles in clinical translation and promising future directions are identified, providing a roadmap for the next generation of intelligent biomimetic materials.

title: A thermally driven sacrificial template strategy for the universal preparation of two-dimensional carbon materials 热驱动牺牲模板策略用于二维碳材料的普适性制备
abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) carbon materials hold great potential in various applications, yet their design is severely hindered by the bottlenecks of stringent precursor dependency and structural homogeneity. Herein, we report a universal, scale-independent, thermally driven strategy for fabricating diverse 2D carbon materials utilizing thiourea (TU) as an in situ sacrificial template. During pyrolysis, the in situ polycondensation of TU forms a layered skeleton, which acts as a structural template to confine the 2D rearrangement of precursor-derived intermediates. With sacrificial decomposition of the TU-derived template at elevated temperature, the intermediates can be converted into 2D architectures. Consequently, this strategy bridges the scale gap from simple organic molecules to complex microscale precursors, enabling the customized preparation of a series of 2D carbon architectures from heteroatom-doped nanosheets to super-hierarchical metal sulfide-decorated sheet-like network-structured carbon. When evaluated as a sulfur host and functional interlayer in lithium-sulfur batteries, the resulting material mitigates kinetic limitations, delivering an exceptional rate capability of 735 mA h g −1 at 10 C and robust cycling stability. This work provides a versatile spatial confinement paradigm for designing advanced 2D carbon nanomaterials.

title: Gold clusterzyme-engineered bioelectronic dressing for precisely guiding scarless tissue regeneration 基于金簇酶的电活性敷料及其精准调控组织无瘢痕再生机制
abstract: Electrical stimulation offers a powerful strategy to mimic endogenous bioelectricity and accelerate complex tissue regeneration like chronic wound healing. However, aligning external stimulation with native bioelectrical and biochemical signals for rapid and scarless tissue regeneration remains challenging. Herein, a wireless bioelectronic dressing (E-dressing) is developed to establish stable bioelectronic interfaces and precisely modulate cellular physiological activities. Specifically, bioactive allylamine-functionalized gold clusterzymes (AM-AuNCs) with intrinsic superoxide dis-mutase-like activity are designed as functional modifiers to co-polymerize with acrylic acid (AA), forming conductive p(AA-AuNCs) hydrogels. AM-AuNCs impart the hydrogel with superior antioxidant activity, robust interfacial adhesion and high conductivity, enabling rapid hemostasis, efficient electrical stimulation transmission and precise fibroblast regulation. p(AA-AuNCs) hydrogel combined with 1.00 V of electrical stimulation can significantly promote the proliferation, migration and alignment of fibroblasts by upregulating TGF-β, FGF-2 and EGF. Upon integrating with a biocompatible and flexible zinc-ion battery capable of delivering sustained and tunable electrical signal for over 7 days, the resulting E-dressing can precisely guide collagen remodeling, inhibit myofibroblast activation and maintain Col I/Col III balance, leading to a 5-fold acceleration of wound closure and 65.5% reduction in scar formation. This multifunctional E-dressing represents a promising bioelectronic device for precise cellular regulation and multimodal regenerative therapy.

title: Asymmetric end-group strategy for three-dimensional dimeric acceptors enabling efficient organic solar cells 基于三维二聚电子受体的不对称端基策略实现高效 有机太阳电池
abstract: Dimeric acceptors are intrinsically advantageous in terms of device stability. However, they generally exhibit moderate power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) and are prone to suboptimal nanoscale morphology, which collectively impede their development in organic solar cells. Herein, we present two asymmetric dimeric acceptors, CH8-15 and CH8-16, which were rationally designed via the asymmetric end-group functionalization of a two-dimensional extended dimer platform. By precisely modulating the steric configurations, CH8-16, which exists as a mixture of three configurational isomers, displays a reduced overall dipole moment yet demonstrates substantially enhanced molecular crystallinity and packing order relative to CH8-15. The PM6:CH8-16 binary device delivers a PCE of 17.44%, surpassing that of the PM6: CH8-15-based device (16.86%), with the improvement primarily originating from an enhanced fill factor. More significantly, the incorporation of CH8-16 as a third component into the PM6:L8-BO host system affords a ternary device achieving an outstanding PCE of 19.73%, accompanied by superior exciton dynamics and optimized morphology. Furthermore, the blend of CH8-16 and L8-BO substantially enhances both thermal and photo-stability of the corresponding devices. This work establishes that the asymmetric end-group strategy offers an effective molecular design path for developing efficient dimeric acceptors.

title: Rational design of oxygen electrocatalysts guided by reaction intermediates 基于反应中间体的氧电催化剂的定向设计
abstract: With the growing shortage of fossil energy and worsening environmental pollution, the development of efficient and green energy conversion and storage technologies has become a global priority. The oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) and oxygen evolution reaction (OER) serve as the core reactions of cutting-edge energy devices, including water electrolysis systems, fuel cells, and metal-air batteries. Both reactions suffer from sluggish reaction kinetics and high overpotential, and high-performance oxygen electrocatalysts are urgently required to address these technical bottlenecks. Numerous studies have demonstrated that the adsorption, transformation, and desorption behaviors of key reaction intermediates such as *OH, *O, and *OOH are the core factors determining the activity and stability of oxygen electrocatalysts. Although in-depth mechanistic research and targeted modulation strategies focused on oxygen electrocatalytic intermediates have been widely reported, systematic and comprehensive summaries remain limited. Centering on reaction intermediates, this review systematically elaborates the action mechanisms of intermediates during ORR/OER processes. It emphatically summarizes advanced in-situ detection technologies and characterization methods for reaction intermediates, and comprehensively discusses mainstream modulation strategies. The current challenges in this research field are analyzed, and future research prospects are proposed. This work is expected to provide theoretical references for the rational design and in-depth mechanistic exploration of high-efficiency oxygen electrocatalysts.

title: Stabilizing high-entropy substrates and tailoring interfacial water: high-valent Pt single atoms drive durable propylene epoxidation 稳定高熵化合物和调控界面水: 高价铂单原子驱动持久的丙烯环氧化
abstract: Electrochemical propylene epoxidation offers a sustainable route to propylene oxide (PO), but achieving high selectivity and stability under industrial current densities remains challenging. Herein, we report a high-entropy amorphous CoFeNiCrMnBO x borate loaded with a high-valence Pt single-atom catalyst (a-Pt-HEBO) for stable bromine radical-mediated propylene epoxidation reaction (BrPOR). The high-entropy amorphous structure reshapes the interfacial hydrogen-bonding network and enriches free water, substantially lowering the energy barrier for water dissociation. Meanwhile, the strong electronic interactions between the coordinatively unsaturated, high-valence single Pt atoms and the substrate effectively prevent transition metal dissolution at high anodic potentials. The catalyst achieved 82.1% Faraday efficiency of PO at an industrial-grade current density of 100 mA cm −2 , and demonstrated excellent industrial application stability in up to 500 h of continuous testing and within a scaled-up electrolyzer (4 cm×4 cm). This work provides a design for high-entropy catalysts in halogen-mediated electrosynthesis and a viable pathway toward carbon-neutral PO production.

title: New stage for generating circularly polarized light: circularly polarized optical filters 圆偏振光产生的新阶段: 圆偏振滤光材料
abstract: Circularly polarized optical filters (CPOFs) have been developed to generate high-purity circularly polarized (CP) light in recent years. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on intrinsically chiral emitters to directly produce CP light, CPOFs enhance the polarization purity of emitted light by chirally filtering unpolarized light, thereby enabling CP luminescence with dissymmetry factors approaching the theoretical limit (∣ g lum ∣ up to 2). According to their working mechanisms, currently reported CPOF materials can be broadly classified into two categories. One is cholesteric liquid crystal filtering systems based on selective reflection arising from photonic bandgap structures, while the other consists of chiral filtering materials based on circular dichroism absorption. Because the CPOF strategy does not rely on intrinsically chiral emitters, it exhibits excellent universality and practical applicability, and can be readily integrated with a wide range of luminescent systems. In this review, we present a systematic overview of recent advances in CPOFs for CP light generation from the unified perspective of “circular polarization filtering”. We particularly focus on cholesteric liquid crystals, lyotropic liquid crystals, and chiral absorption-based materials. Their structural design principles and operating mechanisms are also discussed, providing new insights for the development of CP luminescence systems.

title: Engineering multifunctional nano-PROTACs platforms for precision cancer therapy 工程化多功能nano-PROTACs平台用于癌症精准治疗
abstract: Conventional cancer therapies often struggle with undruggable oncogenic proteins and acquired resistance. Proteolysis targeting chimeras (PROTACs) have emerged as a transformative therapeutic modality that harnesses the ubiquitin proteasome system to selectively degrade target proteins, offering clear advantages over traditional small-molecule inhibitors. However, the broad application of PROTACs is hindered by intrinsic physicochemical limitations, including high molecular weight, poor bioavailability and a lack of tumor-specific delivery. To address these challenges, the integration of PROTACs with nanotechnology has paved the way for advanced nano-PROTACs platforms. Nanocarriers enhance solubility and stability, optimize pharmacokinetics, and enable spatiotemporally controlled drug release through passive or active targeting. This review systematically summarizes recent advances in engineering multifunctional nano-PROTACs for cancer therapy, with particular emphasis on the design strategies by which nano engineering enhances PROTACs’ performance. We evaluate how these platforms improve anticancer efficacy and minimize systemic toxicity while exploring their therapeutic potential in both monotherapy and synergistic treatment settings. Finally, we discuss current challenges and future perspectives, providing a theoretical and technical foundation for the development of next-generation nano-PROTACs as a precise and potent strategy in the landscape of precision oncology.

title: A scalable superhydrophobic zero-dimensional hybrid copper(I) halide for solid-state lighting and multifunctional X-ray imaging 一种可规模化制备的超疏水零维亚铜基杂化卤化物,用于固态照明与多功能X射线成像
abstract: Metal-halide X-ray scintillators show great potential in medical diagnosis, nondestructive inspection, security checking, and space exploration. However, the poor water stability and humidity-induced decomposition of conventional scintillators remain major obstacles for next-generation X-ray imaging. Herein, we report a nontoxic zero-dimensional (0D) organic–inorganic hybrid copper(I) halide scintillator (Cu 2 I 2 (C 26 H 36 NP) 2 , termed Compound G by a facile room-temperature solution method. Bulk hydrophobic phosphine ligands endow the scintillator with exceptional superhydrophobicity and outstanding water stability, retaining 91.95% luminescence after 30 days of water immersion. Furthermore, the flexible polymer styrene-ethylene-butene-styrene (SEBS)-based scintillator screen exhibits excellent radiation robustness with a high light yield of ∼32500 photons MeV −1 , a spatial resolution of 19.14 lp mm −1 , and a low detection limit of 0.8 µGy air s −1 . Impressively, it enables stable and clear X-ray imaging under flexible, high-temperature, and underwater conditions, effectively eliminating vignetting and distortion in nonplanar objects. This work highlights the superior environmental robustness of this waterproof copper halide scintillator, paving the way for its versatile applications in harsh-environment X-ray imaging.

title: Dynamically color-tunable electroluminescent fiber device achieving 131.07% sRGB color gamut coverage 实现131.07% sRGB色域覆盖的动态颜色可调电致发 光纤维器件
abstract: Flexible and weavable alternating-current electroluminescent (ACEL) fiber devices enable applications in wearable displays and efficient human-computer interfaces. However, their lack of color tunability largely limits the application scope for high-density information interactions. Here, we present a dynamically color-tunable electroluminescent fiber device with a unique coaxial winding structure integrating multiple fiber electrodes that emit the three primary colors. Through simple voltage driving, this electroluminescent fiber device achieves a color gamut covering 131.07% of the sRGB standard, enabling arbitrary full-color tunability like standard white light with CIE (the Commission Internationale de l’Eclairage) coordinate of (0.31, 0.33). The light emission peak is continuously tunable over a wide range of 161.7 nm, resulting in a 4-fold enhancement as compared with that of the previously reported ACEL fibers. The coaxial winding structure is compatible with large-scale fabrication, yielding fiber devices on a hundred-meter scale with a luminance variation of 2.76%. Their EL performance remains stable under strict industrial standards, including 10,000 friction cycles, 20 accelerated washing cycles, and 10-d storage at 105 and −20 °C. These fiber devices are integrated into smart textile watchband as an effective human-computer interface, enabling real-time heart rate visualization through progress color changes and gesture-controlled color switching.

title: Upgrading electrocatalytic nitrate reduction reaction: expanding product diversity and economic profitability 电催化硝酸盐还原反应产物多元化与经济效益提升 策略
abstract: Given the limited product variety of the electrocatalytic nitrate reduction reaction (NO 3 − RR), it is desirable to expand the product scope by introducing additional reactants that couple with highly reactive intermediates (*NH 2 , *NH, *NO) generated during NO 3 − RR. This approach achieves product diversification (e.g., urea, amines, amino acids) and significantly enhances the economic value. Meanwhile, the sluggish anodic oxygen evolution reaction (OER) with a high overpotential limits the overall reaction efficiency of NO 3 − RR. Replacing the sluggish OER with kinetically more favorable reactions can effectively overcome this kinetic limitation while concurrently producing value-added oxidation products. This review begins with a systematic analysis of strategies for expanding the product scope of the NO 3 − RR. It then discusses the current status of low-overpotential anode substitution strategies and paired electrolysis technologies. The economic effectiveness of the above different strategies is subsequently analyzed. Finally, we highlight the primary challenges and propose promising research directions moving forward in this field. This study aims to offer theoretical support and development guidance for broadening nitrate reduction products and enhancing the economic viability of the process.

title: Progress in joining technology for thermoelectric devices 热电器件连接技术进展
abstract: Thermoelectric (TE) devices enable direct and reversible conversion between thermal and electrical energy, offering significant advantages as solid-state energy conversion technologies for power generation and precision cooling. Their applications span from extreme-environment power supplies to wearable electronics, where the reliability and efficiency of the devices critically depend on the quality of joining interfaces between TE materials and electrodes. As the research focus shifts from material development to device-level integration, understanding and optimizing joining technologies have become essential. This review systematically examines the recent advances in TE device joining techniques, including brazing and soldering, diffusion bonding, transient liquid phase joining, nano-silver sintering, and emerging flexible interconnection methods. Emphasis is placed on the principles, interfacial design strategies, and performance-limiting factors of each method, particularly regarding thermal stress, elemental interdiffusion, and long-term reliability. By integrating insights from advanced electronic packaging and interface science, this review provides a focused perspective for understanding and optimizing joining technologies, which are critical to the long-term stability of TE devices. Finally, we provide a perspective on future research directions in joining technologies to further enhance the service reliability of TE devices under complex operating conditions.

title: Boosting the brightness of NIR-II AIE nanoprobes via molecular engineering for intraoperative navigation of orthotopic colorectal cancer 分子工程增强NIR-II AIE纳米探针荧光亮度用于原位结直肠癌术中导航
abstract: Fluorescence image-guided surgery (FIGS) in the NIR-II window (1000–1700 nm) holds great promise for precise tumor resection, yet current clinically available fluorophores such as indocyanine green (ICG) suffer from suboptimal brightness and photostability in this spectral region, highlighting the urgent need for high-performance alternatives. Here, we report a robust NIR-II organic fluorescent probe based on an exemplary aggregation-induced emission (AIE) molecular scaffold, developed through a simple yet effective molecular design strategy leveraging linear alkyl engineering. Systematic elongation of linear alkyl side chains increases intermolecular distances to suppress potential π–π stacking and creates a hydrophobic nanoconfined microenvironment that minimizes interference from polar physiological water, collectively boosting both the molar extinction coefficient ( ε ) and quantum yield ( Φ ). This strategy differs from conventional approaches that optimize ε × Φ by modulating the balance between molecular planarity and distortion. Moreover, this linear alkyl chain engineering strategy offers greater applicability and adoption potential than branched alkyl chain engineering tactics. The optimized nanoprobe, TT16-B NPs, exhibits nearly twofold higher brightness than its parent counterpart, along with excellent photostability, favorable tumor accumulation, and good bio-compatibility. These advantages enable ultrabright TT16-B NPs to achieve high-contrast tumor imaging with tumor-to-background ratios exceeding 6.6, allowing accurate intraoperative delineation and radical resection of orthotopic colorectal cancer (CRC) under real-time NIR-II fluorescence guidance. This work represents the first example of AIEgen-based NIR-II FIGS for CRC, and offers a general approach to enhance the brightness of NIR-II fluorophores by readily incorporating long linear alkyl chains into their structures.

title: Soft liquid-metal junctions with photoinduced floating gates for tunable photodetection and rectification 用于可调光电探测和整流的光致浮栅软液态金属结
abstract: Heterojunction-based photodetectors and rectifiers are essential optoelectronic devices widely used in optical communication, imaging, and sensing systems. However, their performance generally depends on specially designed functional materials and fixed device architectures, limiting post-fabrication tunability. Here, we present a liquid-metal platform in which an eutectic gallium-indium alloy (EGaIn) tip is directly contacted with a metal-coated Si substrate, enabling in situ tuning of photodetection and rectification without customized functional layers or complex fabrication. Benefiting from the conformal soft contact and the ultrathin native Ga 2 O 3 tunneling barrier of EGaIn, the junction properties can be continuously modulated by precisely controlling the contact area. As the contact area increases fivefold, the positive photocurrent is enhanced by up to 80-fold, whereas the negative photocurrent remains close to the dark-current level. Meanwhile, the rectification ratio can be tuned over more than three orders of magnitude, and the rectification polarity can be reversed with increasing bias. Further analysis reveals that these behaviors originate from a substrate-integrated photoinduced floating-gate effect, in which photogenerated carriers accumulated at the Si/metal interface dynamically modulate the local metal potential and tunneling barrier, eliminating the need for physically isolated floating-gate layers. This work establishes a facile strategy for dynamically tunable optoelectronics through contact engineering and substrate-integrated floating-gate modulation, providing a proof-of-concept platform for exploring tunable optoelectronic functionalities.

title: Silanol interface engineering via freeze-drying constructs hydrogen-bonded elastic networks for robust silicon anodes 冷冻干燥构建硅醇界面氢键弹性网络助力高稳定硅负极
abstract: 高能量密度硅基负极面临体积膨胀引发的导电网络坍塌与界面 结合力不足两大核心挑战. 本研究通过食人鱼溶液处理结合冷冻干燥 工艺, 制备了硅醇官能化单分散纳米硅颗粒(Si@≡Si–OH). 低温工艺有 效抑制了表面≡Si–OH脱水缩合为惰性Si–O–Si键, 同时显著提升了颗 粒在电极中的分散性. 高密度硅醇界面与富羟基海藻酸钠(SA)黏结剂 通过氢键形成弹性网络, 一方面有效缓冲体积膨胀应力并抑制电极开 裂, 另一方面抑制电极界面副反应, 形成致密富LiF的SEI膜. 得益于上 述协同机制, Si@≡Si–OH负极在1 A g −1 下循环200次后容量保持率达 75.9%, 在5 A g −1 高倍率下仍可提供1809 mAh g −1 的可逆容量. 此外, 所 组装的软包全电池在1 C下经600次循环后容量保持率达80.2%. 本工作 通过活性硅醇界面工程实现了力学缓冲与界面化学的协同优化, 为下 一代高能量密度长循环锂离子电池提供了新的材料界面设计策略.

title: From coil to rotation: a bat-inspired light-driven soft robot with self-sustained oscillation 从卷绕到旋转: 一种具有自持续振荡的蝙蝠启发光驱 动软体机器人
abstract: Self-sustained oscillation-based soft robots are receiving increasing attention because they can move without complicated control systems. However, it is still a challenge to get rid of the dependence of the oscillation direction on the direction of the stimulus source. In this work, inspired by the flexible turning ability of bats, we design a self-rotating oscillation soft robot (SROBot) with direction-independent self-sustained oscillation. The system is composed of a coiling soft actuator and a self-shadowing frame. The actuator, fabricated by printing MXene-carbon nanotubes (CNT)-cellulose nanofibers (CNF) ink onto a preheated polyethylene (PE) film using direct ink writing (DIW) technology, exhibits reversible coiling deformation under near-infrared (NIR) light. When integrated with the self-shadowing frame, a negative-feedback loop is formed, allowing the SROBot to realize stable and controllable self-rotating oscillation, with a maximum amplitude of 73.3°. We further demonstrate the multifunctionality of SROBot in guiding and reshaping light beams for information transmission, acting as a light-controlled stirrer, and operating as a small power-generation device. Overall, this work presents a simple strategy for achieving controllable, direction-independent oscillation in soft robots and broadens their potential applications.

title: Monomer mediation enables continuous manufacture of resilient colloidal photonic films

Integrated lattice substitution of ultralow Ru at octahedral sites of metal–organic framework-derived Co3O4 enables corrosion-resistant and highly active hydrogen evolution reaction in seawater 超低含量Ru取代MOF衍生Co3O4八面体位点实现耐 腐蚀高活性海水析氢
abstract: Ruthenium is a promising substitute for platinum in the alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction (HER); however, it remains hindered by three intertwined challenges: surface-loaded Ru nanoparticles prone to aggregation and dissolution, inadequate chloride corrosion resistance, and high cost at meaningful scale. Herein, we report a site-selective lattice substitution strategy in which an ultralow Ru loading of only 1.06 wt% is site-selectively doped into the octahedral Co 3+ sites of a metal–organic framework (MOF)-derived Co 3 O 4 spinel grown on carbon nanofibers, inducing remarkable lattice electronic reconstruction and d-band center modulation. This lattice confinement not only achieves atomic-level Ru dispersion without any Ru–Ru clustering, as confirmed by extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS), but also inherently shields Ru from Cl − attack, enabling stable operation over 72 h in alkaline natural seawater, as further evidenced by post-stability inductively coupled plasma (ICP) analysis. The catalyst exhibits an overpotential of only 102 mV at 10 mA cm −2 in natural seawater with a Tafel slope of 61 mV dec −1 for HER. Remarkably, its mass activity reaches 2.4 A mg Ru −1 , and its price activity reaches 24.28 A dollar −1 , approximately 78 times that of commercial Pt/C (0.312 A dollar −1 ), representing an outstanding noble-metal cost efficiency. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that the Ru–O–Co coordination lowers the water dissociation barrier (from 0.71 to 0.50 eV) and optimizes hydrogen adsorption free energy (from −0.32 to −0.18 eV). This work provides a powerful and cost-effective lattice doping route to anti-corrosion, high-efficiency HER catalysts for practical seawater electrolysis.

title: Decoupling interfacial contact and electronic leakage toward dendrite-free garnet solid-state lithium batteries 界面接触与电子泄漏的解耦实现无枝晶石榴石固态锂电池
abstract: Garnet solid-state electrolytes, particularly Li 6.4 La 3 Zr 1.4 Ta 0.6 O 12 (LLZTO), have attracted considerable attention owing to their intrinsic safety and high ionic conductivity. However, uncontrolled lithium dendrite penetration remains a critical challenge, which is generally attributed to poor Li/electrolyte contact and electronic leakage. Herein, we constructed two typical interfaces to decouple the effects of interfacial physical contact and interfacial electronic conductivity on dendrite initiation and propagation in LLZTO. We show that improved contact reduces interfacial polarization and mitigates current localization, whereas electronic leakage provides a distinct pathway for lithium nucleation within the LLZTO bulk. In contrast, the slightly carbonized PVDF-derived (CP) interface combines lithiophilic species with electronically insulating phases, simultaneously stabilizing interfacial contact, suppressing electron penetration, and accommodating mechanical stress. Consequently, the LLZTO-CP-based symmetric cell achieves an ultrahigh critical current density above 2.75 mA cm −2 and an exceptional lifespan exceeding 4,000 h at 0.1 mA cm −2 . Remarkably, the soft-yet-resilient CP layer expands the mechanical pressure tolerance window of LLZTO-based full cells to 100 MPa. This work establishes a general interfacial design principle that an ideal Li/SSE interface must simultaneously satisfy lithiophilicity, electronic insulation, and mechanical flexibility.

title: Lightweight, high-strength carbon fiber/phenolic resin composites exhibiting flame retardancy and hydrophobicity for electrothermal conversion and electromagnetic shielding 兼具阻燃性和疏水性的轻质高强酚醛树脂/碳纤维复合材料适用于电热转换与电磁屏蔽领域
abstract: Carbon fiber-reinforced polymer composites (CFRPs) are widely utilized in aerospace, rail transit, and other fields owing to their lightweight and high-strength features. Nevertheless, constrained by the inherent properties of single-component resins, existing CFRPs struggle to integrate multiple functions, including moderate cost, high mechanical strength, flame retardancy, electrothermal conversion, and electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding into a single material system. Compared with other polymer resins, phenolic resin (PF) exhibits properties including high char yield, intrinsic flame retardancy, low heat release, ablation resistance, thermal stability, and low cost. Accordingly, PF and carbon fiber fabrics were selected as raw materials in this work, and large-area carbon fiber/phenolic resin (CF/PF) composites with tunable thickness were fabricated via resin film-forming and lamination methods. The as-prepared CF/PF composites possess superior mechanical properties, with a tensile strength of (492.55±24.55) MPa and a flexural strength of (448.49±42.61) MPa. The composite has a density of 1.44 g cm −3 and outstanding flame retardancy (peak heat release rate reaches 4.9 W g −1 ). Meanwhile, the CF/PF composite exhibits rapid and stable Joule-heating performance, reaching a steady-state surface temperature of 120.5 °C under an applied voltage of 2 V. More encouragingly, the composite achieves an exceptional EMI shielding effectiveness (SE) up to 110 dB in the X-band. This work innovatively realizes the integration of five superior performances in CFRPs: lightweight, high strength, flame retardancy, high-efficiency electrothermal conversion, and EMI shielding, which further broadens the practical application potential of CFRPs in diverse scenarios.

title: In situ construction of LiCl-LiF-LiAl SEI via ionic liquid regulation for high-performance all-solid-state lithium metal batteries 调控离子液体原位构建LiCl-LiF-LiAl的SEI界面实现 高性能全固态锂金属电池
abstract: 全固态锂金属电池(ASSB)中构建稳定的固态电解质界面(SEI)能 更好地控锂的均匀沉积, 有助于抑制锂枝晶的生长. 当前研究主要通过 引入多组分卤化物SEI改善LiF的低离子电导率, 却难以同时引入合金 组分来提高SEI的亲锂性与成核位点密度. 因此, 本研究通过引入 AlCl 4 − /Al 2 Cl 7 − 进入咪唑类离子液体, 在锂金属负极界面协同构建复合 SEI(LiCl-LiF-LiAl). 其中, LiCl提升了界面离子电导率, 同时, LiAl合金 提高了对锂的亲和性, 主动引导锂的均匀成核与沉积. 最终实验结果表 明, Li//PEO-[OMIm]AlCl 4 − //Li电池分别在0.1和0.2 mA cm −2 下稳定循 环超过2400和2000小时. LiFePO 4 //PEO-[OMIm]AlCl 4 − //Li电池在2 C 下循环800次后容量保持率为83.8%. 即使在30 °C和0.2 C下, LiFePO 4 //PEO-[OMIm]AlCl 4 − //Li电池在180次循环后容量保持率为97.7%, 表现 出优异的循环性能.

title: Five-element synergy: how high-entropy alloys master the “division of labor” in coupled electrocatalysis
Medium entropy tuning improved multiple electron redox in polyanion cathode for high-rate sodium-ion battery 中等熵调控改善多电子氧化还原反应用于高倍率 钠离子电池的聚阴离子正极
abstract: Sodium vanadium phosphate (Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 , NVP), characterized by its Na + super ionic conductor (NASICON) structure, is recognized as a promising cathode material for sodium-ion batteries (SIBs), yet its practical energy density is hindered by intrinsically low electronic conductivity and a high energy barrier for the V 4+ /V 5+ redox couple. To address these challenges, a medium-entropy tuning strategy was adopted to design a multi-element substituted Na 3.2 V 1.5 Cr 0.1 -Fe 0.1 Mn 0.1 Ni 0.1 Ti 0.1 (PO 4 ) 3 (ME-NVP). This entropy modulation effectively tailors the microscopic electronic structure, enabling reversible V 4+ /V 5+ redox reactions at 4.0 V. Comprehensive analyses reveal a synergistic diffusion mechanism in ME-NVP that simultaneously accelerates Na + transportation and enhances the multiple-electron redox reaction kinetics. Ex-situ X-ray diffraction confirms a highly reversible structural evolution during cycling. As a result, the ME-NVP cathode delivers a high specific capacity of 116.8 mAh g −1 at 0.1 C and retains 83.9% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles at 20 C, while also demonstrating excellent performance over a wide temperature range (−12–50 °C). This work highlights the effectiveness of configurational entropy regulation in unlocking high-energy polyanion cathodes for advanced sodium-ion batteries.

title: Letting polymer semiconductors crystallize along their self-templates
Simultaneous modulation of interfacial dipole and film kinetics via self-assembled monolayers for low-energy-loss organic photovoltaics 通过自组装单分子层同时调节界面偶极和薄膜动力 学以实现低能量损失的有机光伏器件
abstract: Self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) can precisely tune the interfacial dipole of indium tin oxide (ITO)/active layer, yet their influence on the crystallization kinetics of the overlying active layer remains poorly understood, limiting their potential in high-efficiency organic solar cells. Herein, we introduce tetrakis (hydroxymethyl) phosphonium chloride (THPC), a self-assembling material with an extended carbazole core and heteroatom substitution, as a hole transport layer. Unlike the hydrophilic poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):polystyrene sulfonate (PEDOT:PSs), THPC exhibits a low surface energy, providing a favorable template that extends the film formation kinetics of the PM6:L8-BO-X blend by nearly 1.4 times, tackling a prevalent issue regarding explosive nucleation in PM6-based active layers. This promotes a highly ordered fibrous morphology and enhances vertical phase separation. Moreover, the deep work function (5.32 eV) of THPC increases the built-in potential, reduces interfacial trap density, and facilitates charge extraction. As a result, non-radiative recombination loss decreases from 0.243 to 0.227 eV, and the open-circuit voltage rises from 0.866 to 0.883 V, contributing to a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 20.19%, outperforming the PEDOT:PSS control (18.67%). This finding is confirmed across multiple Y-series acceptors, all approaching 20% PCE. Notably, the poly[(2,6-(4,8-bis(5-(2-ethylhexyl)-4-fluoro)thiophen-2-yl)-benzo[1,2- b :4,5- b ′]dithiophene)- alt -5,5′-(5,8-bis(4-(2-butyloctyl)thiophen-2-yl)dithieno[3′,2′:3,4;2″,3″:5,6]benzo[1,2- c ][1,2,5]thiadiazole)] (D18): L8-BO system shows a PCE of 20.55%, demonstrating broad applicability.
